fdroid:aah.mozart.usagedirectplus.name: UsageDirectPlus
fdroid:aah.mozart.usagedirectplus.summary: Screen time history with per-session detail and database export
fdroid:aah.mozart.usagedirectplus.description:
UsageDirectPlus tracks your daily screen time and keeps a permanent log of how long you used each app, and when.
It is a fork of usageDirect that adds:
– Usage intervals: the start and end time of every app session, not just a daily total
– Usage timeline and unlock timeline charts for each day
– Screen on/off and lock/unlock event history
– Database export to a folder of your choice, on demand or on a schedule, with optional GZIP compression
Like the original, it also offers:
– Reliable app usage statistics from up to ten days before the app was installed
– Historical data in charts
– Usage times on a clock pie chart per day
– Weekday average chart
– Daily usage time in a widget
All data is stored in a database on your device. The app has no internet permission; nothing leaves your device unless you export or share the database yourself.
The app needs the usage access permission to read usage statistics, and lists installed apps in order to show their names and icons.

fdroid:app.kotowski.keepsimalive.vanilla.name: Keep SIM Alive
fdroid:app.kotowski.keepsimalive.vanilla.summary: Scheduled keep-alive SMS so prepaid, roaming or backup SIMs stay active
fdroid:app.kotowski.keepsimalive.vanilla.description:
Keep SIM Alive sends an SMS on the schedule you define so your prepaid, roaming, or backup SIM card is never deactivated for inactivity.
 How it works 
For each SIM on the device you set a recipient, a message, and a schedule for when the message goes out. Each keep-alive is a regular SMS: your carrier may charge for it as per your plan.
 Features 
 Dual-SIM device support
 Fixed send time or a random window
 Off-schedule manual send
 Send history with per-message outcomes
 Automatic retries if network is down or the SIM is removed
 Live SIM status to clearly identify the SIM
 Schedule per SIM card and not per slot, so the schedule follows the SIM
 Optional sticky notification while keep-alive is on
 Survives reboots and app updates
 Privacy 
The app has no internet permission and makes no network calls: keep-alive messages are sent directly over the cellular network and all data stays on your device. No advertising, no tracking, no analytics.
 Permissions 
 Send SMS — the keep-alive message itself
 Read phone state — to properly link the schedule to a certain SIM card
 Show notifications — recommended for sticky notification
 Boot completed — to re-arm the schedule after a reboot
 Ignore battery optimizations — optional but recommended, for reliable wake-ups
 Schedule exact alarms (Android 12+) — optional and experimental, for wake-ups despite aggressive battery optimizations; recommended on devices known to kill background apps. On Android 12-14 you grant it via a separate Alarms & reminders toggle, and on Android 15+ the battery exemption above grants it automatically

fdroid:com.siddarthkay.nullpointer.name: null-pointer
fdroid:com.siddarthkay.nullpointer.summary: A client for devnull, the social network for developers
fdroid:com.siddarthkay.nullpointer.description:
null-pointer is a native client for devnull (https://dev-null.sh), the social
network for developers that reads like a git log. Posts are commits, replies
are branches, and the whole thing fits in your pocket.
* Read the log, open a commit and follow its replies as a graph
* Post commits and reply from your phone
* Notifications for replies, stars and new followers
* Profiles, with your own stats and settings
* Light and dark themes
There are no passwords or tokens. On first launch the app generates an
ed25519 key in the Android Keystore and signs every request with it. Sign in
with GitHub happens on dev-null.sh in the system browser; the app never sees
your GitHub password.
The app talks only to devnull (or an instance you point it at). It sends no
analytics, crash reports or advertising identifiers, and contains no tracking
SDKs.
A devnull account is needed, and devnull signs you in through GitHub.

fdroid:com.weenas.castbay.name: CastBay
fdroid:com.weenas.castbay.summary: AirPlay and DLNA receiver for Android TVs, TV boxes, car displays and tablets
fdroid:com.weenas.castbay.description:
CastBay turns an Android big screen — a TV, a TV box, a car display or a tablet — into an AirPlay and DLNA receiver. Cast your iPhone, iPad or Mac screen, music and videos to it, or use the cast button in video and music apps.
 Features 
 Screen mirroring from iPhone, iPad and Mac, up to 60 fps; H.265 up to 4K on TVs with a hardware HEVC decoder.
 Music with the cover as a blurred backdrop and optional synced lyrics; AirPlay music is lossless and stays in time with the phone.
 Video casting : apps' AirPlay video plays straight from the source, with audio tracks and subtitles.
 DLNA : the cast button in apps such as Bilibili, iQiyi, NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music, from iPhones and Android phones.
 Remote or touch screen : a quick menu while playing (picture fit, playback stats, audio and subtitles, pause, skip and a seek bar); media keys and a car's steering-wheel buttons pause and change tracks.
 Who can cast : anyone, devices you allow on the TV, a PIN shown on the TV (as on an Apple TV) or a password; block any device.
 Works on Android 6.0 and later, in English and Chinese.
 Privacy : no account and no ads. Nothing is sent unless you choose to: lyrics lookups, problem reports (with personal details taken out) and anonymous usage statistics are all off until you turn them on.
 The phone and the screen need to be on the same local network. Music from the Mac's Music app isn't supported (a FairPlay mode UxPlay can't handle).
 CastBay is free software (GPL-3.0), built on UxPlay, libplist, Apple's ALAC, OpenSSL and Media3. User guide and FAQ: https://castbay.weenas.com

 The Forum of Computer Scientists for Peace and Social Responsibility (FIfF)
 invites you to FIfFKon42 under the motto "Keine Panik! Resilienz in der
 Polykrise" (Don't panic! Resilience in the polycrisis). The conference takes

 * French

 * Italian
 * Japanese
 * Lithuanian
 * Polish
 * Portuguese (Brazil)
 * Portuguese (Portugal)
 * Russian
 * Spanish

 🤝 You can help translate the app. See the link here.
 💡 Questions regarding the content can only be answered by the

 💣 Bug reports are very welcome. It would be awesome if you
 can describe how to reproduce the particular error in the
 issue tracker at https://github.com/EventFahrplan/EventFahrplan/issues.

fdroid:io.gitlab.jrock902.cypherleaf.name: CypherLeaf
fdroid:io.gitlab.jrock902.cypherleaf.summary: Private, offline notes with folders, tags, and a lock for sensitive entries.
fdroid:io.gitlab.jrock902.cypherleaf.description:
CypherLeaf is a clean, private note-taking app for Android. It works fully
offline, has no ads, no trackers, and no account. Your notes stay on your
device.
Features:
* Notes with folders and tags to keep things organised
* Pin important notes to the top
* Trash with restore, so a delete is never final by accident
* App lock using your device biometric or screen lock
* Protected notes: individual notes and their attachments are encrypted with
 AES-GCM, and the key is held in the Android Keystore, separate from the
 notes database
* Attachments on notes
* Reminders with notifications
* A home-screen widget for recent and pinned notes
* Export notes as plain text, Markdown, or JSON
* Encrypted portable backup protected by a passphrase (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM),
 so you can move your notes to a new device safely
* Light and dark themes, with an adjustable font size
Privacy:
CypherLeaf requests no internet permission in its release build, so it
cannot send your notes anywhere. Fonts are bundled with the app rather
than downloaded. Protected notes and encrypted backups never leave the
device in readable form.
Only notes you mark as protected are encrypted. Other notes are kept in the
app's private storage, which other apps cannot read, but they are not
encrypted by CypherLeaf. Android's own cloud backup and phone-to-phone
transfer are switched off, so nothing is copied off the device unless you
export it; use the encrypted backup to move to a new phone.

apple-macos:403100976.name: myTracks
apple-macos:403100976.description:
myTracks is the swiss-army knife for organizing your GPS tracks. They can be loaded from a broad range of devices and organized in a library comfortably.
Once imported you can drag & drop photo files to myTracks and they will be assigned to the GPS tracks automatically. The GPS information can be written to the EXIF and IPTC tags of the photo files (Geotagging). You can use any photo organizing software such as Photos, iPhoto, Aperture, Lightroom, GraphicConverter or even the Finder. myTracks can handle both JPEG and RAW file formats.
GPS tracks can be exported as GPX, KML or KMZ files. You can use the exported files, e.g. with Google Earth.
Besides the dedicated GPS loggers a free iPhone App called "myTracks - The GPS logger" is available on the App Store. You can use this App to record GPS tracks.
Using iCloud you can easily synchronise all your tracks between all your devices (iOS and macOS).
See the supporting website for more screenshots, screencasts and the complete list of supported loggers.
Feature Highlights:
* Logger Assistant with more than 50 presets for downloading GPS tracks
* Search, bookmark, and organize using the Track Library 
* 1-click, drag & drop geotagging of JPEG and RAW photo files
* Display tracks on a wide variety of maps online and offline
* Import, export, and edit tracks in GPX and KML formats and export of KMZ formats
* Upload photos from within the application to flickr
* Compatible with Adobe Lightroom, Apple Photos, Apple Aperture, Apple iPhoto, GraphicConverter or macOS Finder
* Free versions for iOS include track recording and sync with macOS application
* iCloud support

apple-macos:6785954723.name: PostLens: Social Media Check
apple-macos:6785954723.developer: Foshan Gaoming Huiyang Network Technology Studio (Individually Owned Business)
apple-macos:6785954723.description:
Preparing for a US visa application? Give your past social posts a closer look with PostLens. Review text from your own data exports and cross-check account and timeline details, with your imported content kept on your iPhone.
START WITH A SAMPLE
Explore a built-in sample report before importing personal data. See how coverage, review items and the declaration checklist work. Sample results are illustrative, not an assessment of your posts.
KNOW WHAT TO RE-READ
See which text posts may deserve a closer human review and why. Keep the original context in view while deciding what needs your attention.
CROSS-CHECK YOUR DETAILS
Use the checklist to compare imported accounts, employers, schools and dates with the information you plan to provide in your DS-160. PostLens does not fill in or submit an application.
KEEP YOUR CONTENT LOCAL
Import supported data-export ZIPs from X, Instagram and Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, or YouTube (experimental). Request the export from the platform first; PostLens does not connect to or crawl your accounts. No PostLens account, ads or tracking.
SEE THE LIMITS
The coverage report separates analyzed text from items that still need your attention. Photos, video, audio and private messages are not analyzed. Content outside the imported export is not reviewed.
FREE TO START, PAY PER REPORT
A free scan includes the coverage report and one completed review item when available. Items the analysis cannot conclude remain available for manual review. An optional in-app purchase unlocks additional completed items for that scan on this device. A new scan requires a separate unlock; there is no subscription. Purchases are consumable and cannot be restored after reinstalling. Deleting local data removes local reports and unlocks.
Before analyzing your own posts, follow the app's on-device model setup. Setup can require a model download, sufficient storage and a compatible device.
PostLens supports personal review; it does not predict visa decisions, provide a risk or approval score, or guarantee that unflagged content is safe. It is not legal advice and does not recommend deleting or concealing posts. Follow current application instructions and consult a qualified immigration professional for individual advice.
PostLens is independent of social platforms and government agencies.
Privacy Policy: https://fshuiyangtech.com/en/apps/footprint/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://fshuiyangtech.com/en/apps/footprint/terms/

apple-macos:6794613502.name: TrailPop: Travel Map Video
apple-macos:6794613502.description:
TrailPop turns your trip photos into a cinematic map trajectory video — your photos never leave your device.
HOW IT WORKS
Select photos from your library. TrailPop reads the GPS and timestamp already embedded in each photo, sorts your trip in chronological order (which you can adjust), and draws a real road-navigation route between every stop using Apple Maps — no manual pin-dropping required.
FEATURES
- Real road navigation routes for driving and walking; great-circle flight arcs for planes and boats
- Fog-of-war reveal animation as your route unfolds across the map
- Multiple visual themes: Dark Tech neon map, Retro Polaroid frames, Minimal Glass
- Procedurally generated background music synced to your video's pacing — no licensed samples, no copyright risk
- Export as a 9:16 HD video ready for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or your camera roll
- GPX file import support
- Preview representative video frames and check missing photo locations before exporting
PRIVACY FIRST
TrailPop never uploads your photos or videos. Video composition happens entirely on your device. To draw real roads and the base map, only the coordinates of your stops are sent to Apple Maps. On iPhone and iPad, the free version may show Google AdMob rewarded ads; you choose whether to allow ad tracking. Mac does not show ads.
FREE vs PRO
The free tier includes driving, walking, and flight routes, up to 10 photos per trip, videos up to 30 seconds, and 3 free exports a day on iPhone and iPad — after that, watch a short ad for each export. Mac exports are unlimited and ad-free. TrailPop PRO removes ads and unlocks 50 photos per trip, 60fps, no watermark, videos up to 5 minutes, every visual theme, plus train and ferry routes.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
TrailPop PRO is available as an auto-renewable subscription: PRO Monthly (1 month) or PRO Yearly (1 year). A one-time PRO Lifetime purchase is also offered. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://certaindaniel.github.io/en/trailpop/privacy/

apple-macos:6451333500.description:
Browser extension which makes it easier to follow Hacker News comments threads across multiple visits, by automatically highlighting new comments and showing which items have new comments. It also adds the ability to annotate and mute other users, plus other UX tweaks.
Features:
List pages
• Show new comment counts since you last viewed each item - clicking on the "X new" link will highlight new comments and collapse trees without any new comments
• Hide "AI" items in the main list pages
• Prevent accidental flagging and hiding on mobile by making the "flag" and "hide" controls require confirmation, or hiding them
Item pages
• Highlight new comments and collapse trees without any new comments when you revisit an item - you can configure whether or not this happens automatically when you revisit without using an "X new" link
• Default comment folding controls are replaced with a Reddit-style left-aligned control, with a slightly larger hit target
• Manually highlight the X most-recent comments if it's your first visit or there are no new comments to show
• Mute users to hide their comments and replies to them - muted users can be managed on your own profile page
 • Logged out users get a new 'muted' link in the header they can use to manage their muted users
• Add notes to users on their profile page - the first line will be displayed next to their comments
• Toggle display of "reply" links below comments, to make more room for comments on the screen
• Increased distance between the upvote and downvote arrows at mobile sizes
• Increase the contrast of submission text
Navigation
• Hide navigation links you don't use
• Add an "upvoted" link to the navigation for more convenient access to items you recently upvoted
• Improved mobile navigation - navigation links are displayed underneath other header contents

flathub:com.keepsolid.VpnUnlimited.description:
VPN Unlimited is a cross-platform VPN service with no limits on traffic or connection
 speed. It encrypts your connection, hides your real IP address and lets you choose
 where your traffic leaves the internet, across servers in more than 80 locations.
 This Linux build is deliberately light. It installs no background service and no kernel
 module: the tunnel is created through NetworkManager, the network service your system
 already runs, using the WireGuard protocol. Settings live inside the Flatpak sandbox, so
 removing the application removes them with it.
 Features:
 WireGuard tunnel set up through NetworkManager - no daemon, no driver
 Servers in over 80 locations, with a recommended-server option
 Custom DNS, so you decide who resolves your names
 Works on Steam Deck in both Desktop and Game Mode
 A VPN Unlimited account is required. You can create one from the application or on our
 website.

flathub:io.github.adrienverge.PhotoColla.name: PhotoCollage
flathub:io.github.adrienverge.PhotoColla.summary: Graphical tool to make photo collage posters
flathub:io.github.adrienverge.PhotoColla.description:
PhotoCollage allows you to create photo collage posters. It assembles the
 input photographs it is given to generate a big poster. Photos are
 automatically arranged to fill the whole poster, then you can change the
 final layout, dimensions, border or swap photos in the generated grid.
 Eventually the final poster image can be saved in any size.
 The algorithm generates random layouts that place photos while taking
 advantage of all free space. It tries to fill all space while keeping each
 photo as large as possible.
 PhotoCollage does more or less the same as many commercial websites do, but
 for free and with open-source code.

flathub:io.github.justinrdonnelly.bounce.name: Bouncer
flathub:io.github.justinrdonnelly.bounce.description:
Bouncer is an application to help you choose the correct firewall zone for wireless connections.
 When you connect to a new network, a window opens prompting you for what kind of network (eg home,
 public, work) it is. When you choose the network type, it is associated with that network and automatically
 used in the future.
 NetworkManager and firewalld are required. If you don't use those, you can't use Bouncer. Fedora
 uses both by default. Other distributions may not.
 Additional setup is required after installation. See the applicable section for your distribution.
 Once the setup is done, start Bouncer and confirm your system is configured correctly. Then click
 the Monitor button to begin using Bouncer. After that, it will start automatically when you log
 in.
 Fedora
 For Fedora, everything just works! Just start Bouncer to confirm, and click the Monitor button
 to begin using Bouncer.
 Ubuntu
 Uninstall ufw: sudo apt remove ufw 
 Install firewalld: sudo apt install firewalld 
 By default, polkit is configured to not let regular users set the zone for a connection.
 The simplest way to change this is to add users to the netdev group (eg usermod
 -a -G netdev justin ). Alternatively, you can create a custom polkit rule for the org.freedesktop.NetworkManager.settings.modify.system 
 action (how to create custom polkit rules is beyond the scope of this document and is left as
 an exercise for the reader).
 Start Bouncer and confirm your system is configured correctly. Then click the Monitor button
 to begin using Bouncer.
 Debian
 Install firewalld: sudo apt install firewalld 
 By default, polkit is configured to not let regular users set the zone for a connection.
 The simplest way to change this is to add users to the netdev group (eg usermod
 -a -G netdev justin ). Alternatively, you can create a custom polkit rule for the org.freedesktop.NetworkManager.settings.modify.system 
 action (how to create custom polkit rules is beyond the scope of this document and is left as
 an exercise for the reader).
 Start Bouncer and confirm your system is configured correctly. Then click the Monitor button
 to begin using Bouncer.

flathub:io.github.mihnea_radulescu.image.name: ImageFan Reloaded
flathub:io.github.mihnea_radulescu.image.description:
ImageFan Reloaded is a feature-rich, tab-based image viewer, supporting multi-core processing.
 Features:
 quick concurrent thumbnail generation, scaling to the number of processor cores present
 support for multiple folder tabs, including tab adding, cloning and closing
 keyboard and mouse user interaction
 dark and light modes, based on system settings
 46 supported image formats: avif, bmp, cr2, cur, dds, dng, exr, fts, gif, hdr, heic, heif,
 ico, jfif, jp2, jpe/jpeg/jpg, jps, jxl, mng, nef, nrw, orf, pam, pbm, pcd, pcx, pef, pes, pfm,
 pgm, picon, pict, png, ppm, psd, qoi, raf, rw2, sgi, svg, tga, tif/tiff, wbmp, webp, xbm, xpm
 browsing and image viewing within zip files
 animation support for the image formats: avif, gif, jxl, mng, webp
 fast and seamless full-screen and windowed navigation across images
 full-screen image upsizing options
 image editing capabilities, with undo support: rotate, flip, effects, save in various formats,
 crop and downsize
 folder and image file ordering by name, last modification time and random shuffle, ascending
 and descending
 configurable thumbnail size, between 100 and 1200 pixels
 thumbnail caching capability for fast folder browsing
 slideshow navigation across images
 image info containing file, image, color, EXIF, IPTC and XMP profiles
 automatic image orientation according to the EXIF orientation tag
 toggle-able recursive folder browsing
 targeted zooming in, and moving over the zoomed image

flathub:io.github.zarestia_dev.rclone-ma.name: RClone Manager
flathub:io.github.zarestia_dev.rclone-ma.description:
A graphical interface for rclone that lets you manage cloud storage accounts without using the
 command line. Supports dozens of providers including Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and S3.
 Key features:
 Visual workflow builder: design multi-step automations with an interactive node-based canvas,
 triggers, logic, and notifications
 Quick Runs & Flow automation hub: one-click operation execution, CLI command import,
 and reusable templates
 Built-in file manager (Nautilus): browse, copy, move, rename, delete, archive, and preview
 remote files
 Rich media preview: support for images, videos, audio, PDFs, Markdown, and code with syntax
 highlighting
 Mount cloud storage as a local drive with VFS cache controls
 Automations: schedule operations using cron expressions or trigger transfers with real-time
 file system watchers
 Serve remote storage over HTTP or WebDAV
 Power management: prevents automatic system sleep while active transfers, mounts, or servers
 are running
 System tray integration and customizable keyboard shortcuts for quick control
 Theme support: dark and light modes with automatic system theme synchronization
 Encrypted configuration storage with full backup and restore support
 Multi-backend management with customizable per-operation profiles
 Troubleshooting: If you encounter an "Invalid binary" error during setup, it is likely caused
 by an outdated system rclone binary. Go to Settings → Core, clear the rclone binary path, and click
 Save & Reset Engine. When prompted, let the app download and install the latest rclone version
 automatically.
 For other issues such as a blank screen or freezes on Linux, refer to the Linux Troubleshooting
 Guide linked below.

flathub:me.amankhanna.opendeck.name: OpenDeck
flathub:me.amankhanna.opendeck.description:
OpenDeck is an application for using stream controller devices like the Elgato Stream Deck.
 OpenDeck supports the majority of the original Stream Deck plugins, like Elgato's own Discord plugin, unlike other softwares (e.g. streamdeck-ui, StreamController, Boatswain) which are much more limited.
 Please note that you will need to install udev subsystem rules for your device to be detected. For more information, see the Installation section of the project README on GitHub.
 Some compiled plugins are not compiled for Linux, so you may need to have Wine (and Wine Mono) installed on your system (natively, as the Wine Flatpak is not supported). Similarly, for using plugins made with Node.js, the Node.js Flatpak is not supported.
 From Multi Actions and Toggle Actions to switching profiles when you switch apps and brightness control, OpenDeck has all the features you'd expect from stream controller software.
 Consider that the power of your Stream Deck actually comes from the software you use with it, then remember how much you paid for it. To support OpenDeck's development, please consider donating to me on GitHub Sponsors, Ko-fi or Liberapay.

fedora-packages:atlas/atlas.name: atlas
fedora-packages:atlas/atlas.description: The ATLAS (Automatically Tuned Linear Algebra Software) project is an ongoing research effort f(ocusing on applying empirical techniques in order to provide portable performance. At present, it provides C and Fortran77 interfaces to a portably efficient BLAS implementation, as well as a few routines from LAPACK. The performance improvements in ATLAS are obtained largely via compile-time optimizations and tend to be specific to a given hardware configuration. In order to package ATLAS some compromises are necessary so that good performance can be obtained on a variety of hardware. This set of ATLAS binary packages is therefore not necessarily optimal for any specific hardware configuration. However, the source package can be used to compile customized ATLAS packages; see the documentation for information.

fedora-packages:bee2/bee2-devel.description: Bee2 is a cryptographic library which implements cryptographic algorithm and protocols standardized in Belarus. Bee2 fully supports the following Belarusian cryptography standards (STB): STB 34.101.31 (belt): data encryption and integrity algorithms. STB 34.101.45 (bign): digital signature and key transport algorithms over elliptic curves. STB 34.101.47 (brng): cryptographic algorithms of pseudorandom number generation + one-time passwords. STB 34.101.60 (bels): secret sharing algorithms. STB 34.101.66 (bake): key establishment protocols over elliptic curves. STB 34.101.77 (bash): sponge-based algorithms. For more details see apmi.bsu.by/resources/std.html Bee2 partially supports cryptographic data formats defined in the following standards: STB 34.101.78 (bpki): a PKI profile. Additionally, Bee2 implements digital signature algorithms standardized in Russia and Ukraine.

Snowball was originally designed and built by Martin Porter. Martin retired from development in 2014 and Snowball is now maintained as a community project. firefox-addons:2894269.name: YouTube No Title Translate
firefox-addons:2894269.summary: Rewrites YT video titles back to default language. Includes currently watched video, lists in front page and video suggestions.
firefox-addons:2894269.description:
This addon is aimed to fix the issue that YT will automatically enforce "translated" video names upon the end user, based on their interface language, which results in generally worse quality of titles since by definition it can't be better than native speaker writing it (+ generally I'm not going to watch videos in unknown language if they have a weird title anyway)
The following page parts are covered:
(1) Tab name
(2) Currently watched video title
(3) Titles in video suggestions
(4) Titles in the front page (feed)
The following parts are NOT covered:
(5) Mini-player mode (mostly because there isn't a straightforward way to extract the video ID from the mini-player interface)
(6) Shorts (may be added later)
Also, was NOT tested with their mobile version markup.
If YT changes their website in a way that this addon stops working and I didn't notice, please create an issue at GitHub: https://github.com/jewalky/yt-no-title-translate/issues

Nextcloud is a suite of client-server software for creating and using file hosting services. Nextcloud application functionally is similar to Dropbox. Unlike Dropbox, Nextcloud does not offer off-premises file storage hosting. Nextcloud is free and open-source, which means that anyone is allowed to install and operate it on their own private server devices.
In contrast to proprietary services like Dropbox, the open architecture allows adding functionality to the server in the form of applications and enables users to have full control of their data.
This extension allows you to synchronize passwords from the application with the browser. The application Nextcloud Passwords must already be installed on the server.

firefox-addons:2836240.name: Toggle Native Tab Bar
firefox-addons:2836240.summary: Toggle the visibility of your Firefox tab bar (horizontal or native vertical tabs) with a single click.
firefox-addons:2836240.description:
Toggle Native Tab Bar gives you complete control over your browser's real estate. Whether you prefer the classic horizontal layout or the new native vertical tabs, this extension allows you to toggle that bar on and off instantly whenever you need it. It is the perfect companion for sidebar extensions like Tree Style Tab .
 Advanced Support & Customization: 
* Native Tab Support: Fully compatible with both standard horizontal and the latest native vertical tab features.
* Dynamic Icon Coloring: The toolbar icon automatically matches your browser theme colors for a seamless, native look (requires a simple one-time manual setup).
* Quick Access: Right-click the extension icon for instant access to setup instructions and settings.
* Theme-Responsive Design: Options and setup pages automatically adapt to your browser's Light or Dark mode.
* Clean, Minimalist Design: Modernized icons that visually represent the current state of your workspace.
 Core Features: 
* Instant Toggle: Show or hide the native tab bar with a click or keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+T).
* Companion for Sidebars: Designed to work perfectly alongside your favorite vertical tab managers.
* Per-Window Control: Choose to toggle the tab bar globally across all windows or on a per-window basis.
* Session Persistence: Your toggle states are automatically saved and restored when you restart Firefox.
* Flexible Configuration: Choose whether to keep the native window control buttons (min/max/close) visible even when tabs are hidden.
* Performance Optimized: Extremely lightweight with zero impact on browser speed.
 Important: Setup Required 
Because Firefox does not allow extensions to hide the tab bar directly, this add-on requires a small amount of one-time setup:
1. Enable userChrome.css support in your Firefox profile.
2. Add a few lines of CSS to your userChrome.css file.
Clear, step-by-step instructions (with copy-pasteable CSS) are provided immediately upon installation and are always available in the extension's options page.
 Privacy & Compliance 
This extension does not collect, store, or transmit any user data. It is 100% open-source and respects your privacy.

bluejetty:00000003:ios.name: Dojo
bluejetty:00000003:ios.summary: Dojo is an iOS app for personalized, AI-guided meditation. It creates guided sessions around a user's goal, available time, and preferences. With permission, it can show optional heart-rate context from supported connected wearables. Dojo i
bluejetty:00000003:ios.description:
TRAIN YOUR MIND LIKE A MARTIAL ARTIST
Master the martial art of your mind. Like any martial art, it is built through practice, and the dojo is where you train.
Tell Dojo how you feel and how much time you have. Sensei, your teacher in the app, puts together a session for right now: the practices, the narrator, the sounds and the length. Want it shorter or with less talking? Just say so, and the session changes right there.
A TEACHER WHO ALREADY KNOWS YOU
Sensei remembers your level, what you like and what helps, from your first session to your hundredth. Awake at 3 a.m., a big call in ten minutes, a slow start to the morning: each moment gets its own practice.
SEE YOUR BODY SLIP INTO RECOVERY
Meditate with Apple Watch, AirPods Pro 3, WHOOP or Fitbit and Dojo shows your heart rate live. After the session you see how far your body settled, measured against your own resting heart rate: Recovery, Deep recovery or Elite recovery. Sensei uses what settled you to shape your next sessions. No wearable? Dojo works fine without one.
A FREQUENCY FOR EVERY SESSION
Each session layers a guiding voice with music, nature sounds and a binaural beat: 2 Hz for sleep, 10 Hz to unwind, 14 Hz for focus. Best with headphones.
MAKE IT YOURS, THEN SHARE IT
Build your own session step by step from breathwork, body scans, mantras and quiet time, then choose the music and sounds. Send any session to someone you love with a link.
SMALL SESSIONS ADD UP
Progress keeps your streaks, practice minutes and heart-rate records in one place, so you can watch the habit build.
FOR BEGINNERS AND EXPERIENCED PRACTITIONERS
Never meditated? Start with two minutes. Years of practice? Ask for thirty minutes, mostly silence.
Heart-rate information is for your own reference. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose or treat any condition.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
The yearly plan may begin with a 7-day free trial for eligible users. The monthly plan starts as a paid subscription. Available offers and eligibility are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.medidojo.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.medidojo.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00064522:ios.description:
The Affinity Plus mobile banking app is loaded with features to make banking and managing your money as easy as possible.
• Budgets: Set and track monthly budgets for different categories. 
• Net Worth: Track how your account balances compare to what you owe. 
• Add your card to your digital wallet for quick and secure payments on the go.
• When you request a replacement card through the app, you’ll get a digital version to use right away.
• Activate your new debit or credit card without having to call.
• Spending Analysis: See how much you’re spending, and what you’re spending it on.
• Cash Flow: Track the net amount of what’s coming in vs. going out.
• Savings Goals: Set a goal amount and target date, and watch your progress.
• On your dashboard, you decide which accounts and features appear, and where.
• Choose Spanish as your preferred language.
• Link to your external accounts with the Connect button on your dashboard, and see their balances along with your Affinity Plus accounts.
• Choose from a variety of Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) options by going to Menu>Settings>Security>Authentication.
• Get better transaction details, with the ability to edit their name and category for easier tracking.
• Business Owners and Authorized Signers can give specific account access to other staff members.
• Also for Business members: Use filters to create the reports you want, and download them as the file type you need.
• Deposit checks from anywhere by taking their picture with the app.
• With Stash Your Cash on the Transfer screen, you can set a checking account to round up all debit card purchases to the next whole dollar, then automatically transfer the difference to your savings.
• Get security alerts, and choose from up to 16 Account Alerts that help you keep track of your savings, checking, and loans with reminders and confirmations that you can customize.
• Easily switch between profiles that you add by going to Menu>Settings>Manage Other Profiles.
• For extra security, peace of mind, and help with budgeting, use Card Controls & Alerts to set spending limits (per transaction or monthly) for your debit and credit cards; or just get transaction alerts for awareness.
• On your dashboard, get free and easy access to your credit score, your full credit report, daily credit monitoring for fraud protection, and tips on keeping a great credit rating.
• Go into any of your accounts to find your MyPlus Rewards points, and to redeem them for gift cards, travel, and more.
• Enroll in Bill Pay from the app, and see your eBill amounts and due dates.
• iPad Multitasking so you can split your screen and use another app at the same time.
• On the Transfer screen, add another member’s account so you can transfer to them; or share a code with them so they can transfer to you.
• Use Balance Transfer to easily bring an external credit card balance over to your Affinity Plus credit card.
• Manage all your personal, credit card and business accounts and loans, and even view your Affinity Plus mortgage.
• Find nearby ATMs and branches right from the login screen.
• Contact us for help.
• Get a pre-login peek at balances with Quick Balance (found on the Menu screen).
• Manage Bill Pay.
• Log in fast with Touch ID® or Face ID®.
• Check recent transactions and initiate new ones.
• Schedule and edit one-time or recurring transfers.
• Apply for loans and credit cards, or open another account.

bluejetty:00163198:ios.description:
The TBM app, your go-to for daily and occasional trips within Bordeaux Métropole and its surroundings! 
With the TBM app, experience innovative, sustainable, multimodal, and accessible mobility.
CHECK YOUR LINES' TIMETABLES AT ANY TIME
Find the complete schedules of the various TBM network lines (tram, bus, boat), as well as those for trains, TER, and regional coaches, and view the real-time position of your transport on the map before it arrives.
For users of the Le Vélo service or park-and-ride facilities, you can also check the number of bikes or available places in real-time before heading there.
SAVE TIME THANKS TO YOUR FAVORITES
Tram stops, bus or coach stops, TER stations, Le Vélo stations, or park-and-ride facilities, add them to your favorites to access the next departures more quickly or check the number of available places from the home page. Plus, you can sort them to display them in the order of your choice!
FIND THE RIGHT ROUTE FOR YOU AND LET US GUIDE YOU
For an immediate or delayed trip, search for your routes and compare the proposed results based on your preferences to find the best route. Once the route is selected, we guide you to your destination.
BE THE FIRST TO KNOW ABOUT DISRUPTIONS ON YOUR LINES
For more peace of mind during your journeys, network traffic information is accessible in just a few clicks. Activate alerts on your usual lines to be notified of any disruptions affecting your route!
BUY AND VALIDATE TICKETS AND SUBSCRIPTIONS FOR YOU AND YOUR TRAVELERS
Make your life easier by purchasing your transport tickets (single or new subscription) directly from the app and validating them in just a few seconds.
UNLOCK A BIKE AT A STATION WITH YOUR PHONE
With or without a subscription, save time by unlocking a bike directly from your smartphone without using the terminal.
OPEN A PARK-AND-RIDE OR BIKE SHELTER WITH YOUR PHONE
No need for a ticket or card anymore! If you have a compatible ticket, you can open any park-and-ride or bike shelter directly with your smartphone.
ENJOY ALL THE SERVICES OFFERED BY TBM
With your unique mobility account, you can use the different TBM services both on mobile and the web without needing multiple accounts.

bluejetty:00083850:android.description:
Aim Pool is a wonderful pool training app designed to help players enthusiasts sharpen their shooting skills in billiards game as well as pool game. By continuously running in the background to record game replays and extend aiming guidelines during game play, Aim Pool allows players to review their actions, identify any aiming deviations, and significantly enhance their accuracy and overall feel for the game. Traditionally, training for precision in billiards or pool game has been slow and inefficient, but Aim Pool revolutionizes this process.
Key Features:
1. Real-Time Aim Correction: Instantly see your aiming deviations to improve your shot accuracy.
2. Recording Game Replay: Record and review your game video to identify and correct mistakes, ensuring continuous improvement.
3. Support various billiards game rule such as snooker, 9 ball and 8 ball pool.
We also provide some premium features:
1. Cushion Shot Guidelines: Learn cushion shots effortlessly with visual guides.
2. Cue Ball Path Tracking: Understand the cue ball's post-impact trajectory with ease.
3. 3-Line Guidelines: Emulate professional players' shots with advanced guideline features.
Permission Statement: To provide game video recording and analysis, Aim Pool requires "screen capture" permissions, "FOREGROUND_SERVICE", "FOREGROUND_SERVCIE_MEDIA_PROJECTION" permissions. Your game footage is stored locally on your device and is never transmitted to any third parties, including our own servers. We also ensure that only game-related footage is recorded, respecting your privacy at all times.

listings.description:
Aim Pool is a wonderful pool training app designed to help players enthusiasts sharpen their shooting skills in billiards game as well as pool game. By continuously running in the background to record game replays and extend aiming guidelines during game play, Aim Pool allows players to review their actions, identify any aiming deviations, and significantly enhance their accuracy and overall feel for the game. Traditionally, training for precision in billiards or pool game has been slow and inefficient, but Aim Pool revolutionizes this process.

Key Features:

1. Real-Time Aim Correction: Instantly see your aiming deviations to improve your shot accuracy.
2. Recording Game Replay: Record and review your game video to identify and correct mistakes, ensuring continuous improvement.
3. Support various billiards game rule such as snooker, 9 ball and 8 ball pool.

We also provide some premium features:
1. Cushion Shot Guidelines: Learn cushion shots effortlessly with visual guides.
2. Cue Ball Path Tracking: Understand the cue ball's post-impact trajectory with ease.
3. 3-Line Guidelines: Emulate professional players' shots with advanced guideline features.

Permission Statement: To provide game video recording and analysis, Aim Pool requires "screen capture" permissions, "FOREGROUND_SERVICE", "FOREGROUND_SERVCIE_MEDIA_PROJECTION" permissions. Your game footage is stored locally on your device and is never transmitted to any third parties, including our own servers. We also ensure that only game-related footage is recorded, respecting your privacy at all times.

Choose, Feel, Experience and LIVE your Story in Linda Brown, a one-of-a-kind romance story game where YOU control the outcome.

DECIDE WHAT COMES NEXT
Your choices will determine who you fall in love with and even who you'll become your enemy. Watch out!

CHOOSE YOUR LOOKS
What you wear will also impact the story in different ways. Ready to dress for the occasion?

INTERACT WITH THE ENVIRONMENT
Explore the characters' cellphones, get objects to advance in the story and more!

PLUS enjoy a story with incredible graphics that have no match in the category.

Linda Brown: Interactive Story is free to play, but you can purchase additional parts of game experience with real money.

bluejetty:00021479:ios.description:
With Mobile Link, you can harness the full potential of your generator, and propane tank, from anywhere, at any time, directly from your smartphone or tablet.
Key features include:
Monitor Real-Time Status: Instantly view your generator's current operational status and upcoming maintenance requirements.
Customize Notifications: Set personalized alerts to keep you informed about changes in your generator’s status.
Track Maintenance History: Effortlessly log and manage detailed records of your generator's service and maintenance.
Adjust Settings Remotely: Schedule your generator's exercise routine from anywhere to ensure its readiness.
Gauge Fuel Levels: Keep tabs on fuel levels to guarantee uninterrupted power supply.
Reach Out for Support: Connect easily with certified Generac dealers for expert service and maintenance.
Upgrade for Better Coverage: Enhance reliability and coverage by upgrading to cellular monitoring.
Sync with ecobee: Integrate with your ecobee thermostat for enhanced, in-home visibility of your generator's status.
Compatible with a selection of automatic home standby generators from Generac, Centurion, Honeywell, Eaton, and Siemens, the Mobile Link service and app are tailored to give you control and confidence in your home's energy resilience.

bluejetty:00030944:ios.name: Cooking Fever Duels: Food Wars
bluejetty:00030944:ios.summary: Unleash Your Culinary Genius: Embrace the adrenaline rush of live PVP battles. Outmaneuver, outcook, and outshine your rivals in exhilarating real-time duels. Feel the heat of the kitchen as you race against time, balancing speed with culin
bluejetty:00030944:ios.description:
Unleash Your Culinary Genius: Embrace the adrenaline rush of live PVP battles. Outmaneuver, outcook, and outshine your rivals in exhilarating real-time duels. Feel the heat of the kitchen as you race against time, balancing speed with culinary precision to emerge victorious.
Ascend the Leaderboards: Cook your way to glory! Compete in local and global challenges, leaving your mark as a top chef. Earn your place among culinary legends on the leaderboard, where every dish you serve brings you closer to the coveted title of Master Chef. 
A Bounty of Rewards: Each season brings new, tantalizing challenges and mouth-watering prizes. Strive for excellence, conquer daily quests, and claim your rightful rewards, enhancing your journey through the culinary world. 
Global Gastronomy: Explore a vast array of dishes from across the world. From the tantalizing spices of Asia to the comforting classics of America, your journey will be a rollercoaster of flavors and cuisines, challenging your versatility and skill as a chef.
Kitchen Upgrades Galore: Hundreds of upgrades await! Transform your humble kitchen into a state-of-the-art culinary paradise. Equip yourself with the best tools and gadgets, ensuring each dish you create is a masterpiece of flavor and presentation.
Daily Quests, Endless Fun: Embark on new quests every day, each bringing unique challenges and rewards. These daily adventures keep the game fresh, exciting, and endlessly engaging.
Customize Your Chef: Express your personality with an adorable collection of animated Foodie avatars. From the quirky to the cute, choose an avatar that reflects your culinary style and adds a personal touch to your cooking journey.
Immerse yourself in the bustling ambiance of 'Cooking Fever Duels.' Here, every ingredient matters, every second counts, and every dish tells a story. This isn't just a game; it's a journey through diverse culinary landscapes, where you'll unlock secret recipes, master exotic dishes, and leave your patrons craving for more.
Compete, Collaborate, Celebrate:
Challenge Friends and Foes: Not only will you face off against unknown culinary talents from around the world, but you can also challenge your friends to friendly duels. Show off your cooking prowess and become the envy of your social circle!
Community and Competitions: Join an enthusiastic community of fellow chefs. Participate in events, share tips, and revel in the joys of cooking. Regular updates bring new competitions and themes, keeping the excitement alive.
Always Connected: 'Cooking Fever Duels' is an online extravaganza, ensuring you're always part of an active, vibrant community. Connect, compete, and cook in a dynamic, ever-evolving world.
Troubleshooting and Support:
Got questions or need a helping hand? Our dedicated support team is just a click away! Reach out for assistance, share your feedback, or suggest new features to make your cooking experience even better. https://www.nordcurrent.com/support/?gameid=1 
Stay Informed: Read our Privacy/Terms & Conditions for a safe and enjoyable gaming experience. https://www.nordcurrent.com/privacy/ 
Important Note: 'Cooking Fever Duels' is an online game, requiring an internet connection for the full, rich experience of global culinary battles.

bluejetty:00044253:ios.description:
Vivez l’expérience Womance où que vous soyez ! Tendances actuelles, créations exclusives et trouvailles locales : tout l’univers de votre boutique préférée est désormais au bout de vos doigts.
Téléchargez l'application Womance : simple, inspirante et humaine.
- Expérience personnalisée : Un flux de produits adapté à vos goûts pour simplifier votre magasinage.
- Notifications en primeur : Soyez la première informée de nos nouveaux arrivages, de nos restocks très attendus et de nos offres exclusives.
- Liste de souhaits : Sauvegardez vos coups de cœur en un clic pour les retrouver plus tard.
- Service 7 jours sur 7 : Un accès direct à notre chat en ligne et à un service à la clientèle humain, toujours là pour vous aider.
- Livraison & Retours : Expédition rapide partout au Canada et processus de retour simplifié.
Nos collections exclusives conçues avec passion à Québec, nos marques maison sont pensées pour votre confort et votre style :
- Womance : Vêtements tendances, tricots douillets, denims parfaits et essentiels pour la vie de tous les jours.
- Sans-Façon Cosmétiques : Une gamme de maquillage et de soins performante, simple et authentique.
- Womance Maison : Fragrances d'ambiance, produits ménagers écoresponsables et accessoires pour transformer votre foyer.
Le meilleur des créateurs québécois & marques recherchées. Nous sommes fiers de collaborer avec des entrepreneurs d’ici pour vous offrir une diversité de produits uniques :
- Accessoires & Mode : Matt & Nat, Horace Jewelry, Pilgrim, Lambert, et bien d'autres.
- Soins & Bien-être : BKIND, Atelier La Vie Apothicaire, Dans un Jardin, Selv Rituel.
- Maison & Lifestyle : Apprenti Ô'rganik, Mimi & August, et plusieurs autres découvertes locales.
À propos de Womance
Depuis ses débuts, Womance s’est donné pour mission d’accompagner les femmes dans leur quotidien en offrant une mode accessible, de qualité et diversifiée. Guidés par une passion pour l'entrepreneuriat d'ici, nous mettons de l'avant des designers québécois tout en créant nos propres collections exclusives de vêtements, de produits pour la maison et de cosmétiques.
Chez Womance, on croit que le style ne devrait jamais compromettre le confort. C’est pourquoi nous sélectionnons chaque matière avec soin, du tricot le plus doux au denim le plus souple, pour que vous vous sentiez bien, peu importe l'occasion.

bluejetty:00140356:ios.description:
Get the Buzztime Trivia app to play at your favorite Buzztime location, as well as single-player “Countdown GO” and “Buzztime Dash” games while on the go. Challenge your smarts by answering questions provided by the nation’s leading trivia company. Once you download Buzztime Trivia, simply login or register as a new player to unlock these buzzworthy features!
Buzztime Trivia Features:
• Play all the exclusive Buzztime trivia network games that you know and love to earn Players Plus Points!
• Just head into your favorite Buzztime location and select the Play at a Buzztime Location button on the home screen to play using your mobile device.
• Claim your spot at the top of local and network leaderboards so you can brag about it to your bar buddies!
OR

• Find your favorite trivia topics from categories like sports, pop culture, music, movies, and more in Countdown GO! Grab a beverage and get ready to trivia and chill.
• Want to play faster? Buzztime Dash will test your quickness in 10-second questions with NO HINTS! We can't look away either!
Important Notes
With Buzztime Trivia, you get your daily trivia fix. Choose your favorite game here https://www.buzztime.com/app/schedule and head into a Buzztime location to play: http://www.buzztime.com/site-finder

bluejetty:00073448:ios.summary:

Podcast App is built around one idea: getting yo
bluejetty:00073448:ios.description:
Find great podcasts. Podcast App is the #1 most downloaded independent podcast player on iOS. Millions and millions of downloads, over 415,000 ratings, and named one of Apple's Apps We Love.
Podcast App is built around one idea: getting you to your next episode as fast as possible. You're usually on the go, so everything is simple, intuitive, and takes the fewest possible steps. Save episodes and build playlists in a tap as you discover them, and get back to anything you've saved or started just as fast. And it's reliable where it counts: new episodes arrive the moment they're released, and your audio never stops, because we know you're listening while doing everything else. Less time fiddling with an app, more time enjoying what you love.
NEW: AI DIGEST, YOUR PODCAST ADVISORS
Not sure what to listen to? AI Digest creates a short podcast made just for you: a 5 to 10 minute conversation between two hosts breaking down the top recent episodes you might love. Get a sneak peek of what's worth your time, then tap play on the ones that grab you. It's like having your own podcast advisors on call.
FIND YOUR NEXT FAVORITE IN SECONDS
* Search shows and episodes across millions of podcasts by topic, guest, person, or event
* Search within a show to find that one episode someone recommended, or check if your favorite host covered a topic or invited a guest
* Get recommendations based on your listening, so you keep discovering new favorites
* Flip through the latest releases from all your favorite shows in our stories style feed
* Explore trending shows in true crime, news, comedy, sports, health, business, education, parenting, and more
SAVE, ORGANIZE, CURATE
* Save any episode with one tap as you discover it
* Build your Listen Later list and have it downloaded, offline, and ready to go
* Create episode playlists by topic or guest, for what's next or the favorites you want to keep
* Share your playlists with friends, family, and coworkers to bring them along
LISTEN YOUR WAY
* Get new episodes the moment they launch
* Pick up right where you left off, speed up playback, rewind or skip ahead
* Track your listening history and streaks, and quickly find that insightful episode you want to revisit or pass along
* Listen in the car with CarPlay
* Listen on your Apple Watch, no iPhone needed
Whether it's the news on your commute, true crime on a road trip, or a bedtime story to wind down, Podcast App makes the world of podcasts your own. Stop scrolling. Just listen.
BUILT BY A TEAM YOU CAN TRUST
Our team has built consumer products with 100M+ installs, and our work has been featured by Apple, TechCrunch, Yahoo, Fast Company, and Fox.
PREMIUM
Our free app is ad supported, with visual ads. Upgrade to Premium to:
* Remove all visual ads completely
* Unlock your full listening history
* Add your own private podcasts by URL
* Create podcast show folders to organize your favorites
* Customize per show settings, including push notifications and default sort order
The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and will identify the cost of the renewal. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication, where applicable. Prices may vary from country to country.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy & Terms of Use: https://podcast.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00074926:ios.summary:
Na Vila 11, você aluga seu apartamento sem burocracia nas melhores regiões de São Paulo e conta com o app do Portal do Morador para facilitar sua rotina no condomínio.
Entenda as funcionalidades do nosso app que tornam o seu dia a dia livre
bluejetty:00074926:ios.description:
Na Vila 11, você aluga seu apartamento sem burocracia nas melhores regiões de São Paulo e conta com o app do Portal do Morador para facilitar sua rotina no condomínio.
Entenda as funcionalidades do nosso app que tornam o seu dia a dia livre de preocupações:
 • AVISOS: Receba comunicados e notificações sobre o seu condomínio em tempo real.
 • RESERVAS: Agora você pode consultar disponibilidade, realizar e alterar reservas das áreas comuns direto pelo Portal do Morador.
 • CORRESPONDÊNCIAS: Ansioso pela encomenda que está para chegar? Recepcionistas tiram foto dos pacotes e você recebe um QRCode para retirá-los na recepção. Facilidade e segurança para suas encomendas.
 • LIBERAÇÃO DE ACESSOS: “Diarista Maria chegou em seu condomínio” essa é a notificação que você receberá pelo app quando alguém pré-cadastrado chegar na sua casa! Todo o controle de entrada e saída do condomínio centralizados = mais agilidade e autonomia para você. 
 • CHAMADOS: Para qualquer solicitação, dúvida ou reclamação, abra um chamado para o seu Líder de Vila através do Portal do Morador de forma rápida e prática.
Quer mais? Acesse os benefícios do Clube da Vila Marketplace, vote em enquetes do condomínio, veja a agenda dos próximos eventos, conheça a equipe do prédio e muito mais!

bluejetty:00070001:ios.description:
SONGPOP — GUESS THE SONG. THE #1 MUSIC TRIVIA GAME IS BACK!
Think you know your music? Prove it. SongPop is the world's most popular song quiz game — a fast, fun music trivia showdown where you guess the song and artist faster than everyone else.
100,000+ REAL SONG CLIPS
From Billie Eilish, Ariana Grande, Justin Bieber and Cardi B to timeless classics from Queen, Michael Jackson, and every decade of hits — 80s, 90s, 2000s, and today's chart-toppers.
 PLAY YOUR WAY
• Real-time PvP: Head-to-head live matches against players worldwide
• Classic Mode: Async duels you can play on your own schedule 
• Private Games: Challenge your friends and family
• Tournaments: Compete for the top of the leaderboard
 BUILD YOUR PLAYLISTS
Level up your favorite genres — pop, rock, hip-hop, K-pop, Latin, EDM, country and more. Collect unique items, express your musical personality, and become the master of your favorite music categories.
 EARN EXCLUSIVE REWARDS
Progress through the monthly Music Pass to unlock avatars, frames, stickers, vinyl collectibles and rare rewards. Spin the Wheel of Fortune for surprise prizes every day.
 THE ULTIMATE HEARDLE ALTERNATIVE
Love Heardle, Wordle, or daily song games? SongPop takes music guessing to the next level with unlimited playlists, live multiplayer, and a real 100K+ song catalog — not just one song a day.
WHY MILLIONS PLAY SONGPOP:
. 100K+ licensed music clips from real artists
. Free to play, quick 60-second matches
. Perfect for parties, road trips, or solo listening
. Fresh playlists and events added weekly
. Cross-generational — great for teens, parents, families
Ready to prove you have the best ear in the game? Download SongPop and start guessing!

bluejetty:00021219:ios.name: Vachanamrut Learning App
bluejetty:00021219:ios.summary: With the inspiration and guidance of Acharya Shree Koshalendraprasadji Maharaj and Bhuj Mahant Swami Shree Dharmanandan Dasji, the Vachanamrut is being made available in an ‘app’ format to commemorate the bicentenary (200th anniversary) of
bluejetty:00021219:ios.description:
With the inspiration and guidance of Acharya Shree Koshalendraprasadji Maharaj and Bhuj Mahant Swami Shree Dharmanandan Dasji, the Vachanamrut is being made available in an ‘app’ format to commemorate the bicentenary (200th anniversary) of the Vachanamrut.
Through various useful features such as short-and-simple definitions and easy-to-understand explanations, this app provides a study platform for spiritual seekers looking to better understand the subtleties of eternal knowledge and apply the teachings of Bhagwan Shree Swaminarayan to their lives. Utilising current technology, this app meets the needs of today’s spiritual generation by giving them access to ancient wisdom in a modern format – making the study of the Vachanamrut a truly enjoyable experience.
The ‘Vachanamrut Learning App’ contains easy-to-use features such as:
Personal Account - Register for an account using your email address or login using your existing Google or Facebook account for added functionality; notes, reading list, reading history and search history are automatically backed up.
Seamless Switching Between Devices - If you are logged into the app, your notes, reading list, reading history and search history all instantly synced to your other devices.
Auto Bookmark - Access the Vachanamrut that you last visited from the home screen.
Reading List - Add Vachanamruts to your reading list so that you never forget your "wish" list of ones to read as part of your study or research into a particular topic or concept.
4 Different "Languages" - Gujarati, Gujarati Transliterated (Lipi/Latin), Gujarati Phonetic and English.
Summary - Summary of each Vachanamrut to help you decide if the specific Vachanamrut is of interest to you. Also included are additional facts and images to assist with understanding the geography of where and how the Vachanamrut was delivered.
Dark or Light Mode - Read in the mode that best suits your eyes during the day or night.
Adjustable Font Size - Increase or decrease the font size to suit preference.
Line Spacing - Choose from 3 different line spacing options to suit your reading preference.
Read time indication - Have limited time? Pick a Vachanamrut that you will be able to complete by using our helpful read time indicators.
Audiobook - Listen to each Vachanamrut being read in Gujarati and follow along with the auto-scroll text. Great for those who are learning Gujarati or those who are having difficulty pronouncing difficult words. (Currently available in Gujarati, Gujarati Latin and Gujarati Phonetics mode).
Split Screen Mode - Read the same Vachanamrut in 2 different languages. Great for those who are learning Gujarati or those who are having difficulty pronouncing difficult words.
Sabha Pictorials - Artist depictions of each Vachanamrut to help you visualise the location of where it took place and what Maharaj was wearing.
Share - Share a link to the whole Vachanamrut or individual paragraphs with your friends.
Notes - Write personal notes about the whole Vachanamrut or individual paragraphs.
Copy - Copy paragraphs to easily paste text to apps that don't support sharing.
Biographies - Clickable names of notable persons; overlay window displays persons short biography.
Sanskrit Shlok Explanations - Clickable Sanskrit Shloks; overlay explains the meaning of each word. Clear and structured explanation of its meaning, with scriptural references.
Dictionary - Clickable difficult words; overlay window displays simple definitions of regional, scriptural and philosophical words.
Reading Plans - Let us guide you through the various spiritual concepts discussed in the revelations of Bhagwan Swaminarayan; reflect on what you have read and how you can apply it to your life.
Search - Search for any word in any language to get results of where this word appears, clicking on the desired result takes you to reading mode.

bluejetty:00033029:ios.description:
Know what you eat. Track what you improve.
Processed is your AI-powered food scanner and food diary, designed to help you cut back on ultra-processed foods and build healthier habits with every scan.
Your AI food detective
Get instant clarity on what you’re eating. Processed breaks down ingredients and classifies foods as ultra-processed, processed, minimally processed, or whole food using the NOVA classification system and advanced AI analysis.
Scan, detect, avoid
Whether you’re scanning a barcode or snapping a handwritten label, Processed analyzes it instantly to show how processed it really is. Just point, capture, and get the facts.
Just take a photo of your meal
You don’t need a barcode. Snap a photo of your meal and Processed will analyze the ingredients and processing level. Add it directly to your food diary in seconds.
Food Diary to stay accountable
Track your ultra-processed intake daily. Set reduction goals, monitor trends over time, and reflect on your progress without counting calories. Your diary helps you stay intentional about what you eat and how it affects you.
Your scan history, always available
Every scan is saved automatically with the product image, ingredients, processing level, and time of scan. Easily revisit what you’ve eaten and track patterns over time.
Database that learns with you
Our global food database grows with every scan. It becomes smarter and more accurate the more you use it, helping you make better choices, everywhere.
Have feedback or questions?
Reach out at hello@processedapp.com
If you’re enjoying the app, we’d love your review.
Learn more at processedapp.com
Disclaimer
This app is for educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for medical advice. Classifications are based on the NOVA framework and AI analysis. Always consult a qualified professional when making dietary decisions.

bluejetty:00165141:ios.description:
An All-New Official UNO Game!
All aboard this thrilling cruise adventure in UNO Wonder! Enjoy classic UNO with exciting new twists along an unforgettable journey. This is your ticket to adventure!
PLAY OFFICIAL UNO
Play the authentic UNO you know and love—now with a wondrous twist! Challenge opponents with Reverses, stack up Draw 2s, and race to call "UNO!" first. The classic card game that's brought families together for generations, now in your pocket!
DISCOVER BREAKING NEW RULES
Experience UNO like never before with 9 revolutionary new action cards that change the game! WILD SKIP ALL lets you play again instantly, while NUMBER TORNADO clears all number cards. Fresh strategy in every match!
TRAVEL THE WORLD
Embark on a luxurious global cruise across 14 spectacular routes, visit iconic landmarks, and make new friends along the way. Unlock hundreds of vibrant cities, such as Barcelona, Florence, Rome, Santorini, and Monte Carlo! Each destination tells a unique story. Explore the wonders of the world right at your fingertips!
COLLECT FUN STICKERS
Show off your journey with beautifully designed stickers from every destination! Complete sets to unlock exclusive rewards and showcase your achievements. 
CRUSH EPIC BOSSES
Playing UNO has never been more thrilling! Conquer over 3,000 levels and put your skills to the test against big bad bosses that block your way in your adventure. Use your mastery of UNO to pave the way for victory!
PLAY ANYWHERE, ANYTIME
UNO Wonder is perfect for solo play at home or anywhere else! No Wi-Fi? No problem! Play at your own pace, and put UNO Wonder on pause whenever you like! Take it easy and play UNO your way!
Start a fresh adventure in UNO Wonder! Set sail for new wonders today!
Join our community to meet other players and chat about UNO Wonder! Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/UNOWonder
Love UNO Wonder? Try UNO! Mobile for an even more exciting multiplayer experience!

A BETTER EVERYDAY CALCULATOR
As a kid, I loved playing with a calculator. Somewhere along the way, the calculator became another boring tool. I want a calculator that reignites that same sense of wonder.
SHOW YOUR WORK
One of the biggest obstacles with most calculator apps is just how easy it is to make mistakes. If you mistype a number and don't catch it immediately, you can easily end up with the wrong answer and never know it.
To fix this, we do what everyone is taught to do in elementary school… we show your work. As you type, the full equation is written out for you—every number and operator. Even better, if you make a mistake, you can now delete or select the number and retype it. Small, but life-changing.

Next generation user interface designed and built in 3D with animation and sounds inspired by video games.

bluejetty:00017295:ios.name: Tonk Online Card Game (Tunk)
bluejetty:00017295:ios.summary:
Tonk or Tunk can be refreshing to those who have grown bored with playing other card games. Tonk card game is a challenging and fun game for everyone
It is a quick game with relatively straightforward rules.
Its objective is to eliminate
bluejetty:00017295:ios.description:
Tonk or Tunk can be refreshing to those who have grown bored with playing other card games. Tonk card game is a challenging and fun game for everyone
It is a quick game with relatively straightforward rules.
Its objective is to eliminate your cards by forming them into ‘spreads’, meaning either 3 or 4 identical cards, or 3 or more sequentially in the same suit. During the game a player may add to their own spread, or an opponent’s spread. Play ends when a player has no cards left.
Tonk is a matching card game. It is relatively a fast paced game that can be played by 2-3 players.
Deal five cards, clockwise, to each player. Face cards count for 10 points, aces for 1, and the rest are at face value. After all hands have been dealt, the next card is played face-up, in the center of the table, to start the discard pile. Remaining cards are placed next to the discard pile, to form the "stock." 
Play this exciting game of tonk with your friends and become the master of Tonk!
Tonk players need a good memory and a knack for well-timed aggression. A good players memory can serve them well. You never want to help your opponent.
The first and fastest way to win Tonk is to Drop, Drop it like it’s hot!!! But don’t get caught!
Enrich your knowledge on Tonk.
Just remember to be always quick, because this game DOES reward quick reactions.
Play this timeless classic card game anytime anywhere! With your friends or against real peoples from anywhere in the world. It’s a popular pastime.
Try TONK today!!
**** Tonk Features ****
* Play with Friends or as Guest 
* Lucky Draw - Spin and Win Coins
* Create Private Room and Invite Friends and Family
* Play your way to top the Leaderboards!
* Tons of Achievements!
* Play with players across the world
* 2 & 3 Player Mode Options
* All time classic family tonk game
Having any problems? Any suggestions? We always love to hear from you and making this Tonk game better.
We would be very grateful for any feedback!
Enjoy Tonk!

bluejetty:00138100:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of electronics retail with Electronics Store Simulator! Embark on a thrilling journey as you transform a simple building into the ultimate haven for tech enthusiasts. Cruise around the city streets in your own car and see what it has to offer.
But that's just the tip of the iceberg! Dive into the world of supply and demand as you order a diverse range of electronic products, from drones and laptops to smartphones and speakers. Keep your finger on the pulse of technology trends, stocking up on the hottest items and managing inventory to meet customer demand.
Speaking of customers, get ready to provide top-notch service as you cater to the needs of tech enthusiasts and casual shoppers alike - customer satisfaction is key to building a loyal clientele.
As your store grows, so too do your opportunities. Expand your footprint with store upgrades and expansions, from adding new floors to investing in state-of-the-art equipment. Stay ahead of the competition by acquiring licenses for exclusive products, ensuring your store remains the go-to destination for all things tech.
But it's not all smooth sailing in the world of electronics retail. You'll face challenges ranging from inventory shortages to unexpected drops in demand for certain products. Adaptability is key as you adjust your strategies on the fly to keep your store profitable and thriving.
With stunning 3D graphics and immersive gameplay, Electronics Store Simulator puts you in the driver's seat of your own electronic empire. Dive into the action and demonstrate your prowess in running the ultimate electronics emporium!
IGRS rating: 13+

Throughout its history, humanity has been attracted to supernatural things. One of those paranormal things is Yeti – a mythical creature from snowy mountains. From the earliest of times we are attempting to catch the giant monster and prove he exists. Now, this has become possible with the help of artificial intelligence!
Bigfoot Monster is the newest extreme naturalist game, where you are a brave scout whose goal is to track and catch a Bigfoot in winter landscapes! He is an intelligent being and knows how to hide from you quickly. But don't give up! Don’t worry, you are not alone on this quest! A dog buddy will help you follow the Yeti and catch it.
Are you ready to challenge yourself and get a breathtaking experience? Immerse yourself into a thrilling wildlife adventure, where you will meet face-to-face the monster giant and get to catch it. Grab your tranquilizer gun and get on your way to Yeti chasing!
But that’s not all. With premium you will receive the best experience the game has to offer!

- New companions: AI-powered helper drones, which will track Yeti among the woods;
- And, most importantly, completely new sceneries, which will become a breath of fresh air after the icy snow peaks.
Hurry up, your time is limited! You have to act really smart and always remember that in any moment you may become a prey!
Privacy policy: https://impulsoryapps.com/privacy

bluejetty:00123857:ios.name: DRAGON QUEST III
bluejetty:00123857:ios.summary:
DRAGON QUEST III: The Seeds of Salvation—one of the most highly acclaimed and best-selling games in the franchise is finally here for mobile! Now all three instalments of the Erdrick Trilogy can be played in the palm of your hand!
Every wo
bluejetty:00123857:ios.description:
DRAGON QUEST III: The Seeds of Salvation—one of the most highly acclaimed and best-selling games in the franchise is finally here for mobile! Now all three instalments of the Erdrick Trilogy can be played in the palm of your hand!
Every wondrous weapon, spectacular spell and awesome adversary in this rich fantasy world is yours to discover in a single standalone package. Download it once, and there’s nothing else to buy, and nothing else to download!
DRAGON QUEST III: The Seeds of Salvation has an independent storyline and can be enjoyed without playing DRAGON QUEST I or DRAGON QUEST II. 
※In-game text is available in English only.
◆ Prologue
On the morning of their sixteenth birthday, the child of Ortega, hero of the land of Aliahan, is charged with a seemingly impossible task by the King himself: to slay the Archfiend Baramos, master of darkness!
What trials await our intrepid hero as they set out to take on a quest not even their legendary father was strong enough to complete?
◆Game Features
・Freely Customisable Party System.
Set out on an unforgettable adventure with a party of up to four characters who can be customised to your exact specifications at Patty’s Party Planning Place! Choose names, genders and jobs, and put together the team of your dreams!
・Freely Changeable Vocations
Your party members can be assigned any one of up to 9 vocations, a choice which will dictate their stats, equipment, spells and abilities.
Though the hero’s role has been decided by fate, the jobs of all the other characters are yours to change as you see fit.
Characters who change jobs will be returned to Level 1 and have their attributes halved, but they will retain all the spells and abilities they’ve learned, allowing you to tailor your team to perfectly suit your needs.
Turn a priest into a warrior to add healing abilities to your swordsman’s arsenal, or mix it up any other way you like! The possibilities are endless!
・Experience an epic RPG experience with over 30 hours of gameplay with added features to the original release! 
Travel across multiple continents and dungeons as you level up your characters and unlock new spells and abilities. The personality system changes how your character grows making your party always unique. Mini-games like medal collecting to unlock powerful new items that were not available in the original release. Discover and explore bonus dungeons and location after completing the main plot. 
・Simple, Intuitive Controls
The game’s controls are designed to work perfectly with the vertical layout of any modern mobile device, and the position of the movement button can be changed to facilitate both one- and two-handed play.
・Experience the multi-million selling series, beloved both in Japan and beyond, and see how the masterful talents of series creator Yuji Horii first combined with the revolutionary synthesizer sounds of Koichi Sugiyama and the wildly popular manga illustrations of Akira Toriyama (Dragon Ball) to create a gaming sensation.
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 12.0 or higher

bluejetty:00073592:ios.description:
Calculate and track your Body Mass Index (BMI) with the most accurate and user-friendly BMI calculator app.
KEY FEATURES:
• Instant BMI calculation with animated visual gauge
• Personalized health insights and ideal weight recommendations
• Support for metric kg/cm, imperial lbs/ft, and British stones units
• Choice of WHO or DGE German Nutrition Society classification systems
• Age-specific calculations for children ages 7 and up, plus adults
• Gender-specific BMI evaluation for accurate results
• Color-coded BMI categories with real-time visual feedback
• Clean, intuitive interface with instant calculations
HEALTH BENEFITS:
• Monitor your weight loss or weight gain journey
• Understand health risks associated with your current BMI
• Set realistic goals for achieving your ideal weight
• Track progress toward a healthier lifestyle
• Early detection of weight-related health concerns
CLASSIFICATION SYSTEMS:
Choose between two professional BMI classification systems:
WHO - World Health Organization:
- Underweight: BMI below 18.5
- Normal weight: BMI 18.5-24.9
- Overweight: BMI 25-29.9
- Obese: BMI 30 and above
DGE - German Nutrition Society:
- Gender-specific BMI ranges
- Alternative classification for European standards
ADVANCED FEATURES:
• Visual BMI gauge with animated indicator
• Supports ages 7 and up with child-specific growth charts
• Settings persistence - remembers your preferences
• Works offline - no internet connection required
• Adults-only mode option available
IMPORTANT NOTE:
BMI is a screening tool that provides a general health indicator. It doesn't account for muscle mass, bone density, or body composition. Always consult healthcare professionals for personalized medical advice.
Questions or feedback? Contact us at info@appovo.com
