bluejetty:00096798:ios.description:
Prompt AI - AI Photo Maker is your ultimate companion for creating stunning AI-generated photos. Whether you are an artist, designer, or content creator, this app helps you find the perfect text prompts to use with popular AI image generators.
Explore thousands of high-quality, ready-made prompts designed for Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, and other AI tools. Every prompt comes with a sample preview image, so you can see the visual style before you create.
MAIN FEATURES
• Extensive Prompt Library
Access a massive collection of creative prompts optimized for AI photo generation.
• Sample Preview Images
View a pre-generated sample image for every prompt to understand the exact style, lighting, and composition.
• One-Tap Copy
Simply find a style you like and tap to copy the prompt instantly. Paste it into your preferred AI generator to create professional results.
• Save Favorites
Bookmark your favorite prompts to access them quickly whenever inspiration strikes.
• Daily Updates
Discover new creative ideas with fresh prompts added regularly.
CURATED CATEGORIES
Find the perfect style for your needs with our organized collections:
• Portrait & Editorial Photography
• Cinematic & Fantasy Art
• Vintage, Retro & Typography
• Festival Specials (Christmas, Diwali)
• Pre-Wedding & Couple Poses
• Neon, Aqua, & Inferno Styles
• Children’s Photography & Creative Concepts
TRENDING & TOP RATED
• Trending: See what prompts other creators are using right now.
• Top Rated: Explore the highest-quality prompts voted by the community.
• Random: Get unique and unexpected ideas to spark your creativity.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Browse through categories or the trending feed.
2. Check the preview image to see the visual style.
3. Tap the Copy button to get the text prompt.
4. Paste the text into any external AI image generator to create your artwork.
WHO IS THIS FOR?
• AI Artists looking for complex prompt structures.
• Social Media Creators needing unique content ideas.
• Photographers exploring new compositions.
• Anyone who wants to master AI photo generation.
Important Note:
Generated images are for personal use only. Users are responsible for ensuring their creations comply with copyright laws.
No login or account is required to use the app.

** Winner of App Store Best of 2014 **
YOU are about to PLAY GOD.
Rule over a living, breathing world. It is as SIMPLE to play with as it is AWE-INSPIRING to behold. Feel truly powerful in the most delightful, charming and tactile world you have ever held in your hands.
• Use your touch to physically shape, mold and sculpt every inch of the landscape, making it unique to you.
• Be loved and worshipped by tiny, devoted Followers. Watch them live, learn, and grow in a fully simulated world.
• Nurture the growth of a civilization as it rises from the dawn of the primitive age and advances throughout the ages of humanity. 
• Cast miracles of both beauty and destruction: sculpt rivers and grow forests, or throw meteors and spread fires.
• Uncover a wealth of mysteries and surprises waiting to be found above and below the landscape.
• Guide your Followers as they embark on regular voyages to new and uncharted lands that hold great rewards.
There has never been an experience quite like this before, and it will continue to evolve as you do. Come and lead an incredible journey that’s waiting for you to make it your own.
Godus is brought to you by legendary designer and inventor of the GOD GAME; Peter Molyneux. His previous acclaimed creations have been the original releases of Theme Park, Dungeon Keeper, Black & White, Fable, Theme Hospital, Syndicate, and Populous.
Get more out of Godus by visiting www.facebook.com/godusgame
Please note: A network connection is required to play.

bluejetty:00026573:ios.summary:

WHY YOGA-GO?
◉ Safe workouts at home
Enjoy home workouts designed with safety in mind. Low-intensity
bluejetty:00026573:ios.description:
Stay active with Yoga-Go’s gentle, low-intensity routines, featuring yoga, Tai Chi, Pilates, stretching, and more—all easy to do at home.
WHY YOGA-GO?
◉ Safe workouts at home
Enjoy home workouts designed with safety in mind. Low-intensity routines ensure a gentle, effective way to stay active without strain or risk.
◉ 7—30 Minutes a day for wellbeing
Take care of your body and mind in just 7 to 30 minutes a day. Yoga-Go quick workouts help you build strength, improve flexibility, and reduce stress while fitting seamlessly into your daily routine
◉ 2000+ Low-intensity exercises
Access a vast library of over 2000 exercises, offering endless variety to keep your fitness journey engaging and effective.
◉ More than yoga
Explore a world of safe movement beyond yoga. Yoga-Go combines stretching, Pilates, meditation, breath work, Tai Chi, and more to create a well-rounded fitness experience tailored to your needs and goals.
◉ Guided workouts
Discover yoga poses for beginners with guided yoga workouts that fit your lifestyle. Yoga-Go offers a step-by-step yoga routine for beginners, helping you harness the power of simple daily movements to improve your health and well-being.
EXPLORE DIVERSE PRACTICES:
► SOMATIC YOGA
Somatic yoga blends gentle, mindful movement with somatic exercises to address physical and emotional well-being. Somatic movement means moving with body awareness, focusing on how you’re feeling, and not aiming to achieve a specific fitness goal.
► CHAIR YOGA
Chair yoga poses are designed to support flexibility and strength, making this practice perfect for those with mobility challenges or anyone seeking a gentle workout. Yoga-Go's guided chair yoga routines offer step-by-step instructions, making it ideal for beginners who want to build confidence while staying active.
► WALL PILATES 
Wall Pilates workouts are a fresh and effective way to add exercise to your routine. They offer all the benefits of classic Pilates for strength and toning your body while using the wall for extra support and balance.
► PILATES
This beginner-friendly Pilates plan was made for people just like you—new to movement, curious about feeling better, and ready to start. With clear instructions, supportive coaching, and simple props, each session helps you gently build strength, mobility, and posture—right from your living room.
► TAI CHI
Yoga-Go’s Tai Chi program introduces you to a gentle, slow-paced form of exercise and helps maximize its benefits, such as improved balance, flexibility, and strength. With guided Yoga-Go sessions, you’ll experience the calming benefits of Tai Chi while creating a deeper connection between your body and mind.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
- Download the app at no initial cost. Further use requires a subscription. A trial may be offered as indicated in the app.
- Subscription prices are shown in the app and charged to your Apple ID upon purchase confirmation.
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
- You can manage or cancel subscriptions anytime in your App Store account settings. When cancelled, access remains active until the end of the current period; no refunds are issued for unused time. 
- We may also offer optional add-ons (e.g., health guides) for an additional one-time or recurring fee. These are not required for your subscription.
Yoga-Go Privacy Policy: https://legal.yoga-go.io/page/privacy-policy 
Yoga-Go Terms of Use: https://legal.yoga-go.io/page/terms-of-use

Mobile Banking. Anytime, Anywhere. Start banking wherever you are 24/7 with the easy and secure Bank With United app! Available to all United Bank consumer online banking users. Using the Bank With United app, your mobile device and mobile wallet, you can access your information – conveniently, in the palm of your hand.
Manage Accounts 
• Access your accounts quickly with Face ID® 1 or Touch ID® 1
• Check your activity and balances
• Search recent transactions by date, amount or check number
• View mortgage, auto and personal loan information
Make Transfers and Payments
• Easily transfer cash between your accounts
• Use Zelle® 2 to safely send and receive money with friends and family 3
• Use bill pay for single one-time payments
• Add or edit bill pay payees
Personal Finance
• View all your accounts in one place
• Create budgets
• Track spending by category
• Set goals and plan for the future
Locations
• Find nearby branches and ATMs using your current location
• Search by address, city or zip code

You still get all the rewards, benefits and protection your United Debit Card and Credit Card already provide without having to reach for your wallet.
Have a business account with United Bank? Check out our Bank With United Business app available in the app store!

bluejetty:00039657:ios.description:
Meet Traini, the AI companion that helps you understand your dog better.
From everyday behavior and emotions to training and care, Traini brings together real-time AI, personalized guidance, and dog-focused intelligence to help you better understand the dog you know and love.
UNDERSTAND YOUR DOG IN REAL TIME
Open Live Camera to explore your dog’s body language and behavior in the context of what is happening around them. Traini helps you notice everyday signals and possible emotional context you might otherwise miss.
ASK PETGPT ABOUT YOUR DOG
Have a question about your dog’s behavior, training, routines, or everyday wellbeing? Ask PetGPT anytime. You can also share an image to receive AI-generated observations about visible details, along with general information and everyday care suggestions personalized to your dog.
GET PERSONALIZED TRAINING & GUIDANCE
Get training plans, step-by-step guidance, and practical recommendations personalized to your dog’s age, personality, behaviors, needs, and goals.
EXPLORE BARKS & EMOTIONS
Curious about what your dog may be trying to communicate? Record their barking with Dog Translator and explore AI-generated interpretations of possible intent and emotional context. Save meaningful moments and begin recognizing communication patterns over time.
BUILD YOUR DOG’S STORY
Turn everyday conversations, discoveries, and milestones into a personal dog diary. Remember training progress, behavior patterns, special moments, and the little things that make your dog unique—all in one place.

Turn any photo into a realistic AI dance video, pick a style, tap once, and watch it come to life. Make yourself, friends, kids, or even pets dance with smooth, natural AI motion. Perfect for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
HOW IT WORKS 
• Upload a photo of yourself, a friend, your kids, or your pet 
• Choose a dance style from a growing library of animations 
• Dance AI analyzes your photo and generates realistic motion frame by frame • Get a finished video in seconds, no filming, no choreography, no editing needed
WHY DANCE AI 
• Realistic motion, not a filter, true frame-by-frame animation, not a static overlay 
• Works with any photo, people, kids, and pets can all become dancers 
• A growing style library, new dance styles, templates, and effects added regularly, from playful moves to trending, viral, challenge-style dances 
• Every video exports ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
MORE THAN JUST DANCE 
Dance AI is also a flexible AI video generator, not only a dance tool. Animate any photo with general motion and visual effects, turn a text prompt into a short video, or apply creative filters and styles. Then, whenever you want the signature experience, turn that same photo into a dance video in seconds.
MADE FOR CREATORS 
Perfect for TikTok and Reels creators, party hosts, meme-makers, pet owners, and anyone who wants to turn a photo into something fun, unexpected, and easy to share.

bluejetty:00093432:ios.description:
Explore the World in Real-Time with Live Earth Camera!
With Live Earth Camera, you get to watch public webcams from all around the world in a format that’s intuitive and easy to navigate. Browse the interactive 3D model of Earth, choose a camera from any location you like, and start watching!
Key Features Include:
- Global Map with Webcams - City streets, beaches, landmarks, and cityscapes - all yours to explore however you like!
- Popular Cams - Access the most viewed live streams from around the globe.
- Saved List - Bookmark all your favorite cams and access them easily anytime you need them.

Discover the world with a single tap!

You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.

bluejetty:00146046:ios.description:
Willow is here to help those without a green thumb, the serial-plant-killers, and the play-it safe cacti owners. We’re here to remove the guesswork and make plant care easy. 
Features:
PERSONALISED CARE ACTIONS
Willow gives you a simple, structured way to look after your plants, helping you understand how they’re doing, what they need, and what to do next.
Regular Plant Check-ins help you spot changes and provide practical guidance based on what you observe. Willow will remind you when it’s time to check again.
Our Watering Cycle guides you through checking soil moisture, deciding when to water and evaluating how well you’ve watered. Light Assessments help you understand whether your plants are getting enough or too much light in their current location.
Tailored care tasks and reminders help you stay on top of each plant’s needs.
Please note, we’re introducing this to new users first.
Already using Willow? Your current plant care experience will stay the same for now. We’re working on a guided introduction to the new features and will release in a future update.
PLANT IDENTIFICATION
Plants can look alike and even share the same name. Simply take a photo and our smart engine will automatically identify your plant! 
PLANT CARE GUIDES
Our plant library includes easy to digest care instructions for hundreds of houseplants and is growing all the time. You can discover new plants and identify which plants are best suited to your conditions. You can even request plants be added to our database. 
COLLECT URBAN JUNGLES
Create personal profiles for your plants and organise them in a virtual urban jungle. Perfect if you have many to look after! Here you can add notes, photos, and track and record events to journal each plant’s journey. 
FERTILISER SCHEDULE
A schedule is auto-populated for any plants added to your collection so you know when and how to best fertilise your plants all year-round. Choose between liquid or slow release fertiliser. 
BLOGS & TUTORIALS
Enjoy the latest from our blog and fun tutorials that show you how to take better care of your plants, grow new plants and even propagate some of your faves!
WILLOW SENSORS
Our beautifully crafted plant sensors continuously monitor your plant’s soil moisture, ambient light, temperature and humidity and will alert you when an action is required to keep your plant happy. And of course a plant score to truly let you know how your plant is feeling. 
WILLOW GROW is an optional paid experience packed with features a-planty to level up your plant care:
PLANT DATA
Unbarred access to your Willow sensor. Take a deep dive and explore your data (light, soil moisture, temperature and humidity) and plant score over the past 30 days including daily analysis and comparisons to other Willow users.
PLANT DOCTOR
Consult our team of horticulturists for expert advice. Chat anything from general plant advice, treatment advice related to pests and diseases, propagation, plant pairings or plants just right for you etc. 
DISEASE ID
Take a photo and our smart engine will identify what is ailing your plant. The symptoms, prevention and treatment advice can be saved to your plant. 
PLANT MATCHER
Get matched with plants that suit you best in our quiz and/or have Best For You analyse your sensor data to recommend the plants best for your space
Download Willow and get started today. 
JOIN THE WILLOW COMMUNITY
https://www.facebook.com/plantwithwillowau
https://www.instagram.com/plantwithwillowau/
https://www.tiktok.com/@plantwithwillowau
REACH OUT
Burning questions that need answers?
Reach out, hello@plantwithwillow.com.au 
OUR TERMS
https://plantwithwillow.com.au/policies/terms-of-service
https://plantwithwillow.com.au/policies/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00013716:ios.description:
Bookshelf helps you track your books, build a lasting reading habit, and better remember what you read—now with powerful AI-powered discovery tools to help you find your next great read!
Add books you’ve read, books you’re reading, and books you want to read. Improve your reading habits with insightful stats and trend reports. Stay motivated with reading goals, streaks, and reminders. Remember what you read by writing and reviewing notes and quotes.
BUILD YOUR LIBRARY
• Import & Sync – Import your existing libraries from Goodreads, Kindle, StoryGraph, or Reading List with a tap.
• Quick Add – Build your library by searching millions of books, scanning any book's barcode, or adding your own.
• Book Recommendations* – Discover trending books, find books based on your mood or any prompt, and browse curated collections to find your next read.
• Everything Tracker – Easily manage book collections, reading status, star ratings, reading dates, and more for all your books.
• Reading Sessions* – Pick up a book, start a session, and we’ll track everything so you can focus on reading.
IMPROVE YOUR READING HABITS
• Book Chat – Chat with our AI librarian to generate summaries and flash cards, discuss key ideas, and much more!
• Reading Stats – Visualize your reading habits over time with charts and reading stats.
• Reading Goals – Create a reading goal for the year to motivate yourself to read more or challenge your friends!
• Estimated Completion Time – See how long it will take to finish any book with your average reading speed.
• Reading Streaks* – Stay motivated by keeping up your streak!
REMEMBER WHAT YOU READ
• Smart Notes* – Use cards to jot down notes or vocab, write a summary, or prepare study questions. Scan text directly from books or add rich text of your own.
• Knowledge Quizzes* – Spaced-repetition quizzes on your note cards that will significantly increase your retention, guaranteed.
• Reading Reminders* – Never forget to read or test your knowledge with timely notifications.
OTHER FEATURES
• Cloud Sync* & Daily Backups – Sync between your iOS devices so your library is always up-to-date, or restore from previous backups.
• App Icons – Make Bookshelf your own with beautiful custom home-screen icons.
• Library Export* – Never fear losing your books or notes with CSV library exports.
• Dark Mode – Beautiful during the day, gorgeous and eye-saving at night.
*Some features require Bookshelf Gold for access or unlimited use
Gold Lifetime charges your Apple ID once for permanent Gold status. Gold Yearly charges your Apple ID for 12 months of Gold status after a 7-day free trial unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial ends. Gold Monthly charges your Apple ID for 1 month of Gold status on purchase confirmation.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime in your iTunes account settings. For more information, see our Terms and Conditions at bit.ly/2NNm93Z and Privacy Policy at bit.ly/31Mad8s.

Transform Your Streaming Experience with MySTB! 
Discover the ultimate IPTV player that brings all your favorite content together in one place. - Seamless Multi-Source Support: Stream content from Stalker-based providers (Mac address), Xtream (Username and Password) and M3U playlists effortlessly.

- Modern, Intuitive UI: Navigate with ease using a sleek and user-friendly interface. 
- Favorites & Recent Watching: Quickly access your favorite channels and pick up where you left off. 
- External Player Support: Play your streams in popular apps like VLC for a customized viewing experience. 
- Multi-Provider Compatibility: Manage and switch between multiple IPTV providers with ease. 
- Customizable Themes: Personalize the app with various themes and layout options. 
- Secure & Private: Your data and viewing habits stay private and protected. 
- Autoplay next videos so you can keep watching without interruption
Note: This app does not provide any content. You must add your own IPTV subscription, and you are responsible for the type of content you stream. This app is equivalent to a media player. You are fully responsible for any content you might add in this app

bluejetty:00141712:ios.description:
START YOUR HOTEL BUSINESS NOW!
Ever dreamed of owning a hotel empire? My Dream Hotel brings your hospitality fantasies to life! Manage your hotel from humble beginnings to luxurious resorts, offering world-class service and building an accommodation empire. With strategic time-management gameplay, you'll rise through the ranks, upgrade your properties, and become the ultimate hotel tycoon. Can you handle the hustle and keep your guests happy?
START FROM THE BOTTOM, REACH THE TOP 
* Grow Your Hotel: Begin your journey as a simple hotel manager, taking care of every detail from greeting guests to cleaning rooms. As your business grows, unlock new rooms, facilities, and staff to keep your hotel running smoothly. Your guests may relax in comfort, but there’s no time to rest for a hotel mogul!
* Expand to New Locations: Open new hotels in beautiful locations, from sunny beaches to serene mountain retreats. Customize each hotel to match its unique vibe and attract guests from all around the world. Show off your management skills and grow your empire to become a true hotel tycoon.
* Hire and Train Staff: As your hotel grows, you’ll need a skilled team. Hire and train staff to provide exceptional service, manage facilities, and keep guests satisfied. Speed up your operations and increase revenue with a motivated team that’s ready to handle the busiest days.
* Maximize Profits: Enhance your hotels by adding premium amenities like pools, spas, restaurants, and vending machines. Boost guest satisfaction and earn more money to reinvest into your growing empire. But be careful—each upgrade requires staffing, so hire wisely!
* Customize Your Rooms: As a hotel manager, you’re also an interior designer! Upgrade and decorate your rooms to create a unique and luxurious experience for your guests. Your design choices can make all the difference in attracting high-paying visitors!
ENDLESS FUN, ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES
Ready for a fun and engaging hotel management adventure? My Dream Hotel offers a fast-paced, casual gaming experience that will keep you hooked for hours. Build, manage, and upgrade your hotel empire in this addictive time-management simulator.
Download My Dream Hotel now and begin your journey to becoming a hospitality mogul!

2. Perfect jump gives higher score and gold reward.
3. Use your gold to unlock more skins.

bluejetty:00123110:ios.name: Reliant Community Credit Union
bluejetty:00123110:ios.summary: Reliant Community Credit Union’s mobile banking app lets you take Reliant’s member-focused banking services with you, no matter where you go—it’s like being able to visit your neighborhood branch anywhere, anytime! When you’re on-the-go, y
bluejetty:00123110:ios.description:
Reliant Community Credit Union’s mobile banking app lets you take Reliant’s member-focused banking services with you, no matter where you go—it’s like being able to visit your neighborhood branch anywhere, anytime! When you’re on-the-go, you can check your available balances, view account activity, pay bills, deposit checks, make transfers between your accounts and to other Reliant members, and find the closest Reliant branch, Reliant ATM, or surcharge-free ATM—all for FREE!*
*Please note: Your mobile carrier's message and data rates may apply.
Account Balances and Activity
Reliant’s mobile banking app gives you immediate access to your eligible personal accounts any time of day, giving you peace of mind that you can quickly check your balance or verify that a recent transaction has posted to your account. 
Paying Bills, Transferring Funds Modernized and so much more! 
Don't panic the next time you realize that you have a bill due, but you're not at home to write a check or sign onto your computer. If you use Reliant’s online and bill pay services, your payees will automatically be available through our mobile banking app. All you have to do is launch the app, schedule your payment, submit—and then go on with your day! And with our transfer feature, not only can you transfer money between your own accounts, but you can also transfer money to your friend, your babysitter, or your hairdresser—all you need is the person’s e-mail address or mobile phone number.
ATM Locator
When you’re out and about, use Reliant’s mobile app to find a nearby Reliant ATM. Locate an ATM using your current location or enter the zip code or address of the area you wish to search.
Notifications for Peace of Mind
Sign up to receive Notifications via email or text message when your account balance has fallen below or risen above a dollar threshold you determine. This instant notification, coupled with your ability to then view your account information, will give you peace of mind about your account—and it will allow you to monitor your finances, no matter where you are or what time it is.
Online Security 
Your security is our priority. Mobile data transmissions are safeguarded by 128-bit SSL (Secure Socket Layer) to prevent unauthorized access. We also provide an automatic inactivity lockout feature should you ever leave your phone unattended while in your account. We'll never transmit your account number information, and no private data is ever stored on your phone. 
To learn how we protect your privacy, please visit https://www.reliantcu.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00180432:ios.summary: Captello™ is the industry's first fully-integrated mobile lead capture tool. Captello™ syncs directly to all leading CRM and Marketing Automation Platforms so you can begin nurturing your new prospects before you even leave the trade show f
bluejetty:00180432:ios.description:
Captello™ is the industry's first fully-integrated mobile lead capture tool. Captello™ syncs directly to all leading CRM and Marketing Automation Platforms so you can begin nurturing your new prospects before you even leave the trade show floor. This app is perfect to use for outside sales prospecting, trade shows, seminars, conferences, and more. Best of all, Captello™ can work offline, no internet at your event, no problem!
Automatic Nurture
When you capture a new lead in Captello™, leads can be sent to your CRM or Marketing Automation Platform. From there, you can automatically begin nurturing your leads. Distribute the lead, segment them into a marketing list, and then begin sending them relevant content without having to do anything manually. 
Live Form Capture 
Using a form built to your marketer's specifications, sales teams can capture lead details on the go while your marketing team gets valuable qualified leads instantly.
Business Card Transcription
Don't want to slow down manually entering forms on a busy floor? Simply take a picture of the prospect's business card and we’ll transcribe it for you.
Kiosk Mode
If you want to give prospects who don't have time to stop and converse, set up a form in Kiosk Mode. While in Kiosk Mode, GoCapture™ will lock itself down with a password and reload the form after every submission. 
List Import: Import trade show attendees ahead of time. At the show, simply search for their name and you're done!
Badge Scanning: Scan the attendee's badge to capture data fast.

bluejetty:00168520:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed of creating your ideal avatar town? Come to the Pregnant World Simulator for baby girls, you can experience different professions, create unique citizens, such as a pregnant princess who cares for her baby, a doctor who runs a hospital or clinic, girls living in the doll dream house, and even establish the rules of the whole town! You can create a hospital or a clinic, play as a doctor or a pregnant mother, or you can stay at home play with dolls, listen to the asmr sounds and get relaxed. Our game has no limitations, allowing you to create a virtual town life according to your wishes, and build your perfect world!
Features:
- Explore each dream house in the avatar town, just like experiencing real life.
- Police Station: Drive a police car, play the role of a police officer, and protect the safety of the town and guard his baby.
- Hospital/Clinic: Diagnose and care for the patients as the doctors and nurses, or be pregnant princess or sick girls.
- Fire Station: Become an outstanding firefighter and extinguish the fire bravely, fight for his beloved princess.
- You can experience 20+ different professions and create unique characters in the Pregnancy World Simulator.
How to play:
- Select a dream house on the avatar town map and begin immersive exploration.
- Create your characters or choose the existing dolls. You can craft an amazing storyline.
- Try clicking and dragging items inside the home. Some surprises wait for you.
- Real life sound! Experience the ASMR at home!
Let's play the ASMR Baby Care World Simulator NOW!

bluejetty:00147231:ios.name: Aspire: Calorie Counter & Diet
bluejetty:00147231:ios.summary: Aspire is the all-in-one health tracker that helps you lose weight and build healthier habits—without juggling multiple apps. Track your food, calories, macros, water, steps, workouts, and intermittent fasting in one simple place so you can
bluejetty:00147231:ios.description:
Aspire is the all-in-one health tracker that helps you lose weight and build healthier habits—without juggling multiple apps. Track your food, calories, macros, water, steps, workouts, and intermittent fasting in one simple place so you can stay consistent and make smarter choices every day.
FOOD + MACRO TRACKER
Log your meals fast and instantly see calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Set custom daily goals that fit your lifestyle (weight loss, maintenance, low-carb, keto, paleo, and more).
SMART NUTRITION INSIGHTS (NOT JUST CALORIES)
See a nutrition score inspired by the Nutri-Score standard, spot highly processed foods, and identify additives in many packaged foods—so you can choose foods with higher nutritional value.
WATER TRACKER + REMINDERS
Stay hydrated with quick water logging and helpful reminders throughout the day.
STEP TRACKER (AUTO SYNC)
Connect with Apple HealthKit or Fitbit to automatically track your daily steps. Get reminders to move and stay on top of your daily activity goal.
WORKOUT TRACKER
Track workouts and estimated calories burned to support your nutrition plan and improve overall fitness.
INTERMITTENT FASTING TIMER
Set your fasting target, track fasting hours, view fasting stages, and get notified when your fast ends.
Aspire is more than a calorie counter—it’s a complete daily tracker designed to keep you motivated, informed, and on track. We listen to feedback and regularly update the app to improve your experience.
Data Sources:
• Dietary Recommendations: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) guidelines
• Food Nutrition Scores: Nutri-score system (slightly adapted)
Support: support@aspire.world
Privacy Policy: https://www.aspire.world/privacy
Terms of Service: https://www.aspire.world/terms

Positive accompanies you on your way to reach your goals and supports you in your difficult times!
Psychological researches show that the words and thoughts we say to ourselves throughout the day change the way we live our lives and how we view the challenges we face. Focusing on positive thoughts has a positive impact on our perspective and the flow of our lives. What you read in Positive are carefully selected phrases for this purpose.

Read thousands of quotes. Get new ideas on any topic, anytime.
There are motivational sayings and quotes from philosophers, world leaders and celebrities. You can also find affirmations on many different topics in Positive. Choose the category you want to read and let the sentences change your perspective.

If you want to start your day with a reminder, we can send you a sentence selected for you from the category you choose at the time you specify. Maybe this phrase is a sign for you?

bluejetty:00070085:ios.summary:
Flip two cards. Remember what you saw. Clear the board — then keep going, because the board is only the beginning.
Twinvale is the card-matching game you already know, rebuilt into a full adventure. Explore a hand-painted town, climb 60 le
bluejetty:00070085:ios.description:
Flip two cards. Remember what you saw. Clear the board — then keep going, because the board is only the beginning.
Twinvale is the card-matching game you already know, rebuilt into a full adventure. Explore a hand-painted town, climb 60 levels across 9 chapters, beat the bosses guarding each one, and come back wearing the gear they drop.
A WORLD, NOT A MENU
Your home screen is a painted map. The castle holds the campaign, the arena holds the Challenges, the gear shop sells what you have not earned yet, and the trailhead leads out to Expedition. New buildings open as you play.
SIX WAYS TO PLAY
- Levels — 60 boards across 9 chapters, with hazards, mini-bosses and bosses
- Challenges — 24 boards in four families: Precision, Target Trail, Hot Streak and Limited Looks
- Expedition — an endless run with three lives, escalating modifiers and camp supplies
- Blitz — one clock, as many boards as you can clear
- Daily Journey — a new board every day, the same board for everyone, on a seven-day calendar
- Zen — no clock, no fail state, no systems. Just cards.
GEAR THAT CHANGES THE BOARD
Beat a boss, take its gear. Five slots — weapon, boots, armor, hat and orb — filled from 42 pieces, and each one changes how a board opens rather than how it looks: a free look at a card, seconds back on your first matches, mistake shields banked before the first flip, a wider step budget.
ELEMENT FUSION
Special Pairs drop Water, Fire, Wood, Light and Dark into a three-slot tray. Two ingredients make a fusion, three make an Overcharge, and three of a kind make a Perfect Resonance. Three Dark makes an Eclipse that clears the stage outright — at the cost of everything still unmatched on it.
COLLECT, COMPETE, COMPLETE
- 72 cosmetics — card backs, card faces, board backgrounds and icon packs across five rarity tiers. Legendaries carry their own animation and their own sounds
- A Diamond Shop for cosmetics and power-up bundles. Earn diamonds by playing, or pick up a pack when you want something sooner
- 62 trophies and 5 Game Center leaderboards: total stars, boards cleared, Expedition depth, Blitz depth and longest chain
- A 28-day Daily Ritual that pays out in cosmetics
- Nine seasonal events through the year
- A second playthrough that re-tunes every board once you finish the first
BUILT TO BE PLAYED ANYWHERE
No connection needed — every mode works offline. Sized for both iPhone and iPad. Card states and actions are labelled for VoiceOver, controls keep a large tap target, and a Reduced Motion setting replaces every animation with a still frame without changing a single rule.
Play in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, French or Spanish.
Free to play, with optional diamond packs and a one-time Remove Ads purchase. Whether you have one minute or a whole evening, every match still lands.

bluejetty:00129327:ios.name: Bullet Hell Monday Finale
bluejetty:00129327:ios.summary:
Bullet Hell Monday Finale is a bullet hell shooter game that’s great fun for beginners too. Avoid the bullets and shoot enemies. Upgrade your craft and aim to clear the Chapter Mode.
■ Chapter Mode
Various missions await you in each stage
bluejetty:00129327:ios.description:
Bullet Hell Monday Finale is a bullet hell shooter game that’s great fun for beginners too. Avoid the bullets and shoot enemies. Upgrade your craft and aim to clear the Chapter Mode.
■ Chapter Mode
Various missions await you in each stage -- from simple to challenging ones. Clearing missions like “Defeat 30 enemies!” unlocks a boss stage. Defeat the boss to proceed to the next chapter.
■ Strengthen your craft
There are many level up options to strengthen your craft: shot power, shot speed, bomb duration, and more. Upgrade your craft and blast through the stages.
■ Great for beginners
Stages start off easy and gradually get more and more intense. You have no obligation to clear the difficult missions. If you get stuck, try your hand at another mission.
■ Simple controls
Use swipe gestures to move and attack, and tap with your other hand to launch bombs. These are the only skills available to you when you first start.
As you progress through the game, you will gradually unlock new abilities.
■ Easy mode
In Chapter Mode, you select the difficulty before starting a stage. Selecting Easy makes enemy attacks less intense and makes it easier to beat the stage. If you get stuck on a stage, try selecting Easy.
■ Twitter
https://twitter.com/dot_decluster
■ Official site
https://bullethellmonday-finale.storeinfo.jp
* The app is free to download.
* There is some paid content available via in-app purchases, but it can be unlocked with in-game points.
* Contains video ads. Watching these videos gives you more in-game points.

• Car and home repairs

• Unexpected expenses

bluejetty:00137482:ios.description:

bluejetty:00114486:ios.description:
Revel builds and operates fast charging stations in the hardest-to-build areas to make electric adoption easier for everyone.
Use the Revel Charging app to find, pay for, and manage your EV charging — all in one place.
Download the Revel Charging app to:
FIND FAST EV CHARGER STATIONS
 • Discover real-time charger availability on the map and get directions to any Revel charging site.
PLUG INTO CONNECTORS THAT FIT YOUR EV

CHARGE AT THE MOST AFFORDABLE TIME

TRACK LIVE CHARGING PROGRESS

UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE DISCOUNTS
 • Automatically redeem perks and charging discounts for qualifying vehicles and fleets.
VIEW CHARGING HISTORY
 • Access past sessions and download receipts anytime.
REACH SUPPORT FASTER
 • Use in-app chat to find quick help articles or contact support — so you can get back on the road faster.
For assistance or to learn more, visit https://gorevel.com/

bluejetty:00119169:ios.summary: Buy gold and silver quickly and securely with the APMEX mobile app. APMEX is one of the world's leading retailers in gold, silver, platinum, and palladium. Quickly review the latest precious metals news and stay up to date on the current go
bluejetty:00119169:ios.description:
Buy gold and silver quickly and securely with the APMEX mobile app. APMEX is one of the world's leading retailers in gold, silver, platinum, and palladium. Quickly review the latest precious metals news and stay up to date on the current gold price or silver price with live spot charts. Set up custom market alerts to track the price of gold and silver. Then, shop our wide selection of bullion and collectible products and purchase directly on the app. APMEX offers thousands of gold, silver, platinum, and palladium products, including coins and bars in various sizes, from the most trusted mints around the world. 
SHOP GOLD AND SILVER 
Buy precious metals from anywhere through our easy-to-navigate mobile app. Browse our entire catalog, including thousands of gold, silver, platinum, and palladium products as well as investment-grade bullion and rare collectible coins. 
SECURE CHECKOUT 
Providing a secure and quick checkout process is our top priority. We use the latest security measures and technologies to keep our customers' purchases and personal information safe. 
STAY INFORMED 
The market is always on the move and, with our precious metals news section, customers will be able to keep up to date with the latest precious metals news and market reports. Also, track the price of gold and silver with our live spot price charts to see real-time changes in the price of precious metals. 
PRICE ALERTS 
Never miss a significant gold or silver price movement with customizable market alerts. Use alerts and price charts to identify potential buying opportunities at any time. 
EXCLUSIVE OFFERS 
View current promotions and deals, including app-only offers, to never miss a sale. Browse Vault Deals to shop our best offers on gold, silver, platinum, and palladium. 
MANAGE ACCOUNT 
Our mobile app gives customers access to their APMEX account on the go. Check the current value of individual precious metals holdings with our portfolio tool, view order history, and more.

Our keyboard offers over 60 unique fonts, is easy to use, and stands out from other keyboards by focusing solely on what matters - an easy and personalized user experience. Optimized for iOS 26.
EXPRESS YOUR UNIQUE STYLE
This easy-to-use font keyboard lets you elevate your expression through a vast font library, Kaomojis, and a pasteboard that puts your favorite snippets at your fingertips. With Fonts Pro, creativity is in your hands.
SMART SPELL CORRECTION
Our intelligent spell checker works seamlessly with all fonts, even the fancy ones. Type naturally and let Fonts Pro correct your spelling while keeping your unique style intact.
KAOMOJI PICKER
Express yourself with hundreds of Japanese emoticons. From kawaii to cool, find the perfect kaomoji for every mood. (^_^)
EASY TO USE
Enjoy lightning-fast and sleek performance with Fonts Pro's intuitive and simple UI. This app is the perfect tool for anyone who wants to add some extra flair to their typing habits.
WORKS IN ANY APP
Fonts Pro works on Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram, TikTok, Roblox, Twitch, Discord, and every other iOS App.
60+ FONTS, AND MANY MORE COMING
Choose from a wide range of font options including bold, italic, gothic, and many more. Fonts Pro makes it easy to customize your messaging, social media posts, and other content with an innovative toolbar that puts you in control.
• Bold
• Italic
• Typewriter
• Gothic
• Hollow
• Circles
• Squares
• and many more!
SYMBOLS AND KAOMOJIS
Discover a wide range of symbols to express yourself in new and creative ways. Add some personality to your messages with our vast library of Kaomojis and Emoticons.
COPY AND PASTE TEXT SNIPPETS
Save your favorite snippets easily with Fonts Pro. Access your snippets quickly from Fonts Pro Keyboard.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS
Our subscription feature unlocks a world of possibilities. With a subscription, you gain access to exclusive content and features, including new fonts, symbols, and Kaomojis.
All your personal data is protected with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://pixdeo.com/fonts-pro-privacy/
We hope you find Fonts Pro enjoyable!

bluejetty:00119521:ios.description:
Ripl lets you easily create, post, schedule, and track professional-looking social content in just minutes. 
Build your audience on social media, engage your customers, and drive more traffic to your business with beautiful, branded videos and posts on Ripl. 
READY-MADE TEMPLATES 
Pick from 1000s of customizable templates made for your business and goal. Easily create video, animation, or static posts in minutes.
Ripl's templates are made to help your business stand out in Instagram stories, Facebook ads, or social flyers.
PROMOTE YOUR BRAND
Set your logo, colors, and font preferences so you'll be sure that every post fits your business' unique style.
With Ripl, you can show off your brand and maintain consistency across all your social media channels—Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
The easiest solution for creating and managing social ads. Just create a video ad, select your audience, set your budget, and then watch the results come in. 
Ripl makes it so that any small business can have success with Facebook and Instagram ads. Increase brand awareness, gain more followers, and get in front of more customers without breaking a sweat. 
STOCK MEDIA LIBRARY OR ADD YOUR OWN
Over 500,000+ professional images and videos at your fingertips, and the ability to add your own, make it easy to stand out on social media. 
Whether you are promoting your restaurant, real estate business, or online shop, with our stock media library you can find the images and videos you need to make each post look professional.
SCHEDULE MULTIPLE POSTS IN ADVANCE
Save time by making one post or many, then schedule and share to all your social accounts at once—Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
TRACK YOUR PERFORMANCE IN ONE PLACE
See your recent posts from multiple social channels, see post-by-post engagement, and track performance trends over time.
ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
Access your account from your home, your business, or on the go. 
Ripl’s mobile and desktop browser apps make it easy to create new posts, edit drafts, and schedule to your social channels wherever you are.
WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
"Ripl’s scheduling feature is amazing! A must have app for all businesses!” – Gayle Lemler of Lemler Valley Farm
“Ripl provides professional, branded content with easy peasy templates.” – Bella of Spades Fest
"Creating a post on Ripl is fast and simple. You can create anywhere, and easily maintain your brand.” – Pamela M Jensen of Reality World Real Estate

Instagram: @Ripl
Facebook: @Ripl
For support, contact us via social media or email us at feedback@ripl.com.

If you turn off auto-renew in the middle of a subscription period, you will still have access to all premium features until the end of the period. No partial refunds will be given for turning off auto-renew in the middle of a subscription period.

bluejetty:00023332:ios.name: Hero of Aethric: 8 Bit Fantasy
bluejetty:00023332:ios.summary: EXPLORE, FIGHT, and LOOT in this nostalgia fueled, free to play RPG. Enter an ever evolving retro world of fantasy waiting to be explored. Enjoy turn-based combat in a classic MMORPG that puts you in command of your own customizable bit her
bluejetty:00023332:ios.description:
EXPLORE, FIGHT, and LOOT in this nostalgia fueled, free to play RPG. Enter an ever evolving retro world of fantasy waiting to be explored. Enjoy turn-based combat in a classic MMORPG that puts you in command of your own customizable bit hero. Collect loot and create the perfect build to defeat your enemies and conquer the world of Aethric.
Build your origin town as a home base in this fantasy RPG and set forth on an epic adventure across a unique hand-crafted 8 bit world. Watch the lands of this open world game evolve over time with new updates added every month. Uncover the story of a fallen land, unlock new classes, engage in thrilling turn based action and become the Hero of Aethric!
CREATE YOUR OWN CLASSIC RPG ADVENTURE with friends or tackle things alone. Battle in multiplayer turn-based combat in the arena or go dungeon crawling with your party. The choice is yours on how your fantasy RPG adventure will play out. Make this 2D MMORPG your own with over 100 unique classes, gear, and specializations tailored to your playing style. Explore, loot, and fight your way through a legendary world of fantasy in Hero of Aethric today!
HERO OF AETHRIC FEATURES:
CLASSIC RETRO RPG EXPERIENCE
- Discover a fantasy 2D RPG world crawling with treasures and adventure
- Meet characters in a vast open world that will help you explore the world of Aethric and bring peace
- Defeat enemies in turn based fantasy combat with epic weapons and spells
- Nostalgic fun awaits in a classic RPG that combines modern gameplay with an old-school pixel art style
TURN BASED RPG COMBAT
- Fight enemies in the arena or across the world of Aethric in action-packed turn based games
- Combine your strategy and class setup to take down foes across different fantasy worlds
- Enter an 8 bit fantasy RPG adventure with deadly bosses around every corner
CUSTOMIZABLE 8 BIT ACTION
- Unlock over 50 unique classes and specializations. Start as a thief, mage or warrior and choose your path.
- Combine different armor, weapons, spells, and more to create your perfect build
- A fantasy open world fit for any play style with endless weapon and class possibilities
- Loot your way into creating the ultimate hero of Aethric with locations waiting to be discovered
FREE TO PLAY MMORPG ADVENTURE
- Join heroes from around the world and explore the world of Aethric in a classic 2D MMORPG
- Participate in World Raids and join thousands of players to face off against raid bosses in turn based battles
- Join a guild with other players to take on unique quests, missions and much more!
NOTE FROM DEVELOPER
As a follow up to Orna: the GPS RPG, we aim to build and evolve this game alongside you. We’re a studio that believes in creating games without any paywalls or forced advertisements. We always listen to feedback to make our games the best they can possibly be.
Be sure to join our Discord and be part of the conversation! With monthly updates including features, questlines, and events we can’t wait for you to see what Aethric has to offer – we’re excited to meet you, Hero!
Official Subreddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/MSmTAMnrpm
Privacy Policy: https://ornarpg.com/privacy/

EXPERIENCE a fully interactive murder mystery adventure set in the present day! Journey through a mysterious tropical island filled with hidden objects, secrets, and MURDER! Put your detective skills to the test by hunting for clues, gathering evidence, and figuring out who’s behind the horrific crime! 
THE ADVENTURE BEGINS when Carla Page, a young journalist, receives an unexpected invitation from billionaire Ruben Navarro to join his yearly private party on a tropical island. When Carla gets there, she finds herself surrounded by some of the world’s wealthiest, most influential people... and right in the path of the worst storm of the year. But being unable to escape the inclement weather will be the least of her problems as a mysterious murder occurs moments after she sets foot on shore. Carla puts on her detective’s hat and dives into solving the crime, but each new clue just raises more questions. Carla soon finds out that murder isn’t the island’s only secret. 
HOW YOU’RE GOING TO CATCH THE MURDERER: 
MAKE CHOICES that shape how the story unfolds! 
INVESTIGATE CRIME SCENES and use your detective instincts to uncover every secret and clue. 
SEARCH AND FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS among stunning scenes. 
SOLVE UNIQUE MINI-GAMES and brain-twisting puzzles. 
EXPLORE THE ISLAND and discover a beautiful and unique art style!

bluejetty:00061319:ios.description:
Shop auto and home insurance smarter—without paying to start.
See estimated costs, check discounts you may qualify for, then request free quotes to compare your options.
Fast, simple, and no obligation to buy.
WHY PEOPLE USE THIS APP
• Compare auto, home, or bundled quote options in one place.
• Check if your current premium may be too high before renewal.
• Explore "what if" scenarios (deductible, coverage level, vehicle, teen driver).
• Estimate potential bundle savings when combining policies.
PRICE & DISCOUNT ESTIMATOR
Enter your ZIP and answer a few quick questions (age, vehicle, driving record, coverage, own/rent).
Get a typical monthly and yearly price range, plus common discounts such as:
• Bundling
• Safe driver
• Multi-car
• Good student
• Pay in full
• Safe-driving app
Works offline for estimate tools. Estimate ranges are based on published state averages and typical discount ranges, with sources shown in the app.
POLICY CHECKUP
• Add what you currently pay and see whether it looks competitive.
• Run "what if" changes to understand how premium drivers may affect cost.
• Set an optional renewal reminder so you remember to shop when timing is best.
Your policy details stay on your device.
BUNDLE SAVINGS CALCULATOR
If you already have quotes, enter auto + home premiums and a bundle discount to estimate possible savings.
HOW QUOTES WORK
1. Choose auto, home, or both, and enter your ZIP.
2. Complete a short secure quote request.
3. Insurers and licensed agents may contact you by phone, text, or email with offers you can compare.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to use.
• No obligation to buy.
• In-app estimates are not insurance quotes.
• Final prices and availability come from insurers and agents.

bluejetty:00064929:ios.description:
FSBSW is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FSBSW:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FSBSW app, you must be enrolled as a First State Bank SW Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00024908:ios.name: Ontario G1 Practice Test
bluejetty:00024908:ios.summary: Are you prepared to take your Ontario G1 driving test? Use the official study guide material and actual test questions to prepare for the G1 test in Ontario. With 200+ questions and category-specific practise tests, you'll learn about Ontar
bluejetty:00024908:ios.description:
Are you prepared to take your Ontario G1 driving test? Use the official study guide material and actual test questions to prepare for the G1 test in Ontario. With 200+ questions and category-specific practise tests, you'll learn about Ontario's traffic laws, signs and symbols, penalty system, and driving basics.
The app's content is entirely based on the MTO Driver's Handbook. Practice with instructive questions similar to those on the G1 exam. Get complete and immediate explanations for every question response.
FLASHCARDS
Do you understand the meaning of traffic signs and symbols? Not to worry! You will have access to a comprehensive content-focused flashcards system designed to teach you all of the traffic sign symbols you need to know. 
TEST & STUDY PROGRESS MONITORING 
Maintain a record of your progress through the chapters and lessons. Keep a record of your test results.
QUESTION CHALLENGE
This is a unique feature of our application. It allows you learn while playing a challenge game. Your score will go up by one point each time you correctly answer a question up until the point where you get it wrong. It keeps record of your high score.
The app includes :
• 200+ official practice questions taken from the MTO Drivers manual/ handbook.
• Mock test which includes randomly generated 40 questions to be answered just like the real test. 20 questions will be from road signs and 20 questions will be from rules of road.
• Practice mode which focuses on questions from each category
• Progress section that analyses your test results so you can review your answers and identify areas for improvement
• Bookmark questions to refer them later.
• Flashcards for the traffic signs and road signs you have to remember in order to pass the test.
This is an essential practice app for anyone:
• Taking the G1 Driving Test in Ontario, Canada
• Wanting to apply for Driving Licence in Ontario, Canada
• Want to practice the official MTO Drivers Handbook questions. 
Download the Ontario G1 Practice Test now to pass your driving licence test.

About Game
=========
*Let’s clean the messy house now !
*Cleaning the messy house in your way the Bathroom, Bedroom, Car, Garden, Kitchen, Playground, Swimming Pool, Hall, and Theatre cleaning game.We must clean trace object first, and put unset object to relative place.
*After that tools panel comes so you need to take tool & complete your task.

*Wipe up dust, vacuum the bed & sofa, and throw away trace to dustbin. Not leave any dirty things and fix anything that’s not looking proper. 
*Be ready to clean & decorate the house with lots of new views.
*This cleaning game will teach you about , how to clean your house with best way.
Daily Chores
=========
30+ new levels.
Clean,Repair or fix the view by latest tools.
Car,Gardening,Kitchen,Garage,Washing Machine,Helicopter,Garage tools puzzle,Swimming pool leaf clean, socks pair puzzle, Gym clean,Wash Basin, Stove clean, Sofa clean, Toilet clean, Garden leaf clean, Carpet clean, shoe pair puzzle, Pan cleaning, refrigerator ice clean, Shoe clean and shining, stadium fire control training, Puppy mud clean, Boat clean, Fly clean, Mosquito clean, Bug clean, Memory game, Sorting the objects, Cockroach clean, Catch the fruits in basket.

=========
Search the hidden objects.
100 levels.

Scroll the view horizontally and find the objects.

Find the Object in pair.
100 new levels.
4 categories.
Undo functionality.

Repair the surf boat.
Blow the fire using tools.

Make delicious pizza for your customer.
Make Potato chips & soda too.

bathroom look shiny and clean.

*Car Cleaning*
After the Car clean you need to fixed Head Light & fixed wire so your car is ready to start.

After the Kitchen clean you need to wash dishes with liquid.
*Theatre Cleaning*

Put all the things which is in used at right place.

*Playground Cleaning*
After the Playground clean you need to fixed broken Swivel Seesaw & broken Swing.
*Garden Cleaning
Chance to grow a flower in a garden.
*Puppy House Cleaning*
House is so dirty you need to remove unused things in to the dust.
Put all the things which is in used at right place.
*Bicycle Cleaning*
Replace the broken chain.
*Tree House Cleaning*

Repair the engine.

User friendly interface and interactive graphics.

- Santa Monica 
- Robertson/WEHO 
- Sherman Oaks
APPLE HEALTHKIT

At the Palm Beach Post, our mission is to dig deep, uncover truths, and keep you informed with the latest news. We are committed to our community, ensuring that every story that deserves to be told is heard. 
We’re here because we believ
bluejetty:00063927:ios.description:
At the Palm Beach Post, our mission is to dig deep, uncover truths, and keep you informed with the latest news. We are committed to our community, ensuring that every story that deserves to be told is heard. 
We’re here because we believe that local journalism is valuable – we cover our beautiful beaches, our amazing neighborhoods and our entire community through live breaking news coverage day in and day out. 
We’re our community’s trusted storytellers. We’re here for it. 
WHAT WE’RE ALL ABOUT: 
• Investigative journalism that brings light to the abuses of power across our community. 
• Expert guides into our dynamic dining scene with Pulitzer-winning journalist Liz Balmaseda. 
• Sports coverage for locals, by locals: the Marlins, Heat, Dolphins, Gators and Seminoles. 
• Access to The Dirt newsletter, covering the real estate market in Palm Beach. 
• Stay up-to-date with election news, analysis, and results. 
• App features like real-time alerts, challenging puzzles and lively podcasts, a personalized feed, the eNewspaper, and more. 
APP FEATURES: 
• Real-time breaking news alerts 
• A personalized feed on the all-new For You page 
• The eNewspaper, a digital replica of our print newspaper 
Subscription Information: 
• The Palm Beach Post app is free to download and all users can access a sampling of free articles every month. 
• Subscriptions are charged to your account at confirmation of purchase and automatically renew each month or year, unless turned off in your account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. See "Subscription Support" in the app's Settings for more details and customer service contact information.  
MORE INFORMATION: 
• Privacy Policy: https://cm.palmbeachpost.com/privacy/ 
• Terms of Service: https://cm.palmbeachpost.com/terms/ 
• Help Center: https://help.palmbeachpost.com

bluejetty:00188085:ios.description:
The Accounting & Business magazine app is your essential source for accounting and finance, insights and analysis and CPD units. The app, from the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants, shares trends and developments for and about finance professionals working around the world, with regional editions for those in Africa, ASEAN-ANZ, China, Europe-Americas, Ireland, Middle East-South Asia and the UK. The app is free to download.
Key Features:
Stay informed: Find comprehensive coverage of accounting, finance and business issues in corporate, practice and public sectors. Read topical analysis, find expert insights and hear from accounting and finance leaders on a range of topics, by sector.
Inspirational: Read high-profile interviews with inspiring finance leaders in business and in practice, decision-makers and entrepreneurs from around the world, including ACCA members
In-depth coverage: Stay up to date on specific topical issues in the accounting and finance industries through our special editions. Recent focuses include AI, new in-demand skills, late-career skills, and the issues facing small accounting firms. 
Regional relevance: Access your monthly regional edition in the app to get relevant, up-to-date market developments and hear from accounting and finance professionals in the markets you serve. You can also select to see only the region(s) of your choice.
CPD on offer: Further your career with articles offering CPD and earn units that contribute to your professional development goals. 
Career guidance: Read advice on how to get ahead in accountancy and business wherever you are on your journey. 
Work and well-being: Find content and tips to help you manage your work/life balance and ensure that you’re developing personally as well as professionally.
Technical updates: Keep up to date with all the latest developments in regulation and compliance.
Search and save: Use the search function to find articles on particular topics. You can also save any articles you’d like to revisit, and share with colleagues those of particular interest.

bluejetty:00155649:ios.description:
Get ready to rock your world with Houston's ONLY Classic Rock Station, 106.9 & 107.5 The Eagle! It's not just about tuning in anymore; it's a whole new way to experience the music you love. Imagine having the power to rate and request your favorite songs, or chat with fellow rock enthusiasts who share your passion. That's the kind of interactive journey Houston's Eagle radio player offers, making it effortless to dive into the world of Classic Rock anytime, anywhere, and on any device you choose.
But wait, there's more! Houston's Eagle isn't just a radio station – it's the heart and soul of Classic Rock in Houston. Think of the legends – Led Zeppelin, Van Halen, The Rolling Stones, AC/DC, Aerosmith, ZZ Top, and so many more. These are the giants whose tunes have defined generations, and they're all here, in one place, on The Eagle.
And for those live music aficionados, Houston's Eagle is your golden ticket. They're not just playing the hits; they're bringing the biggest names in Classic Rock right to your doorstep in Houston. It's not just a radio station; it's your backstage pass to the best concerts and rock experiences the city has to offer. Tune in, rock out, and be a part of the legend that is Houston's Eagle. Let's keep the spirit of Classic Rock alive and kicking!

bluejetty:00084030:ios.description:
Love trivia? Discover the ultimate trivia experience with Trivia Games AI—the app that lets you create trivia games on ANY topic you can imagine! Whether you’re a fan of movies, history, science, pop culture, sports, or something entirely unique, Trivia Games AI has you covered. With personalized questions and a dynamic multiplayer mode, every game is tailored to keep the fun going!
Key Features:
 • Trivia on Any Topic: Just name a topic, and Trivia Games AI will generate unique questions and answers for you. The possibilities are endless!
 • Solo or Multiplayer Mode: Play solo to test your knowledge, or gather your friends and family for a thrilling game of up to 4 players on the same screen.
 • Personalized Gameplay: Answer a few quick questions during setup, and the app will customize your experience based on your interests, age, and region.
 • Variety of Difficulty Levels: Choose from Easy, Medium, Hard, or a mix for a challenge that fits your mood.
 • Fast and Fun: No waiting, no limits. Dive into trivia games instantly with a sleek, user-friendly interface.
 • Local and Global Content: Get trivia questions relevant to your region, or explore fascinating topics from around the world.
Why You’ll Love Trivia Games AI:
 • Perfect for family game nights, road trips, parties, or solo challenges.
 • Endless entertainment with new, fresh questions every time you play.
 • Easy to use for all ages—kids, teens, and adults alike!
How It Works:
 1. Choose a topic you love or let the app suggest one.
 2. Customize your game settings—pick your difficulty, number of players, and more.
 3. Start playing! Answer questions, earn points, and see who becomes the trivia champion.
Who Is It For?
Trivia Games AI is for anyone who loves learning, laughing, and challenging themselves or others. Whether you’re a casual player or a trivia enthusiast, this app is your go-to source for unlimited trivia fun.
Download Trivia Games AI Today!
Don’t just play trivia—create it! Experience a whole new way to play with personalized questions, engaging gameplay, and endless topics. Challenge yourself, compete with friends, and discover the joy of learning something new every time.

bluejetty:00133604:ios.description:
The starlight is our hope.
"METRIA", a 3D action RPG where hope and sin collide, is packed with an original story unfolding in a classic fantasy world, an exciting battle system with flashy actions and animations, as well as intriguing elements that trigger your desire to explore.
- A Classic Fantasy Journey Across 9 Countries with Unique Characters -
You will be controlling unique characters including the apprentice knight "Rio Calquinos", the demi-human girl "Aru", the Astra knight "Lucas Nizam", and etc. to explore "Ronatis", the continent where the story takes place. You will have to defeat formidable enemies that get in your way and aim to discover the truth about the world.
- STORY -
――You woke up to find yourself standing on an unknown land.
Through various meetings and farewells,
you will find the hidden truth of this world.
- Fun Battle with a Team of 3! It Gets More Exciting with Flashy Effects and Animatios! -
The occasional battles during the story are real-time action battles fought with a team of 3.
Experience speedy combats while using various actions such as dodge, jump, and skills.
Each character possesses powerful unique skills (special moves) with flashy animations that add more excitement to the battle!
- Felling trees, mining ores, and many more things to explore and craft to make your journey colorful! -
There are many activities you can do such as felling trees, mining ores, fishing, picking plants, and many more things that make you wanna stop by and explore!
You can create various items and gear by taking the materials you have collected to the base.
- Official X (formerly Twitter) -
https://twitter.com/metria_pr
We will be sharing updates and new info about the game!

bluejetty:00155208:ios.description:
ZONA AZUL DIGITAL ( ESTACIONAMENTO ROTATIVO )
O sistema de Zona Azul agora será Digital, adquira o e-Tíquete.
Como adquirir o e-Tíquete para utilizar no Estacionamento Rotativo?
O usuário poderá adquirir e-Tíquete junto aos Monitores que estarão devidamente identificados e circulando pelas áreas onde existam vagas regulamentadas. Poderá também se dirigir aos pontos de venda afiliados que estarão claramente identificados nas áreas regulamentadas.
E para sua melhor comodidade poderá baixar o APP EstacionamentoFacil para Celulares/Smartphones, que possibilitará aos usuários cadastrados adquirirem créditos para compra dos e-Tíquetes.
Como utilizar o APP EstacionamentoFacil ?
Procure na loja de aplicativos do seu celular/smartphone o APP EstacionamentoFacil, após instalação será solicitado o cadastro simples com Nome, Email, Telefone e Senha.
Depois do cadastro efetuado, o usuário poderá adquirir créditos para compra dos e-Tíquetes, utilizando seu cartão crédito ou débito. No APP poderá visualizar o histórico das aquisição de crédito realizadas no EstacionamentoFacil, além de ter sempre a mão seu Saldo para compra de novos e-Tíquetes.
As transações com cartão de crédito/débito serão protegidas, sendo efetuado diretamente com a Operadora. Com isto as informações do cartão não serão armazenadas, evitando qualquer possibilidade de utilização indevida das informações.
Com os créditos adquiridos o usuário poderá, através do APP EstacionamentoFacil, ativar o e-Tíquete pelas tarifas e períodos regulamentados pela Lei Municipal.
O usuário receberá a confirmação da validação do e-Tíquete adquirido, não sendo necessário se dirigir à Monitora ou ao veículo estacionado.
Como utilizar o e-Tíquete no Estacionamento Rotativo?
O sistema utilizará tecnologia digital para emissão do e-Tíquete permitindo que, após o usuário adquirir o e-Tíquete(pelo monitores/postos credenciados/APP), a placa do veículo seja registrada no sistema, validando o período de permanência do veículo na vaga.
Dessa forma não será necessário que o usuário retorne ao veículo para validar o período ou deixar qualquer tipo de tíquete impresso em local visível, como ocorre no sistema convencional.
A responsabilidade de fiscalização da regularidade dos veículos estacionados em vagas regulamentadas será realizada pelos Agentes de Trânsito do Município de Suzano.
Quando o veículo estacionado de forma irregular?
Será considerado irregularmente estacionado o veículo que:
Exceder o período máximo de estacionamento permitido em cada área;
Usuário não ativar o e-Tíquete no período fiscalizado;
Estiver utilizando tíquete diferente daquele adotado pelo Município de Suzano;
O que ocorre quando o usuário não efetuar a regularização?
Conforme inciso XVII do art. 181 do Código de Trânsito Brasileiro e demais regulamentações pertinentes, o não cumprimento as condições regulamentadas especificamente pela sinalização (placa - Estacionamento Rotativo), prevê aplicação de Auto de Infração de Trânsito (tipo grave 5 (cinco) pontos na CNH ) com aplicação de Penalidade de Multa, e ainda sujeito a remoção do veículo.

bluejetty:00168281:ios.description:
Don't put up with bad matches and missing tracks - use the tool that gives you control over your playlist transfers.
Important: You'll need a current Apple Music subscription to use "Playlisty for Apple Music".
• Copy all of your Spotify playlists, liked songs, albums and artists to Apple Music in just a few taps

Please note that Playlisty for Apple Music transfers playlists *into* Apple Music, not out. If you are looking to transfer playlists from Apple Music to Spotify please look at our other app: Playlisty for Spotify (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/playlisty-for-spotify/id6478105775) which goes the other way.
¹ The free version of Playlisty allows you to import an unlimited number of playlists, but playlists from certain sources (e.g. Spotify & YouTube) are capped at 20 tracks. Our low-cost "Pro" upgrade unlocks a number of additional features including playlists of unlimited length regardless of source.

bluejetty:00040239:ios.description:
In this creative and challenging tuning journey, you'll get access to a range of car tuning tools that will allow you to redefine the classic cars that once ruled the road according to your personal preferences. From professional-grade painting tools to a wide range of interior decorations, every step of the way allows you to get creative and modify or restore these classics exactly as you want. Your task requires only meticulous care and a little effort, whether in the accompaniment of passionate rock or calm classical music, to challenge yourself, surpass yourself, and let these former glories bloom again on the road, step by step.
 Along the way, you'll need to use your strategy and skill to use the parts and coins you collect to buy more premium accessories for your car. Obtaining each accessory is full of challenges, requiring you to skillfully use the various items at your disposal to unlock more modification possibilities. But remember, success along the way won't come easily, it will require you to think fast and be flexible in tackling difficult problems. Only by constantly learning, exploring and experimenting can you truly open up more options and not only restore your car to its former glory, but also give it a unique new life.
 With each successful modification, you will not only feel an improvement in skills, but you will also discover more about car culture and the art of tuning in the process, which will make your tuning journey more enriching and meaningful. Every effort and success will bring you one step closer to becoming a true master of tuning, and ultimately, the revival of these classic cars will be the best proof of your skill and passion.

bluejetty:00061523:ios.summary: PDF Reader Pro helps much for anyone who reads, edit, highlights, OCR, signs, converts, creates, protects, compresses and fills out PDFs on their iPhone and iPad. It also makes it easy to organize, annotate and edit your PDFs. Import files
bluejetty:00061523:ios.description:
PDF Reader Pro helps much for anyone who reads, edit, highlights, OCR, signs, converts, creates, protects, compresses and fills out PDFs on their iPhone and iPad. It also makes it easy to organize, annotate and edit your PDFs. Import files from your computer or the cloud, then complete forms, add freehand drawings and audio notes and more.
PDF Reader Pro offers even more - merge and combine multiple documents, split your PDFs, insert pages from another PDF, insert photos or hyperlinks to your PDFs, Convert PDF to Word and other Microsoft Office® formats. With support for reading files from popular productivity suites, it’s a convenient way to take the office anywhere you go.
PDF Reader Pro Edition for Professional is your last choice of PDF application.
READ 
・ View PDFs with various themes like night mode to comfort your eyes.
・ Choose vertically/horizontally scroll pages or single pages/two pages/book mode.
・ Support crop mode, tabbed PDF reading, continuous page view, auto scroll and more.
・ Use text-to-speech feature to read selected text with no time limits.
・ Easy content navigation with bookmarks/outlines.
・ Fast files Printing to directly print PDFs from your device.
・ DRM, supports Vitrium* protected PDF files.
ANNOTATE
・ Annotate PDFs with highlight, underline, strikethrough, note, freehand, text box, anchored note, rectangle, circle, line etc.
・ Create multiple signatures with trackpad, keyboard or images.
・ Insert pre-designed stamps such as Approved, Confidential and more.
・ Support to link any part of the text to a different page, email or website.
・ Share your annotated PDFs with others via PDF documents/Flattened copy/ Summary/ Original PDF.
EDIT PDF
・Edit PDF text. Easily fix typos or other inaccurate content. Fast change the font color, size and style.
・Modify PDF images such as cropping, rotating, deleting, replacing, etc. Easily resize or move images for a better layout.
・Add and edit watermarks to keep your PDFs safe and professional. Watermark tiling is supported.
・Extract images from PDFs.
・Create a Flattened copy to flatten PDF to make the contents static.
PAGE EDITOR
・ Merge & Split PDFs available, split documents into multiple documents or combine multiple pages into a new one.
・ Extract the desired pages to create a new PDF.
・ Insert blank pages / another PDF to import specified content.
・ Rotate, rearrange, add, and delete PDF pages.
Fill FORMS
・ Work with static PDF forms created in Adobe Acrobat.
・ Fill out any PDF forms with interactive fields such as text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, combo boxes, list boxes, etc.
CONVERT PDF
· Export from PDF to Microsoft Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx), RTF, Text, Image, HTML, CSV, and more Offline.
・ Convert MS Office documents, iWorks, web content, and images to PDFs.
・ Create a new PDF as a blank PDF / from your clipboard content.
COMPRESS PDFs
・ Compress large PDFs to reduce file size. PDF size-reduction for easily sharing. 
OCR
· OCR pdfs to convert scanned PDF files or pictures into editable and searchable PDFs or TXT files. 50+ languages supported!
PROTECT CONTENT WITH PASSWORD AND ENCRYPTION
・ Passcode to prevent unauthorized use of PDF Reader Pro.
・ Encrypt to protect your PDF files from unauthorized reading with a password.
SCANNER
・Make continuous scans and automatically detect edges of scanned objects.
Text-to-Speech
・ Support a total of 36 voices for 26 languages.
WORK IN THE CLOUD
・ Store and secure files on iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, Evernote, Box, FTP, WebDav, etc.
Backup Files between iOS Devices, Mac and PC
・ Connect your iPhone/iPad with a desktop for transferring files using USB or WiFi connection.
Support Various File Types
・ MS Office, iWork, image files 
・ Compressed files (zip, rar)
・ audio and video files
・ Other file formats
Have any feedback? Please contact us directly at support@pdfreaderpro.com
