bluejetty:00152150:ios.description:
The Mississippi Lottery in your pocket - the official Mississippi Lottery app makes it easy to stay connected wherever you play. Scan your tickets, enter 2nd Chance drawings, and get instant access to winning numbers, jackpot amounts, and game and promotion info, all in one place.
App Features:
• Ticket Scanner: Instantly check if your Scratch-off or Draw-Game ticket is a winner. No log-in required.
• 2nd Chance Entries: Turn eligible non-winning Scratch-offs into another shot at prizes. Create an account or log-in to your existing 2nd Chance account.
• Winning Numbers & Jackpots: Stay up to date with the latest results for Powerball®, Mega Millions®, Lotto America®, Cash 3, Cash 4, Cash Pop and Mississippi Match 5.
• Promotions & Notifications: Be the first to know about new games, jackpot updates and exclusive promotions.
• Retailer Locator: Find nearby Mississippi Lottery retailers.
• Game Details: Learn how to play, prize details, and see which games are currently active.
Want more ways to connect with the Mississippi Lottery?
• General information: www.mslottery.com
• Mississippi Lottery Insider: https://www.mslottery.com/players/mississippi-lottery-insider/
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TheMSLottery/
• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/themslottery
• X: https://x.com/themslottery
• Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@themslottery
• Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/c/TheMississippiLottery/featured
Play Responsibly: Must be 21+ to play the Mississippi Lottery. Need help? Call 1-800-GAMBLER (1-800-426-2537).
Disclaimer: You cannot purchase lottery tickets through this app. Every effort is made to ensure the accuracy of information contained in this app. This app, however, is not the final authority on winning numbers, prizes, games, or other information. Winning numbers are not official until validated by the Mississippi Lottery and its independent auditors. All winning tickets must be validated by the Mississippi Lottery before prizes will be paid.

bluejetty:00099490:ios.description:
Get ready for a fruity challenge! Fruit Goods Match is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you test your memory, speed, and strategy.
Create Orders:
Each level starts with a unique order of fruits to complete.
Match Fruits:
Tap fruits on the shelf and place them in the slots to fulfill the orders.
Order Success
Complete the slot order correctly to earn in-game coins and unlock new levels.
Fun Tools
Use undo to retract a fruit, refresh to rearrange the shelf, and other exciting items to help you succeed.
Challenging Levels 
Each level brings new layouts, more fruits, and tougher orders.
Casual & Relaxing
Enjoy colorful graphics, smooth animations, and cheerful sounds while solving fruity puzzles.
Features:
 Hundreds of levels with varying difficulty.
 Dynamic fruit shelf layouts to keep you engaged.
 Reward system: earn in-game coins for completing orders.
 Simple tap-and-drag controls for all ages.
 Perfect for short breaks or long gaming sessions.
Why You’ll Love It:
 Easy to learn, hard to master.
 Brain-training and memory-enhancing gameplay.
 Cute fruit graphics and fun sound effects.

Capture your thoughts freely and without distractions, tracking, or ads. With Joplin’s end-to-end encryption and open-source code, you can concentrate on your ideas and tasks without worrying about your privacy.
Capture multimedia notes
Capture multimedia notes effortlessly. In Joplin you can :
• create manuscript notes,
• transcribe speech to note,
• add multimedia: photos, videos, PDFs, and images,
• insert documents as attachments,
• create math expressions, add tables, write code and insert diagrams,
• create to-dos and add reminders.
Organise your ideas
Organise your notes into notebooks. Connect your notes with tags by subject or priority. Use colours and rich text editor to format your notes with ease. Make task lists, create to-dos and add reminders. Effortlessly find your notes, even within PDFs and images, thanks to the powerful search feature enhanced by Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology. Use Joplin to store your bills, lecture notes, photos or receipts.
Reliable synchronisation
Access your notes from computer, phone or tablet by synchronising with various services including Joplin Cloud, Dropbox and OneDrive. Seamlessly move from one device to another.
Offline-first
You can access your notes anytime and anywhere, even without Internet. If you’re using Joplin on multiple devices, they will synchronise and update once you regained the connection.
Enhance your productivity across devices
Extend your note-taking experience by using Joplin on additional devices such as a desktop computer or tablet. Make the most of each device by using its specific features. On the desktop app, use a web clipper extension, wide-range of community plugins and a Markdown editor. Experience flawless handwriting and drawing on your tablet.
Join active community
Connect with Joplin’s vibrant community on Joplin Forum. It’s a place where users can share ideas, ask questions, exchange information and give feedback. Joplin’s dynamic community also develops powerful plugins, so you can customise your app to suit your needs.

bluejetty:00070822:ios.description:
Are you looking for an easy-to-use and versatile text to speech app? Look no further than Text To Speech - TTS Reader.
This app allows you to convert text to speech in 31 different languages, making it perfect for international users. You can even change the speaker, speed, and pitch to create a personalized listening experience.
In addition to converting text to speech, Text To Speech - TTS Reader also works as a text reader, allowing you to read text aloud and scan text or photos via OCR. It's perfect for people with dyslexia and other reading difficulties.
Other features of this app include the ability to export audio files in mp3 format, add bookmarks, and import text from weblinks and iCloud files (including PDFs). You can even highlight spoken text to keep track of your reading progress.
Using Text To Speech - TTS Reader is easy. Simply import your text, select a speaker, adjust the speed and pitch, and tap the play button to hear your text read aloud.
We value your feedback and are always looking for ways to improve our app. If you have any suggestions or issues, please contact us at andychung.cc@gmail.com.
=== Subscription options ===
The app is free to download, but to access premium features, a subscription is required. With the subscription, you'll enjoy uninterrupted access to our premium features. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
If you wish to cancel the automatic renewal of your subscription, you can do so at any time by accessing your iTunes account settings. However, please note that refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To ensure a successful cancellation, please make sure to turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Terms of use: https://tts.andyrgb.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tts.andyrgb.com/privacy

bluejetty:00019213:ios.description:
FEATURES:
 - Powerful search with filters of all cards and sets, all offline
 - Scan cards with the camera
 - Up to date prices from the main stores and marketplaces: TCGplayer, Card Kingdom, Star City Games, Cardmarket...
 - Improve your deck building, check the value of your decks and view multiple stats (Mana Curve, Mana Production...)
 - Organize your card collection in sorted binders and lists
 - Powerful deck simulator to test and improve your decks 
 - Complete card information with up to date rules and legalities
 - Easily share decks with your friends
 - Track your favorite cards
 - Feed with multiple Magic: the Gathering articles
 - Trade tool
ManaBox is an unofficial companion tool for Magic: The Gathering (MTG) players. With ManaBox you can search through all cards and sets without exception for FREE. ManaBox allows you to access up to date market data from different stores and marketplaces so you always know the value of your cards or look at the prices of the cards you would like to get.
Easily digitalize your collection with the built in card scanner and have it available in your pocket at all times.
Keep all your decks organized inside the app and place them in folders if you prefer. You can also share links to them that can be opened in any browser.
You can share any card you want with your friends as well as a link to the marketplace of your choice.
View any set and any card in MTG history, all in one app. The always up to date database means you will never miss any recently released set or card.
ManaBox includes a powerful trade tool that allows you to do better trades, faster and fairer. Search easily between different sets and choose the specific card version you want to trade.
We’re continuously working on improving the app, we’d love to hear your feedback and suggestions at manabox@skilldevs.com. 
All prices in the app come as is from the stores but it's possible that some small differences exist. This is because of the update frequency between what's shown in the app and what you can see in the store's website. 
Currently ManaBox has support for the following stores and marketplaces:
- TCGplayer
- Cardmarket
- Card Kingdom
- Star City Games
- Cardhoarder
- Mana Pool
Magic: The Gathering is copyrighted by Wizards of the Coast and ManaBox is not affiliated in any way with Wizards of the Coast nor Hasbro, Inc.
This app offers subscriptions. They're available (in USD) for $2.49 monthly or $22.99 yearly. ManaBox subscriptions will renew within 24 hours of the subscription period ending, and you will be charged through your iTunes account. Manage at any times through Account Settings in iTunes. Terms and Privacy Policy can be found at https://manabox.app/termsofservice and https://manabox.app/privacy, respectively.

bluejetty:00026461:ios.description:
INTERACTIVE WEATHER MAP
Zoom Earth is an interactive weather map of the world and a real-time hurricane tracker.
Explore the current weather and see forecasts for your location through interactive weather maps of rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.
With Zoom Earth, you can track the development of hurricanes, storms, and severe weather, monitor wildfires and smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery updated in near real‑time.
SATELLITE IMAGERY
Zoom Earth shows weather maps with near real-time satellite imagery.
Live satellite images from NOAA GOES, JMA Himawari, and EUMETSAT Meteosat geostationary satellites are updated every 10 minutes.
HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites Aqua and Terra.
RAIN RADAR & NOWCAST
Stay ahead of the storm with our weather radar map, which shows rain and snow detected by ground-based Doppler radar in real-time, and provides an instant short-term weather forecast with radar nowcasting.
WEATHER FORECAST MAPS
Explore beautiful, interactive visualizations of the weather with our stunning global forecast maps. Our maps are continually updated with the latest weather forecast model data from DWD ICON and NOAA/NCEP/NWS GFS. Weather forecast maps include:
Precipitation Forecast - Rain, snow, and cloud cover, all in one map.
Wind Speed Forecast - Average speed and direction of surface winds.
Wind Gusts Forecast - Maximum speed of sudden bursts of wind.
Temperature Forecast - Air temperatures at 2 meters (6 feet) above the ground.
“Feels Like” Temperature Forecast - Perceived temperatures, also known as apparent temperature or heat index.
Relative Humidity Forecast - How air moisture compares to temperature.
Dew Point Temperature Forecast - How dry or humid the air feels, and the point at which condensation occurs.
Wet-Bulb Temperature Forecast - Heat stress levels.
Atmospheric Pressure Forecast - The average atmospheric pressure at sea level. Low-pressure areas often bring cloudy and windy weather. High-pressure areas are associated with clear skies and lighter winds.
HURRICANE TRACKING
Follow hurricanes from development to category 5 in real-time with our best-in-class tropical tracking system. Information is clear and easy to understand. Our hurricane tracking weather maps are updated using the very latest data from NHC, JTWC, NRL, and IBTrACS.
WILDFIRE TRACKING
Monitor wildfires with our active fires and heat spots overlay, which shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are updated daily with data from NASA FIRMS. Use in conjunction with our GeoColor satellite imagery to see the movement of wildfire smoke and monitor fire weather in near real-time.
CUSTOMIZATION
Adjust temperature units, wind units, time zone, animation styles, and many more features with our comprehensive settings.
ZOOM EARTH PRO
More features are available through auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your App Store account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing period and be charged within 24 hours, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. For further information, please read our Terms of Service.
LEGAL
Terms of Service: https://zoom.earth/legal/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://zoom.earth/legal/privacy/

Are you looking for a new quiz soccer game where you need to guess football teams?
Want this sports quiz to be fun, simple, and updated for the 2027 season?
Play Guess the Football Team 2026. With 1M+ downloads and an average rating of 4.7, we are one of the most interesting football trivia games ever.
Test your soccer/football knowledge and see if you can guess all +200 world football clubs included in our football quiz game. 
◆ GUESS FOOTBALL TEAMS AFTER SEEING EACH SOCCER PLAYER’S NATIONALITY IN THE LINEUP
From the English Premier League and the Spanish LaLiga, to the German Bundesliga, Portuguese Liga Portugal Ligue 1 and Serie A, we included the best football clubs in the world. 
Start by guessing the most famous clubs in Europe. As you progress, the challenges will become harder and harder. You’ll realize that you know the clubs, but it’s hard to guess if you don’t know the nationality of each football player in the lineup.
◆ GET HELP WITH HINTS
Things may get hard in our quiz soccer game. Especially if you don’t know the national soccer team or many of the football players on the team. For those instances, you may use hints such as: show the league position, show the soccer player name, and show team. 
Additionally, you can share the level as png file with friends and get help to guess the team.
◆ GUESS THE FOOTBALL TEAM – FOOTBALL QUIZ 2026 GAME FEATURES:
- There are 125 of the best clubs.
- Guess the footballer nationality in the lineup to guess the football team.
- Guess the football club by lineup! (Season 2026-2027).
- In-game hints to help you in the hardest levels.
- Play the football quiz offline.
- Share guess the club levels as png with friends and get help.
◆ PREMIUM FEATURE: RETRO FOOTBALL
Dive into football history with our iconic lineups from the best seasons of the past. Discover historic football moments and test your knowledge of football legends!
-Experience iconic lineups from the best football clubs of past seasons.
-Exclusive access to Retro Football with the Premium membership.
Challenge yourself and prove you're the ultimate football fanatic by guessing all the teams correctly!
Discover why our app is nominated as a top football quiz app by Quins.
Get ready to kick off the football quiz of the year!

bluejetty:00159787:ios.name: Thelast.io - Battle Royale
bluejetty:00159787:ios.summary:
Do you love multiplayer PvP and fantasy-based survival games? Go head-to-head with other players in this exciting 2D Battle Royale io game.
Make use of a large variety of unique items and equipment in your struggle to survive to be the last
bluejetty:00159787:ios.description:
Do you love multiplayer PvP and fantasy-based survival games? Go head-to-head with other players in this exciting 2D Battle Royale io game.
Make use of a large variety of unique items and equipment in your struggle to survive to be the last one standing!
We have recently added Squads to our game modes so you can play with friends and be the last survival team.
◉ Thelast .io - CORE FEATURES:
▶ Solo (battle royale online PvP mode - fight by yourself versus other players and be the last to survive)
▶ Duos (battle royale online PvP multiplayer mode - fight as a team with friends or strangers versus other players)
▶ Squads (battle royale online PvP multiplayer mode)
▶ 20+ unique equipment, including swords, axes, staves, guns and magical accessories. Choose your own combat style!
▶ 350+ unique cosmetics that you can mix and match to customize your character
▶ 45+ badges to be unlocked based on your progression
▶ 30+ quests that you can complete to earn rewards
▶ Ranking system so you can compare your skill to other players
▶ Rewards that can be earned in various ways.
▶ Twitch integration for streamers so other players can see who's streaming (streamers appear on the title screen)
▶ Player tutorial
▶ Airdrop
◉ The last .io - PLANNED FEATURES:
▶ New map
▶ New items and equipment
▶ New cosmetics
◉ The last.io - HOW TO PLAY:
Once you join a match you'll appear in a lobby. Once the match begins you will be carried over the map by an airship.
You can jump off the airship when ready and free-fall or hold the drop button in to descend more quickly. After you've landed you'll want to find a chest or break open containers to obtain weapons and items. You'll then have to fight your way to the end of the match, making use of your equipment, environment, and brain. As the match progresses the area that you can safely travel in will gradually become smaller and smaller.
Celebrate your victory and survival once you’re the last one standing in this magical 2D multiplayer Battle Royale .io!
Do you think you can survive in this survival world and achieve victory in this 2D Battle Royale online io game?
If you ever need help or want to make new friends to play with, visit our official discord at: https://discord.gg/JGMFC9R
*This 2D Battle Royale online io game requires an active internet connection to play.

bluejetty:00095064:ios.description:
Dog Translator – Your Smartest Companion for Pet Parenting
Dog Translator is the ultimate all-in-one assistant for dog lovers — blending advanced AI tools to help you better understand, train, and care for your furry best friend.
From building your pup’s personalized profile to having fun with bark translations or getting quick advice from our AI vet assistant, Dog Translator makes being a dog parent easier, smarter, and a whole lot more fun.
KEY FEATURES
1. Create a Dog Profile
Add your dog’s name, age, breed, photo, and more — everything you need to keep track of your pup in one convenient place.
2. Dog Translator (Human ↔ Dog)
Ever wish you could talk to your dog? Now you can — kind of. Enjoy our AI-powered voice translator to playfully "chat" with your dog using simulated bark responses powered by advanced sound analysis.
3. Dog Training Toolkit
Access practical tools like a clicker, whistle, squeaky sounds, and basic AI-guided training tips based on your dog’s behavior and breed.
4. AI Veterinarian Assistant
Need quick advice? Chat anytime with our built-in AI vet assistant for general guidance on dog symptoms, behavior, and wellness — available 24/7.
5. DogPedia
Explore a rich, searchable encyclopedia full of breed info, care tips, behavior guides, and fun dog facts — everything a responsible dog parent needs.
SETTINGS
Manage multiple dog profiles
Upgrade to premium for exclusive tools
Easily switch between pets
Please Note:
• AI Veterinarian: This is an AI-based tool for general pet care guidance only. It is not a replacement for a licensed veterinarian, and it does not provide medical diagnoses or treatments.
• Dog Translator: This feature is designed for entertainment purposes only. While powered by sound analysis and playful responses, it does not enable real communication with dogs or interpret their actual emotions.
Download Dog Translator now and start building a smarter, more playful connection with your pup!
Privacy Policy: https://woofyai.io/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://woofyai.io/terms-of-use/
Contact Us: info@woofyai.io

bluejetty:00186605:ios.summary: Ah, the forest, such a magical place! In this particular forest, Banja and her friends are waiting for you to help them build a wonderful, healthy forest community. Plant and chop down trees to create wood that you can use to build houses,
bluejetty:00186605:ios.description:
Ah, the forest, such a magical place! In this particular forest, Banja and her friends are waiting for you to help them build a wonderful, healthy forest community. Plant and chop down trees to create wood that you can use to build houses, roads and renovate buildings. You can also create comic books and other fun stuff. The forest provides a wealth of things to do and produce.
If the forest is feeling good, the inhabitants of the forest feel good - and not just the animals and humans. The supernatural beings of the forest, such as imps and trolls, will also be delighted and will thank you with their love. So step into the magical forest and start playing!
The game is free to download. If you like it and want to buy the full version then you can make a one time purchase inside the app. You will be able to continue building the world you've created in the free version.
FEATURES:
- Build, craft, paint, play - explore a child's creativity 
- Create a large, magical forest world and watch it develop and grow
- Play 14 different minigames
- Interact with fun characters and creatures in the forest
- Learn about the forest, sustainable forestry and climate change in a simple and fun way
- Enjoy the hand-made graphic style and the harmonious sounds of the forest
- No elements featuring stress or timers
- Kid friendly interface - easy to understand and navigate
- Kid-safe environment: totally free from 3rd party ads and commercials
Grow Forest is a game specially developed for children aged 3 to 9 years old. The main purpose of the game is to entertain, but also to pique the player's curiosity of the forest and the part it plays in creating a sustainable society for us all. There are no stressful moments in the game, and children can play at their own pace, never risking getting stuck at any point.
STAY TUNED

Instagram: http://www.instagr.am/GroPlay 
Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/GroPlay 
Website: www.GroPlay.com

bluejetty:00092392:ios.description:
Scoop is a mass messaging app without bots.
As bots spread across the internet, it is becoming harder to know whether the people we interact with online are actually human. AI can now generate messages, conversations, and engagement at massive scale, making the line between human and automated communication harder to see. Scoop is building a different kind of messaging network where every person is verified as human.
Scoop gives communities a human-only place to communicate, organize, and connect. When you know the people on the other side are real, conversations become more meaningful, communities become stronger, and online interaction starts to feel human again.
And when real people come together, real value is created. Scoop gives communities the tools to own those relationships and create new opportunities with brands, sponsors, and partners, while keeping human connection at the center.

bluejetty:00186712:ios.description:
The app supports children through various exercises such as ▶learning vocabulary, ▶sentence structure and ▶grammar as well as ▶pronunciation and ▶spelling. Their knowledge is built up and deepened step by step. In addition, you can create your own flashcards for learning, which makes the app an ideal companion for school lessons.
▶ EASY peasy learning
• Create your own vocabulary lists.
• Lessons included to learn new content or deepen your knowledge.
• Flashcards principle: ideal and proven concept to acquire new knowledge in the long term.
▶ Leitner algorithm: better learning with flashcards
We have refined the Leitner principle in such a way that it is the ideal companion and supplement to school lessons.
▶ Various learning methods: fun and variety
Depending on the level of the child, the app applies the best learning method for your child:
• Finding word pairs or picture pairs
• Spelling
• Pronunciation
• Translating
• Listening and understanding
• Completing sentences, etc....
▶ Personal lessons and vocabulary lists
You can also create your own vocabulary lists to prepare for or to accompany school lessons.
▶ Individual speed
Each child learns differently. Repetitions consolidate knowledge. Our learning technology registers how your child learns and adapts to the child.
▶ More Pro features
• Vocabulary Scanner (take a picture of your vocabulary and start learning)
• Live Translations
• Cloud Sync
• Multi-user support
• Detailed reports about the learning progress
• Offline mode (also works in cars, on trains and airplanes, etc.)
EASY peasy Pro
Enhance the language training of your kids with our Pro version. In addition to all the content of the free app, EASY peasy Pro paid subscription provides an extra set of great features: multiple users, unlimited lessons per day and an offline mode for the ultimate on the go learning experience.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will be automatically charged at the same price for renewal within the 24-hour period prior to the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your Account Settings. bluejetty:00164561:ios.description:
The CRMLS app, designed for agents who are members of California Regional MLS, provides on-the-go access to the CRMLS platform. An agent login is required. 
Highlights:
• share a branded app with your clients
• chat with clients and with other agents about listings in the app
• access agent-only listing information
• search by schools or by drive time
• use TouchID for quicker sign in
• quickly calculate a mortgage payment
• draw tool
• spot tool - just point your phone in the direction of a home to quickly get all the listing info
Listings in the app feature:
• property boundaries on a satellite map view with nearby amenities
• visual history for price and status changes and past sales
• information on schools
• street view
• commute times to saved locations
Integration with the CRMLS Matrix platform features:
• your saved searches
• your full list of contacts
• your carts
• your portfolio of listings
• the CRMLS Agent Roster
Have a comment or enhancement request? Please visit www.crmls.org/support.

bluejetty:00018067:ios.description:
Bank securely with the Lanco FCU mobile app. Use your online banking credentials to log into your Lanco Federal Credit Union account and enjoy convenient tools to manage your finances.
MANAGE YOUR ACCOUNTS
• Quickly view balances, recent transactions, bill payments and more on your dashboard.
• Enable low balance alerts.
• Review transaction history and view check images.
• Add tags, notes, and images to transactions to help you keep track of what’s important to you.
TRANSFER MONEY AND PAY BILLS
• Perform immediate or recurring transfers and loan payments.
• Take line of credit advances.
• Schedule bill payments.
DEPOSIT CHECKS
• Take photos of checks to deposit them into your account.
• View check hold details and release dates.
SECURITY & CONVENIENCE
• Use a passcode or biometrics to access your accounts.
• Add 2-step verification to secure your login.
• Easily switch between profiles to manage multiple Lanco FCU memberships.
CONTACT & SUPPORT
• Easily find Lanco FCU branches and surcharge-free ATMs near you.
• Get contact information for Lanco Federal Credit Union member services.

bluejetty:00024484:ios.name: Jumbo Jet Flight Simulator
bluejetty:00024484:ios.summary:
MAYDAY! MAYDAY!! MAYDAY!!! Declaring an Emergency!
Jumbo Jet Flight Simulator is a flight simulator game consisting of 6 different jumbo jets that were popularly used in commercial aviation. Built using Airfoil physics the game delivers a
bluejetty:00024484:ios.description:
MAYDAY! MAYDAY!! MAYDAY!!! Declaring an Emergency!
Jumbo Jet Flight Simulator is a flight simulator game consisting of 6 different jumbo jets that were popularly used in commercial aviation. Built using Airfoil physics the game delivers a highly realistic Flight Simulation experience on mobile devices. 
Jumbo Jet Flight Simulator also features Disaster Missions which are based on real-life air crashes where a major malfunction cripples the aircraft. This is your chance to display phenomenal airmanship and pilot the airplane back to a safe landing or face impossible odds and fight till the bitter end.
The Game also features Day/Night cycles, Dynamic Weather, Free fly mode, and a Cockpit view. Unlike most flight simulation games on mobile, Jumbo Jet Flight Simulator offers a comprehensive list of control systems, instruments and warning systems.
Control systems:
Ailerons(roll control)
Elevators(pitch control)
Rudder(yaw control)
Flaps
Spoilers
Trim
Reverse Thrust
Asymmetric Thrust on Engines
Autopilot
Brakes
Landing Gear
Instruments:
Altimeter
Airspeed Indicator
Attitude Indicator
Heading
Vertical Speed Indicator
Turn Indicator
Slip/Skid Indicator
Warning Systems:
Stall Warning
Bank Angle Warning
Terrain Warning
Landing Gear Warning
Master Caution
Aircrafts:
Airbus A380
Nicknamed as SuperJumbo, A380 is the world’s largest full-length double-deck airliner with a seating capacity of 525. With 4 turbofan engines the Airbus A380 can fly for 14,800 km.
Boeing 747
Dubbed as the original ‘Jumbo Jet’ , Boeing 747 is the world’s first wide-body airliner. Also called ‘Queen of the skies’, more than 1,500 aircraft were built over a span of 50 years.
Ilyushin Il-86
Often remembered as ‘USSR's first wide-bodied aircraft’, the Ilyushin Il-86 was built by the Ilyushin design bureau for the Soviet Union. Out of the 100+ airplanes that were built, only 3 remain in service, all with the Russian Air Force.
Lockheed L-1011 TriStar
Built by Lockheed Corporation, the ‘Tristar’ came into production in the 1970s to compete against Boeing 747 and the McDonnell Douglas DC-10. A total of 250 Tristars were built and only one remains in service.
Airbus A310
Often known as the world's first twin-jet wide-body airplane with range long enough for it to be operated on transatlantic flights, Airbus A310 first came into production in 1983. 
Boeing 777
Commonly referred to as the ‘Triple Seven’, it is the first Boeing aircraft with fly-by-wire controls. First launched in 1995, 777 had become the most-produced Boeing wide-body jet, overtaking the 747.
Jump into the cockpit and see if you have what it takes to pilot a Jumbo Jet!

Airbus A310
Often known as the world's first twin-jet wide-body airplane with range long enough for it to be operated on transatlantic flights, Airbus A310 first came into production in 1983. 

Boeing 777
Commonly referred to as the ‘Triple Seven’, it is the first Boeing aircraft with fly-by-wire controls. First launched in 1995, 777 had become the most-produced Boeing wide-body jet, overtaking the 747.

Jump into the cockpit and see if you have what it takes to pilot a Jumbo Jet!

bluejetty:00150463:ios.summary:

Built for soloists, educators, drumlines, and marching ensembles — practice with the e
bluejetty:00150463:ios.description:
Subdivide is the rehearsal engine for musicians: a precision metronome, programmable click tracks, audio cue practice, and a chromatic tuner in one app.
Built for soloists, educators, drumlines, and marching ensembles — practice with the exact clicks your music needs, then share them with everyone on the field.
PRECISION METRONOME
• Subdivisions from quarters to septuplets, with per-beat accents
• Mute individual subdivision notes to test your internal clock
• Tap tempo, presets, and a hold-to-cut long tone for ensemble cutoffs
• Live Activity on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
CLICK TRACKS FOR ENTIRE PIECES
• Build multi-section tracks: tempo, time signature, and subdivision changes
• Smooth accelerando and ritardando transitions between sections
• Import MusicXML and generate the whole track from your score
• Count-offs, looping, and custom start/stop bounds for woodshedding
• Speed up or slow down the whole track without changing pitch
MADE FOR THE MARCHING ARTS
• Drill Mode organizes your track by drill page and counts
• Share tracks to your whole ensemble with a QR code — they don't need an account
• Export any track as audio to rehearse on any device
AUDIO CUES
• Import any recording and drop cue points on the waveform
• Count in right on the beat, loop tough sections, adjust speed
• Share cues — audio included — with your section
CHROMATIC TUNER
• Fast pitch detection with cents display
• Reference tones for tuning by ear
WORKS THE WAY YOU PRACTICE
• Bluetooth foot pedal and page-turner support
• Siri Shortcuts and Action Button control
• Practice stats and iCloud sync across devices
Subdivide Pro unlocks the tuner, track creation, audio cues, sound sets, and subdivision muting — try it free.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of use: https://www.subdivide.app/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.subdivide.app/privacy

-------------------------------

bluejetty:00061219:ios.description:
除了所有"隨手讀中文聖經"(搜尋"隨手讀中文聖經")的功能,"專業版"另增加以下功能: 
------------------------------- 
* 最完整的中英文研究聖經app,除了不同的中英文聖經譯本之外,還包括註釋,Strong Number原文聖經編號及字典,聖經字典,圖表,屬靈書籍等數十本附上的公共領域免費研經資料,也可選購合法授權的研經資料,例如:新譯本,研讀本註釋,中文NET經文及註釋, ESV, Message, NASB Study Bible, NET, NKJV,希臘文, 希伯來文原文經文字義等.並可利用iOS本身的語音功能(不需要下載龐大的錄音資料，並且不因譯本不同而需另外下載不同的錄音資料）,來朗讀所有的中英文聖經譯本(需另外選購 - 支持包括英,日,阿拉伯,希伯來,希臘等三十七種語音,中文語音包括:國語,普通話,廣東話,可用作經文背誦及語言學習工具).
* 支援繁,簡中文使用者介面; Universal app(支援iPhone以及iPad); 直向以及橫向顯示;所有資料庫已附上,不需要internet連接. 
* 新增 Apple Watch 功能
* 目前市面上的聖經App,僅能有主視窗閱讀聖經,注釋,或字典.不能同時閱讀聖經與這些參考資料."專業版"提供了相當獨特的功能,可以同時打開每一個聖經,個人筆記,注釋,以及字典視窗,這些視窗是獨立的,浮動的,可移動的,並可放大或縮小.讓你可以同時對照閱讀經文及這些參考資料. 
* 目前市面上唯一app可打開至多4個聖經視窗（別的App只能打開至多2個） - 每個聖經視窗可以調整視窗大小和指定聖經文本。此外，你可以指定某一聖經視窗為“多本聖經文本並行顯示“。這些功能允許在同一屏幕上查看所有的聖經譯本,而無需來回翻轉。加上上面所提的“浮動”的注釋，字典，個人筆記和聖經搜索彈出視窗，等於你可以在同一屏幕上查看所有的研經內容. 
* 超強的筆記編輯功能: 目前市面上唯一支援“豐富文字編輯功能”以及可插入任何研經內容或web Link. “豐富文字編輯功能” ，包括“粗體” ， “斜體” ， “劃底線” ， “刪除線” ， “字體顏色/加亮/大小” ， “有序或無序列表”等，此外，你可以貼上“註記”link，可以快速連接任何研經內容到您的筆記。此外，您可以複製網頁鏈接然後貼上到您的筆記。詳情請看Video demo: http://facebook.com/handybible
* “註記”筆記: 不像聖經筆記必須與經文連結，“註記”筆記可以作為以“專題”方式表達的筆記。 “註記”筆記也擁有如上述的豐富文字編輯功能。詳情請看Video demo: http://facebook.com/handybible
* 另一有別於其他聖經App的功能,所有資料是以SQL數據庫儲存,搜索經文或你的個人筆記中的任何字串.可設定舊約,新約,整本聖經,或限定那些經卷,也可以使用“AND“或“OR”來縮小搜索範圍。效率, 功能強大的SQL數據庫查詢, 能在幾秒鐘內搜尋到你要找的經文.而且搜索結果可顯示所有包含該字串的經文以及該字串出現在各書卷的頻率.目前市面上大部分的聖經軟件,只能一頁一頁的查詢,無法一次及一目瞭然地顯示所有的查詢結果. 
* 支持使用"正則表達式"(Regular Expression)搜索聖經經文，只需在搜索字串之加上"regex:"，然後接著加上正則表達式搜索字串。
* 同一視窗可選擇顯示多至四本聖經文本,輕輕一按切換聖經圖標,即可輕鬆地切換到不同的聖經文本 
* 除了可透過Navigation Bar上的切換聖經圖標,輕輕一按即可輕鬆地切換到不同的主要聖經文本,另外增加一浮動聖經視窗,可以總是有不同聖經文本經文可閱讀及比較. 
* 注釋: 包含MHCC,JFB,Clarke,Barnes,Gill,TSK. 如同"個人筆記",若該節經文帶有注釋,該注釋圖標會顯示在該節經文旁邊.此注釋視窗是浮動的,半透明和可移動的,這樣可以同時閱讀聖經經文和個人筆記以及注釋. 
* 研讀工具: 
--- 經文合參:在同一視窗顯示所有不同經文版本,以便對照比較.
--- 搜尋字典:包含AmTrac,Easton,Fausset,ISBE,Morrish,Nave,SC,Smiths,TCR. 可任意搜尋整個或部分關鍵字詞. 
--- Strong Number原文字典(包含英文及繁,簡中文)查詢:包含舊約希伯來文/新約希臘文原文定義,並列出參考到該原文的經文. 
--- 聖經加註Strong Number查詢:包含KJV以及和合本(繁,簡)加註Strong Number.浮動, 半透明和可移動的視窗, 顯示該Strong Number的定義,並列出參考到該原文的經文. 
--- 聖經地圖史畫: 現有"The Complete Sunday School Atlas","The Rand-McNally Bible Atlas" and "Dore's Bible Illustrations" 
--- 讀經計畫: 可以按照個人讀經進度來建立在多少週/月/年之內來研讀多少聖經書卷的每日讀經計畫.內附四個讀經計畫以供參考.
 * 所有以上功能均可複製或email出去 
* 除了(繁,簡)和合本,呂振中,中文英皇欽定本聖經,簡明聖經外,也包含英文的ASV, BBE, DARBY, ISV, KJV, NHEB, WEB, YLT聖經文本, 另外可選購授權研經資料: 中文-新譯本, 《研讀版聖經-新譯本》(香港環球聖經公會授權), 中文NET聖經及60,000條注釋, 英文-ESV, NASB, NASBEC, NET bible/60,000 notes, Message, NKJV bible 
* Useful Tips/FAQ: http://vincentchiu.com/iphone_apps http://facebook.com/handybible
* 使用者良好評鑑(平均4.8/5全球評鑑)

bluejetty:00061888:ios.description:
Want to improve employee engagement and performance? Looking for a way to inform meetings and employee evaluations? 
15Five is the leading employee communication platform for managers to gain insights into employee progress, and for employees to receive the feedback they need to succeed.
This brief, automated weekly process leads to meaningful conversations about everything from how to improve an employee’s role, to the creation of brilliant product innovations. With our new iOS app, have the most important conversations with your team or manager from anywhere!
Here’s how it works:
Once a week, employees answer several questions about their accomplishments from the previous week and provide other details about their progress. Managers can even pass-up answers to directors and executives, providing top to bottom visibility around triumphs, challenges, and great ideas. 
Our new iOS app allows you to enjoy the same great features as the web version: 
Goals & Accomplishments - Employees enter their goals for the upcoming week. Next week they check off the goals that they accomplished, while the ones that they missed are automatically marked with an x. Employees can add additional accomplishments at the bottom that were not contemplated the week before. Managers get a sense of progress at a glance. 
Comments - Employee feedback is a two-way process. Managers can comment on answers directly in the app, spawning important conversations about everything from increasing revenue to improving company wide processes. 
@mentions - Responses to questions often involve more than one team member. Just @mention orther stake-holders to loop them in to the conversation and make decisions that much faster. 
Flag for follow-up - Don’t let important responses fall through the cracks. With this handy feature, you can come back later to provide an employee with support, realign someone around their goals, or talk through an innovative idea. 
The 15Five app is perfect for remote teams to check-in every week, and for on-the-go managers and executives to know the pulse of their company from anywhere at any time. To use the app, you must already be a customer.

bluejetty:00200169:ios.summary:
ImpulseDie is a percussion synthesizer that you patch with cables. It is inspired by SOMA Pulsar-23, the hardware semi-modular drum machine.
It works out of the box. With no cables at all, the clock drives the looper, the looper plays the
bluejetty:00200169:ios.description:
ImpulseDie is a percussion synthesizer that you patch with cables. It is inspired by SOMA Pulsar-23, the hardware semi-modular drum machine.
It works out of the box. With no cables at all, the clock drives the looper, the looper plays the four voices, and the voices go to the mixer and out. Cables are there to change that: let the kick play the bass, the bass bend the snare, or the reverb clock the hi-hat.
NOT A STEP SEQUENCER
The looper records your touch like a tape loop: when you tap, how long you hold, how hard you play. A short tap is a hit, a long press is a held note or a drone. Prefer drawing? The LOOP view turns every voice into a piano roll.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Four voices: kick, bass, snare and hi-hat
• A 4-bar looper for each voice, with record, mute, play and erase
• Clock with divider, random generator, LFO
• Delay, reverb, distortion and a set of small utility modules
• 122 pins: any output can go to any input. Audio, envelopes, clocks and random steps are all the same kind of signal
• Tape players: load your own audio files from the Files app or iCloud Drive
• 148 factory presets, most with a groove already recorded
• A little noise, drift and bleed, like analog hardware. Turn it down in SETUP if you want it cleaner
• Several skins and colour schemes
TWO PLUG-INS IN ONE APP
• ImpulseDie: the app works on its own, and installs an AUv3 instrument for AUM, GarageBand, Cubasis, Drambo, Loopy Pro, Logic for iPad and other hosts
• ImpulseDie FX: an AUv3 effect that runs the audio of a track through the machine
The app and both plug-ins share the same presets.
MADE FOR TOUCH
• Drag up and down to turn a knob, sideways for fine moves
• Double-tap for the default value, press and hold to type one
• Pads are multi-touch, as on the hardware
• Pinch to zoom the panel up to 2.5×
PLAY IT AND SYNC IT
• Play the voices from a MIDI keyboard; MIDI Learn on every knob
• Follows the tempo and position of your host, or runs free on its own clock
• Undo and redo for every gesture
Same engine and same sound as the desktop version (VST3, AU, AAX).
Landscape only. Designed for iPad; on iPhone the panel is scaled to the screen.
—
ImpulseDie is an independent product, inspired by SOMA Pulsar-23. It is not affiliated with, licensed by or endorsed by SOMA Laboratory, and contains no code, circuit designs or samples from SOMA Laboratory. SOMA, SOMA Laboratory and Pulsar-23 are trademarks of their owner. All algorithms, code and artwork are the property of Diego Capoccitti / 34Audiovisuals.

bluejetty:00077133:ios.description:
Get out of pain, and stay out of it, in as little as 10 minutes a day.
MELT On Demand is your streaming home for guided fascia self-care: gentle, follow-along videos that help you relieve chronic pain and everyday aches, improve mobility and stability, calm your nervous system, and feel better in your body. It's not a workout and not stretching. It's simple, science-backed self-care that meets you where you are, at any age or fitness level, based on the idea that you don't have to cause pain to get out of pain.
FIND RELIEF FOR WHAT HURTS
Browse a full, growing library organized around real life:
 ◦ Ease pain by area, neck, back, hips, knees, shoulders, hands, and feet
 ◦ Support for living with chronic pain and diagnosed conditions
 ◦ Move better for your favorite activities and sports
 ◦ Everyday resets for sleep, stress, low energy, and desk-bound days
 ◦ Short on time? Plenty of focused videos around 10 minutes
WHY IT WORKS
MELT targets the connective tissue system, your fascia, and the nervous system that keeps your body stable and balanced. By gently rehydrating fascia and calming stress, MELT helps release the stuck tension that leads to pain, stiffness, and imbalance, so you can move and feel better, naturally.
GUIDED BY EXPERTS
Follow along with MELT creator Sue Hitzmann and a community of certified instructors who guide you step by step, so you always know what to do and why it works.
BUILD A PRACTICE THAT LASTS
New videos are added regularly, so there's always something fresh. Start with the fundamentals, then grow at your own pace with content for every body and every goal, whether you're easing pain, recovering from activity, or simply investing in how you'll feel for years to come.
SELF-CARE ANYWHERE
Stream on your phone, tablet, computer, or TV, at home or on the go. Your practice goes wherever you do.
People come to MELT to get out of pain, move more freely, sleep better, stress less, and feel more like themselves. A few minutes of the right self-care can change how your whole body feels.
Download MELT On Demand and start feeling better today.
Our app offers auto-renewing subscriptions.
You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, or the trial period (when offered). Cancel anytime in Account Settings.

bluejetty:00129028:ios.description:
Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.
The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.
The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

bluejetty:00128728:ios.name: BFF Test: Best Friend Quiz
bluejetty:00128728:ios.summary:
We all want to be surrounded by friends. True friendship is precious to us all. Have you ever wondered which of your friend is truly your BFF (Best Friend Forever)?
Now, you have an app to test the strength of your friendship with your fri
bluejetty:00128728:ios.description:
We all want to be surrounded by friends. True friendship is precious to us all. Have you ever wondered which of your friend is truly your BFF (Best Friend Forever)?
Now, you have an app to test the strength of your friendship with your friends and get your friendship score. This app can not only be used as a compatibility test, but will also keep you engaged and entertained along the way.
How does the BFF Friendship Test app work?
The process is simple. You just need to enter yours and your friend's name in the BFF Friendship to start the friendship compatibility test. You then answer 10 simple questions about your friendship in this playful quiz. At the end of this fun little quiz you can see the friendship score in the buddy meter.
What is special about the BFF quiz? What kind of questions can expect here?
The friendship quiz tries to cover all aspects of this special BFF bond. The questions revolve around how much you know about your friends, how much you trust them and how does their presence in your life make you feel. Each question is designed carefully to help you gauge the closeness of this friendship bond and how compatible you are with this person. The questions help you realise if you already are at BFF level with this friend or if your friendship bond needs a little more work.
How many times I can take the quiz?
You can take the quiz as many times as you like. You can take the BFF quiz for each and every friend of yours. The app offers 4 sets of unique questions. This allows you to take the friendship quiz again even for the same friend. We are constantly in the process of adding more content to the BFF Friendship app. Our aim is to ensure that you never get bored even if you take the quiz the tenth time.
Can I share the friendship score with my friend?
Absolutely! You can not only share the results of the BFF test with your closest friends but you even have to share the result with the world. The app offers various share options at the end of the quiz which include (but are not limited to) Whatsapp, Instagram, Facebook and more.
Share the result and testimony of your real friendship with your friends, colleagues, families and in turn ask them to share their result, and for this, all they have to do is answer the fun trivia quiz questions from the BFF test app.
The friendship meter quiz is free for all users to play. There is no charge for playing this quiz or for checking the score in the buddy meter after the end of the BFF Test quiz. What are you waiting for? Install the BFF Friendship Test App with fun friendship quizzes, check your friendship bond, compatibility and share with friends to celebrate the friendship with your buddies.
Please note the BFF Test app has been developed only for fun and entertainment purpose and has no intention to hurt the user or anyone's feelings. The application uses a numerical algorithm and should be used only for fun or entertainment and should not be treated otherwise.
We are constantly working hard on making the "BFF Test" app better and more fun for you and your true pals. We need your constant support to get going. Please feel free to send us an email for any queries/suggestions/problems or if you just want to say hi. We would love to hear from you. Enjoy your friends quiz app, you can play as many quizzes as you want!

bluejetty:00157977:ios.name: Amity
bluejetty:00157977:ios.summary: Welcome to the rest of the world. Amity is the only app that brings a truly global experience to the world's oldest fraternity. Today's Freemasons expect a connected Craft, and Amity delivers with over 300 Grand Lodges and over 52,000 Lod
bluejetty:00157977:ios.description:
Welcome to the rest of the world. Amity is the only app that brings a truly global experience to the world's oldest fraternity. Today's Freemasons expect a connected Craft, and Amity delivers with over 300 Grand Lodges and over 52,000 Lodges and other Masonic Bodies at your fingertips.
Finally, the power of modern technology is available to Freemasons. Use Amity to find Lodges anywhere in the world; check your membership status in real time; log your attendance at Lodge; and more.
Version 3 of the Amity app includes:
FIND LODGES -- AND APPENDANT BODIES -- ANYWHERE
Use our groundbreaking map to find Masonry Near You... everything nearby, anywhere in the world. When you find a Lodge, you can:
• See when it meets and check your recognition status
• View the Lodge's website, social media, and more
• Get directions using your favorite mapping tool
• See photos and other information
• Send the Lodge a message
Best of all... if details are missing, and the Lodge is in your Grand Lodge, you can update the data to give others a better experience!
CHECK RECOGNITION
Amity v3 includes a complete list of all of the world's Grand Lodges, and whether or not you recognize them. You already know that we're the only tool that documents every Regular Grand Lodge... and now they're at your fingertips.
LEARN FROM YOUR BROTHERS
Amity v3 adds a powerful new tool: our Masonic Media Library. Browse top blogs and podcasts from around the world, hear the latest news, and more. From The Masonic Roundtable to Historical Light to Freemasons for Dummies... they're all here. For participating Grand Lodges, you can even view official documents such as your Grand Lodge Code and more!
CHECK YOUR MEMBERSHIP STATUS
Amity launched the first global, real-time status checker in 2018, and King Solomon's Pass is still the standard in Grand Lodges around the world. Now, in Amity v3, it's built right into the app! You can:
• Show your QR code to another Mason for scanning
• Scan someone else's QR code to launch their Pass
• View your own pass and confirm your information
• Launch recognition status right from another Mason's Pass
Verifying your recognition status with another Mason has never been easier... no books necessary! Amity works in over 100 Grand Lodges around the world, and more are on the way.
CHECK IN TO LODGE
Amity's Masonic Passport lets you keep a record of your visits to any Lodge in the world. For each entry you can take notes to remind yourself of what happened, or launch the Lodge's profile to get more information. New in Amity v3: scan your Lodge's QR code to launch its profile and check in with just one tap!
VIEW STATISTICS
Amity v3 introduces statistics about the Craft, including information about Amity as well as groundbreaking information such as the number of active Lodges on each continent. Do you have a suggestion for a chart to add? Let us know!
READ THE MSA's "SHORT TALK BULLETIN"
The Masonic Service Association's "Short Talk Bulletin" is one of Freemasonry's most famous publications. It's been published for almost 100 years, and Amity has partnered with the MSA to bring you a free, rotating version of the Short Talk Bulletin.
MANAGE YOUR LODGE'S DATA
For Brothers with Lodge Admin -- or Grand Lodge Admin -- permissions, Amity allows you to create and view meetings; send yourself attendance rosters; see user profiles, and more. And now, in Amity v3, you can send Summonses to any member of your Lodge that is registered with Amity!
Grand Lodge Admins also have access to Amity's Administrative Portal, where additional statistics are available and recognition status can be updated in real time.

bluejetty:00022123:ios.description:
• Editor's Choice Award (96/100) - Children's Technology Review
• "Simply an amazing app for kids to learn cursive writing." - 5/5 - Top Pick - smartAppsForKids.com
142,000 units sold (including 62,000 to schools)!
• Teach and reinforce the accurate tracing of cursive letters, as well as the proper way to join letters within words, utilizing our proprietary technology
• 3 most popular US fonts (ZB, DN & HWT) + UK , French and Swiss fonts
• Customise by adding your word lists (and record audio for each word)
• Enjoy engaging tracing with 50+ animated stickers, sound effects, and interactive games that bring letters to life at the end of each tracing
• Uppercase & lowercase letters, numbers, and words
• Fully customizable to suit every child’s needs (letter size, difficulty,...)
• Phonics and letter names for each letter
• Monitor progress through reports that allow the replay of the child's tracing
• Introduce toddlers to shapes tracing activities, fostering early developmental skills
• Left-Handed Mode
• Create printable Worksheets to assist your child with handwriting practice on paper
• Apple Pencil support
• Accessibility settings for children with visual impairments
_______
PERFECT FOR KIDS
Kids want to have fun, and Cursive Writing Wizard offers a lot of fun to keep them motivated in the learning process! 
• They can trace using 50+ animated stickers and sound effects
• Once tracing is complete, they can interact with them on 5 games that animate letters
• They can trace any word - like their name - and record their voice for each word
• They can collect stars in 5-Stars play mode
_______
PERFECT FOR PARENTS & TEACHERS
• Ability to create your own word lists (and record audio for each word)
• Detailed reports provide information on what kids have done, including the ability to replay and export the tracings to view kids' progress
• Share word lists via iCloud drive or other cloud providers, adhoc network, or email
• Multiple parameters to customize the app according to the child’s current education level (e.g. letter size, difficulty, show/hide model, allow to stop between key points, etc.)
• 3 most popular US fonts (ZB, DN & HWT) + UK and U French fonts
• Upper and lower case letters, numbers + word lists
• Letter names and letter sounds (which can be customized)
• A customizable 5-Stars play mode prompting the child to trace a letter or a word 5 times using different parameters (each step is more challenging)
• Create an unlimited number of users
• Many settings to customize the app (sound, game time limit, black background,...)
• Left-Handed Mode
• In the A-Z section, special graphics available to match letters (e.g. ant graphic for A/a)
• Accessibility settings for children with visual impairments
_______
"Cursive Writing Wizard is just as wonderful and well-designed as the original Writing Wizard" 5/5 - AppyMall.com
_______
Privacy Policy
KNOW WHAT'S INSIDE
As a Moms with Apps member, we follow the "Know what's inside" best practices for kids’ apps
L’Escapadou takes children’s privacy seriously. We believe you should not have to worry about your kids being tracked by apps or websites. This app:
• Does not collect any user information (we do not use data collection tools)
• Does not contain in-app purchases
• External Links: Protected parent sections are available where you can send us a mail and check out our others apps. Before accessing a parent section, an addition must be solved so that young kids cannot access it.

bluejetty:00146300:ios.name: MoveX - Step and Run Tracker
bluejetty:00146300:ios.summary: MoveX automatically keeps track of your time and presents your life sorted into slices. It shows you your daily activities, places you go, and who you spend time with. MoveX weekly journal provides personalized insights and clarity to your
bluejetty:00146300:ios.description:
MoveX automatically keeps track of your time and presents your life sorted into slices. It shows you your daily activities, places you go, and who you spend time with. MoveX weekly journal provides personalized insights and clarity to your week passed. Start each week with a look back. Remember where you’ve been and vision where you’re going.
Life is precious and so is your time. And keeping that in mind, MoveX is here to help you achieve more of your goals, build a sustainable habit, and boost your productivity to a new height.
A powerful pedometer! GPS Diary tracks your daily routes. Track your all-day activity without wearing a fitness gadget.
Move X is the best Activity Diary and Step Counter because of its features:
- Use your iPhone as a Step Counter & Step Tracker. Move X lets you easily keep track of your daily and weekly step counts without affecting your battery life.
- Move X calculates calorie burn for your activities. You can also view your daily idle calorie burn. Seeing your everyday exercise helps you think about your life in a new way. Start with small changes that can lead to healthy habits and natural weight loss.
- It displays your step count, walking distance, active calories, and heart rate data. It also generates charts for different time periods to help you view the statistics for all dates.
- Move X automatically records your walking, cycling, and running, tracks your distance traveled using various modes of transportation, and keeps a record of your sleep time, among other things.
- It generates an editable timeline based on all your data for the day to help you better document your life.
- It displays all your routes on a map.
- All tracking is automatic; there's no need to manually turn it on or off.
- It provides in-depth integration with Apple Health to provide you with comprehensive health data.
- It collates place statistics, average visit durations, average calories burned, heartrate, and more.
- It provides daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly activity summaries showing duration, distance, calories burned, and much more for every activity type.
- GPS tracking with 24/7 recording.
- It automatically checks in at your location and calculates the duration of your stay.
- It displays your real-time location, including a compass to help you get your bearings.
- AI analyzes your travel or exercise mode, such as walking, running, cycling, taking public transportation, and more. You can also manually select from 16 different sports, including skiing, swimming, horseback riding, and rowing.
- Multiple data display formats, including activity timelines, map routes, and data statistics, help you better analyze your travel activities.
- Multiple sharing options, including picture trails, map routes, and 3D video, can bring you more sense of accomplishment.
- You can export and generate various standard data files, such as GPX and CSV.
- There are no ads, and your data is encrypted and stored securely, so no one except you can access it.
If you need to track your work:
- Track all the places you have visited and the duration of your stay. It can automatically record your visits whether you're visiting clients or traveling on business.
- Record your work hours at the company and generate a commuting report to track your work hours per week/month.
- Export .csv files for easy reimbursement.
If you love to travel:
- Automatically record your travelfootprints and light up the cities you have visited on a world map.
- Import your previously visited places from your photo album to display your complete journey.
- Share your travel route map with a 3D video to tell your travel story.
- Export .gpx files that you can import into other tools like Google Maps.
- This is the perfect app to replace Moves, and it can meet all your needs. We're always working hard to make it even better.
Privacy Policy: https://www.movex.me/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.movex.me/terms-of-use.html

Feeling stuck with your golf skills even though you are getting lessons and training? Feeling frustrated because of an inconsistent golf swing? Wanting to get a longer distance? GolfFix can solve all your problems!
Utilizing AI vision technology, GolfFix provides golf swing analysis and virtual golf coaching that auto-detects your flaws, providing immediate, detailed analysis and plan to improve your swing skills and accuracy. Practice with GolfFix to get your swing analysis & reports!
Advanced AI Swing Analysis
- Automatically detects and records your swing from address to finish, generating a complete swing sequence directly from your recording or imported video 
- Advanced issue detection that identifies over 45 swing issues using AI, each paired with a clear explanation, recommended solution, and visual example
 - Compare your swing with professionals or your past swings to measure improvement technique 
- Access AI-powered shot fix lessons that target your specific swing issues (Slice, Hook, Pull, Push, Loss of Distance, Skying, Fat Shot, Topping, Shank, Toe Shot)
Rhythm, Swing Tempo Analysis & Golf Practice Drills Tools
- Analyze your golf swing’s rhythm and tempo
- Break down your swing into 4 parts to calculate the accurate rhythm and tempo; swing tempo, backswing, top pause, downswing
- Training drills and proven techniques to make your rhythm and tempo consistent
Focus Drill
- Provides the right training and practice drills according to your level and swing style
- Instant analysis and feedback on every practice swing you’ve made - no time to waste!
Monthly AI Report
- Monthly reports to see the results of your golf lessons
- Compare and track your progress with yourself and other users’
- Check the most commonly occurred issue of your golf swing
- Highlight the most improved issue of your golf swing mechanics and techniques
- Track your daily practice streak
- Review your average posture score over the month and compare your lowest and highest scored swing
Global Golfer Community
- Share your swings, tips, and golf experiences with players around the world in an engaging community hub
- Communicate freely across languages with built-in translation that keeps conversations effortless and inclusive.
Premium Features
- Advanced AI analysis
- Personalized swing recording, analysis and lessons
- Shot fix lesson
- Monthly report 
- Rhythm, Tempo, Focus Drill mode
- Unlimited swing log view 
- Swing video Sync
- 60 FPS video support (device may vary)
- No ads
With GolfFix, today is the best day of your golf life.
-------------------------------------------

bluejetty:00099662:ios.name: Allstate Robocall Blocker
bluejetty:00099662:ios.summary:
No one enjoys getting spam calls or texts, and unfortunately, they can do more than just disrupt your peace. If you engage in a robocall from a scammer, your finances and identity could be at risk. 
With Robocall Blocker, you have an extra
bluejetty:00099662:ios.description:
No one enjoys getting spam calls or texts, and unfortunately, they can do more than just disrupt your peace. If you engage in a robocall from a scammer, your finances and identity could be at risk. 
With Robocall Blocker, you have an extra layer of protection between you and unknown and unwanted outreach. Here’s how it works: 
AUTOMATIC CALL SCREENING 
When an unknown caller rings your line, Robocall Blocker will ask the caller to state their name and the call’s purpose. You’ll listen to the brief message and either accept the call, reject it, or send it to voicemail. Then, you can choose to block that number or add it to your contacts. Robocall Blocker also cross-references the incoming number against its global database of millions of scam phone numbers and screens the caller’s dialogue for common scamming terms and language patterns. 
SMS PROTECTION 
For even greater phone protection, Robocall Blocker can block spam texts as well. When SMS protection is enabled, Robocall Blocker can analyze text messages from unknown senders and check the number against a robocaller database, as well as URLs in the body of the message against a suspicious URL database. 
Allstate Robocall Blocker is included in select Allstate Identity Protection plans. Not a member? Sign up at aip.com or check if your employer offers Allstate Identity Protection as a benefit at http://aip.com/employee. 
Allstate Identity Protection is offered and serviced by InfoArmor, Inc., a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation.

bluejetty:00083230:ios.description:
TruckSmarter is the #1 free load board for truck drivers, with AI dispatching that finds loads, checks rates, gets market insights, and takes action.
Truck drivers use load boards to search freight, compare rates by lane, and connect with brokers to bid on and book loads. TruckSmarter unifies your load boards in one app and gives you Dispatch, an AI assistant, to search, call, and place bids on freight for you.
TruckSmarter Load Board: Always Free
• 100% free, always
• See all your load boards in one place. No more app switching.
• Search 100K+ daily loads: find, bid on, and book new loads every day
• Filter by RPM, trailer type, location, broker, and more
• Supports dry van, reefer, flatbed, and hotshot loads
• Book loads instantly with Book Now
• Get custom load alerts and minimize deadhead
• Every broker is vetted before they can post on TruckSmarter
• Already using DAT or 123LoadBoard? TruckSmarter gives you the same load access at zero cost
Dispatch AI: Free Limited Access, $49/month for Unlimited
• Ask anything: find loads, check rates, get insights, and take action, all in one chat
• Dispatch calls brokers and verifies load details, so you're ready to book
• See today's live market rate, so you know if a broker's offer is fair
• See estimated take-home pay per load, after fuel and deadhead
• Get help positioning your ask when a broker's rate comes in low
• Ask Dispatch to find backhaul options, so you're not driving home empty
• Dispatch monitors your lanes around the clock and alerts you when something fits
• You always stay in control: Dispatch works the phones, you work the wheel 
• Free for limited weekly requests, then $49/month for unlimited. No hidden fees, no percentage take.
Why TruckSmarter?
• We help truck drivers, owner operators, carriers, and dispatchers save time and earn more with every load, their way. Built for new authority carriers and experienced owner operators alike.
• The Load Board is 100% free, always (DAT One, Truckstop, and 123Loadboard charge subscriptions)
• Dispatch is a real AI assistant, not just a search tool. It works around the clock so you don't have to.
Need assistance? Reach out to support@trucksmarter.com. Soporte en español disponible.

bluejetty:00123769:ios.name: Car Eats Car Multiplayer Race
bluejetty:00123769:ios.summary: Racing is all about adrenaline, excitement, and speed! Looking for a driving game to challenge friends? Or to destroy opponents in a crazy PVP real-time game on the racetrack? Be the first road warrior to arrive at the finish line and climb
bluejetty:00123769:ios.description:
Racing is all about adrenaline, excitement, and speed! Looking for a driving game to challenge friends? Or to destroy opponents in a crazy PVP real-time game on the racetrack? Be the first road warrior to arrive at the finish line and climb the world leaderboards! Legendary Car Eats Car game is coming back! Now the extreme arcade racing is based on online multiplayer mode! Team up with friends and compete against rivals together! Car Eats Car Multiplayer Racing monster truck game is designed for fans of extreme driving, cartoon characters and comics.
Challenge yourself in crazy races!
Take part in extreme races on various tracks against three rivals in a real-time mode with new Car Eats Car game! Drive a car in different locations: hot desert, snowy Arctic Circle, or the underwater world. Overtake competitors by coming to the finish line first! The cars of rivals would inevitably get in the way. Burn rubber and perform various killing maneuvers: jumps, tricks and coups, and land well. Defy gravity rules, take off from a hill, do backflips, and rush like a rocket through the crazy loops. The tricks replenish your car’s turbo supplies for acceleration. Boost your performance!
Customize your monster truck!
Use rubies to modify your car with some crazy upgrades (speed, turbo, control, acceleration) to ensure that you keep on ruling the track in Car Eats Car game. Pick up the look of avatars, skins, flags, disks, and turbo effects. Or buy the car from the next, more advanced league! More than 20 trucks available! Put the flag of your country or your own unique banner on them! Show everyone who's number one!
Create your own collection of evil cars!
A huge dragon steals the cars and moves them into the space-based garage, where they are turned into monster trucks. Participate in survival real-time races with Beetlee, Locomachina, Gator, Smarty and other offroad legends that can be yours! Help your cars escape from the main villain, Carzilla! You can do it! Race, overtake, and win!
Beat your rivals!
Your rivals in real-time races are people from different countries. Achieve success with the help of crazy tricks - spin forward, backward, and use nitro acceleration! Progress from the Rookie multiplayer level to the race of Experts, then Masters and Aces! Beat your opponents mercilessly, collect rubies, accumulate wealth, and upgrade your monster racing cars like nobody else! Go through levels and become the only offroad legend in the world!
Fast and furious features:
- Race against friends or random players in real-time!
- Compete against up to four players simultaneously!
- Participate in thrilling daily racing tournaments!
- Unlock 20+ cars and choose the best one for your playstyle!
- Create your own car using huge tuning stuff!
- Blast through 24 crazy tracks!
- Perform mind-blowing stunts while trying not to flip over!
- Climb the leaderboards and challenge the best players in the world!
- Earn awesome achievements!
- Unlock upgrades!
- Enjoy a well-developed story and catchy graphics!
- Test simple and intuitive controls!
Reign supreme!
With fierce competition, this race is on! The sequel of the legendary monster racing game is more dynamic than ever! Participate in real-time tournaments with players from different countries! Wake up your predatory instincts! Only the best drivers with baddest rides will stand a chance to win this epic multiplayer showdown! It doesn’t matter whether you’re a stunt driver or a drag racer! Are you the road warrior who will reign supreme? Drive all 20 cars, find and upgrade the most suitable auto-monster for yourself. A great timekiller for racing enthusiasts in an unusual fun design! Tired of racing in circles for the sake of racing? Plunge into a dangerous adventure of evil cars with Car Eats Car Multiplayer Racing!
Links to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy can be found below
Terms of Use: https://smokoko.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://smokoko.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00071131:ios.summary:

It
bluejetty:00071131:ios.description:
Meet Sked - Your new work schedule manager. 
Sked gives you total control over your work schedule. It adds your work shifts in seconds. It tracks your hours worked and pay earned. It shows you your monthly schedule at a single glance. 
It can handle many jobs. It can manage overtime and holiday pay. You can create invoices for hours worked in Sked. And it can add your most common shifts with just a single tap. In fact, there isn’t much that Sked can’t do. 
Sked has powerful sharing features. You can sync your schedule to your iPhone or iPad’s native calendar, which will give you Apple Watch alerts. You can share just your work day, or entire months of your schedule with friends. And best of all - you can directly sync schedules with close friends and family in the app, so you can always see when everyone is working. 
Does your schedule involve rotating shifts? No problem. Sked’s robust scheduling features can handle shift addition for certain days of the week. Sked can also add shifts every certain number of days. 
Sked can add little notes to your calendar as well, to remind you of the most important things. Oh - and of course Sked will alert you when you need to get ready for work. 
With Sked, your work life just got easier.
Subscription pricing and terms:
Sked offers three auto-renewing subscription options:
$2.99 per week
$6.99 per month
$29.99 per year
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Your Sked subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of Use: http://picshiftapps.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: http://picshiftapps.com/privacy-policy/

Ever found yourself swamped with tasks, unable to refuse, and ending up working late? Waiting endlessly for slow responses from clients? Or trying to make sense of vague instructions from your boss?

◆ Highlights! ◆
Explore a plethora of meticulously handcrafted stages by artisans, filled with quirky and amusing gimmicks perfect for killing time.
◆ More fun apps await! ◆
If you ever wished to skip school as a kid, "School School!" is for you! And for the naughty ones who hated showing their test papers, "Hide my Test" is a must-check!

bluejetty:00036789:ios.name: PetTalk - Pet Translator
bluejetty:00036789:ios.summary: Why is your siamese yowling at 3am? Why does your tabby chirp at the window when birds land on the feeder, or your persian purr while tense in a carrier? PetTalk Pet Translator uses AI-powered acoustic analysis to decode your cat’s vocaliza
bluejetty:00036789:ios.description:
Why is your siamese yowling at 3am? Why does your tabby chirp at the window when birds land on the feeder, or your persian purr while tense in a carrier? PetTalk Pet Translator uses AI-powered acoustic analysis to decode your cat’s vocalizations — turning meows, purrs, chirps, growls, and yowls into readable emotional states.
Designed for cat owners who want to better understand their pet’s needs and emotions, PetTalk helps decode vocal signals from breeds like siamese, tabby, persian, and maine coon. Whether you are puzzled by nighttime yowling, chattering at birds, or changes in meowing, the app offers insights tailored to your cat’s breed and age.
HOW IT WORKS
PetTalk captures your cat’s vocalizations and analyzes acoustic properties such as pitch, frequency, duration, and intensity. Using a database based on animal behavior research, it matches patterns to emotional states specific to breeds and ages. The app processes sounds in real time and delivers interpretations within seconds, directly on your device without uploading audio, supporting privacy and offline use.
WHAT YOUR CAT IS SAYING
Short meows usually greet or acknowledge you, while long meows may demand attention or food. Rapid repeated meowing can signal urgency or frustration. Chirping or chattering occurs when cats watch birds, reflecting prey drive. Purring during contact often shows contentment, while purring when tense can indicate stress or self-soothing. Yowling at night is common in older cats or unspayed females. A low growl or hiss often means your cat needs space.
KEY FEATURES
AI Acoustic Analysis provides instant behavioral interpretation on-device, with no internet needed. Create cat profiles including breed and age so the app adjusts interpretations for a siamese yowl, persian purr, or tabby’s bird-window chatter. Save translations in Sound History to track anxiety spikes, nighttime yowling, or changes over time. Engage your cat with Interactive Games based on natural feline instincts such as hunting, curiosity, and comfort-seeking. Use Offline Mode for vet visits or travel. Export and share recordings and results with your veterinarian or behaviorist.
WHO USES THIS APP
New cat owners learning to read their kitten’s signals and understand what different meows, purrs, and chirps may mean. Cat owners puzzled by nighttime yowling or sudden vocal changes, particularly in older or unspayed cats. Owners of indoor cats who chatter at birds, meow at closed doors, or vocalize around feeding time. Families with young children teaching kids when a cat is content, playful, or needs space. Pet sitters who need to quickly understand an unfamiliar cat.
HOW TO GET STARTED
• Download and open PetTalk Pet Translator on your iPhone or iPad
• Create a cat profile with name, breed (e.g., Siamese, Persian, Tabby), and age
• Hold your device near your cat when they vocalize
• Tap record and let the full sound complete
• Review the translation and save it to your history
SUBSCRIPTION
Yearly Plan: $9.99 per year — less than $1 per month for full access.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Manage or cancel through your App Store Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
DISCLAIMER
PetTalk Pet Translator provides interpretations of cat vocalizations based on acoustic analysis and animal behavior research. Results reflect the most likely behavioral pattern for a given sound. Individual animals vary and context always matters. The app is designed for awareness, not a diagnostic instrument. Consult a licensed veterinarian if your cat shows sudden changes in behavior or vocalization.
Privacy Policy
https://mycattranslator.com/privacy
Terms of Use
https://mycattranslator.com/terms
