bluejetty:00041574:ios.description:
Finally understand the hidden patterns running your life, and break them for good.
Trusted by 150,000+ people on their healing journey.
Mindberg isn't another personality test, mood tracker, or feel-good habit app. It's a shadow work experience grounded in real depth psychology, designed to help you understand why you do what you do and finally break the patterns that keep repeating.
If you've ever asked yourself:
- Why do I keep finding myself in the same situations?
- Why do I react the way I do in relationships?
- Why do I feel stuck, numb, or disconnected?
Mindberg helps you uncover the real answers hiding in your unconscious mind.
WHY THOUSANDS CHOOSE MINDBERG
- Break repeating patterns
- Understand your shadow
- Interpret your dreams to reveal what your unconscious is trying to tell you
- Track patterns through guided reflection to build real self-awareness
- Integrate insights into daily life, not just intellectual understanding
- Make better choices rooted in deep self-knowledge
Mindberg is about transformation from the inside out.
MINDBERG GOES DEEPER
Have you used any of these?
- Enneagram
- MBTI / Myers-Briggs
- Personality tests
- Astrology quizzes
- Journaling apps
- Habit trackers
Those tools describe what you do. Mindberg helps you understand why you do it.
Rooted in Jungian shadow work and psychology, Mindberg goes beyond surface-level labels. Your responses and patterns reveal the parts of you that are hidden, denied, or misunderstood.
BUILT FOR YOUR HEALING JOURNEY
Mindberg supports you through:
- Trauma and emotional wounds
- CPTSD and early conditioning
- Grief and loss
- Breakups and relational wounds
- Identity crises and loss of direction
- Recovery from numbing habits and addictive patterns
- Inner child healing
- Spiritual exploration and meaning-making
Mindberg is a safe place to face what you've been avoiding and finally move through it. Everything you write stays private. Your journal is yours alone.
YOUR UNCONSCIOUS SPEAKS. START LISTENING.
Dreams, emotional triggers, repeating patterns. None of these are random. They're signs from your unconscious mind.
Mindberg includes:
- Guided shadow work sessions
- Prompts for Shadow exploration
- Relationship patterns
- Dream analysis and dream journal tools to uncover recurring symbols
- Reflection tools that connect behavior to deeper patterns
When you understand the unconscious forces shaping your life, you stop fighting yourself and start making real progress.
WHY IT WORKS
Most apps try to change your behavior. Mindberg works with the source of your behavior.
By identifying the unconscious beliefs and patterns behind your decisions, you gain clarity and control. This is how you stop reacting and start choosing differently.
People don't invest in Mindberg for quick fixes. They come for insight, transformation, and the chance to finally understand themselves.
WHAT MAKES MINDBERG DIFFERENT
Mindberg was created by a Jungian psychotherapist accredited by the C.G. Jung Institute Zürich. This isn't a faceless app. It's built by people who care deeply about your journey.
The Mindberg team is emotionally invested and committed to supporting you as you explore your inner world. We listen, we iterate, and we evolve based on your feedback.
If you have suggestions, reflections, or ideas, we'd love to hear from you. Leave a review or reach out directly. Your voice shapes the future of Mindberg.
Start your journey inward. Understand your shadow. Reclaim your power.

Dive into the next generation of bubble shooting with Bubble Appex—where casual fun meets competitive thrill and real-world rewards! This isn’t just another bubble game—it’s your shot at thrilling matches, skill-based progression, and the chance to turn every pop into real cash.

• Easy Aim & Shoot: Drag the laser guide to aim, then release to fire—simple and smooth!
• Pop & Clear: Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to make them pop. Clear the board with smart matches to advance.

• Always Something New: Enjoy daily login bonuses, online rewards, and massive Grand Prix events with huge prize pools. Plus, join seasonal tournaments to climb the leaderboards and win big. There’s always a fresh way to earn coins, power-ups, and cash!
Ready to pop, win, and have a blast? Download Bubble Appex now and join millions turning bubbles into real rewards!

Become the richest soccer manager!
Create your personalized football club, recruit the most valuable players, swipe to earn tons of cash, manage your teams and become the best sport tycoon... EVER!

▪ RECRUIT top players in the transfer market to build your dream team (attackers, midfields, defenders..)

bluejetty:00073451:ios.description:
'Tzofar' is an app that provides alerts about sirens in Israel.
By using the app you can receive alerts based on city selection, entire areas, current location, and relevant threats.
Tzofar provides alerts on all HFC's threats such as Red Alerts (Rockets and missiles fire), Earthquake, Hostile aircraft intrusion, and more.
There are other options such as selecting alert sound, bypassing silent mode, alerts history, a map showing the areas where an alert was activated, and more.
The system is connected to the Home Front Command servers, and the information comes in real-time.
The app is not official and should not be relied on. always follow the Home front command instructions.
The system was built by Hoshen Kadosh and Itai Guli

bluejetty:00165137:ios.description:
Welcome to Bubbu & Mimmi World: The Virtual Pet Adventure!
Step into the joyful world of Bubbu the Cat, the global favorite virtual pet, and his playful kitten friend, Mimmi! Bubbu & Mimmi World is an engaging and creative pet game designed for children who love to explore, create, and care for animals. This is more than just a cat game; it’s an exciting universe of discovery, fun, and friendship. Enjoy this amazing kids game now and start your endless adventure!
Pet Care and Learning
• Be the Caretaker: Your virtual companions (dogs, cats, rabbits, and bears) rely on your love and attention. Meet their daily needs to keep them happy and healthy.
• Responsibility & Empathy: Caring for your virtual pet is a playful way to develop responsibility, empathy, and important life skills.
Dress-up, Create & Celebrate 
• Personal Style: Customize your character with hundreds of outfits, hairstyles, makeup options, and accessories. Express your unique style! 
• K-Pop Superstar Makeover: Create your own K-Pop idol cats! Dress them in trendy stage wear, try vibrant new looks, and watch them perform fun dance moves! 
• The Magical Wedding Day: Become a top wedding planner. Design dream rings, style the bride and groom, and throw an unforgettable celebration. 
• New Friends: Hatch mysterious eggs to discover adorable pets. Combine them to create even more lovable creatures and expand your joyful pet family.
Explore an Expansive World
• Unlimited Exploration: Wander from magical castles to enchanted forests, from bustling city centers to sparkling seas. Every corner of Bubbu & Mimmi’s world is packed with surprises and adventures.
• Role-Play Fun: Dive into daily life by visiting the Supermarket, getting pampered at the Spa, enjoying a makeover at the Beauty Salon and Hair Salon, or throwing unforgettable birthday parties! You can also lend a hand at the Hospital and learn to care for injured friends. 
Engaging Mini-Games & Activities
Enjoy endless fun with a collection of exciting mini-games and daily surprises:
• Puzzles: Test your skills with the block puzzle game.
• Adventure: Explore Candyland through fun mini-game.
• Arcade: Try catching items on the beach.
• Classics: Play a relaxing game of Solitaire.
• Daily Surprises: Collect daily gifts and enjoy constantly fresh content that keeps the adventure going!
A Trusted and Safe Experience
At Bubadu, we are committed to creating games for children that spark creativity, friendship, and positive learning. Bubbu & Mimmi World is designed as a safe, family-friendly space where players can develop imagination and emotional growth. It is an ideal game—intuitive and packed with creative possibilities.
Important Information for Parents
This game is free to play, but some in-game items and features may require real-money purchases. Please check your device settings for in-app purchase controls.
• Subscription Details: Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your account settings.
Safety and Privacy (COPPA Certified)
This game is certified compliant with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) by FTC approved COPPA safe harbor PRIVO.
• Privacy Policy: If you would like to know more about the measures we have in place for protecting child privacy, please see our policies here: https://bubadu.com/privacy-policy.shtml.
• Terms of Service: https://bubadu.com/tos.shtml

Embrace Your Motherhood Journey with Gentle, Empowering Yoga
Eve is designed exclusively for expecting mothers, offering a safe and nurturing space to practice yoga tailored to your unique needs. Whether you're seeking to prepare for childbirth or easing into postpartum recovery, Eve provides expert-led sessions that combine movement, mindfulness, and relaxation to support your body and mind.
Features You'll Love
- Daily Check: Get personalized insights and tips tailored to your mood and symptoms.
- Community: Join a safe place where you can ask questions, find answers, and share stories.
- Nutrition: Discover the ingredient of the week, chosen to support you and your baby’s growth, with easy, healthy recipes.
- Personalized Yoga Routines: Enjoy custom-tailored yoga sessions that adapt to your stage to help build strength, improve flexibility, and promote overall well-being.
- Expert Instruction: Follow guidance from certified instructors who specialize in prenatal yoga, ensuring every movement is safe and effective.
- Mindfulness & Meditation: Integrate calming meditation and breathing exercises into your routine to reduce stress, enhance relaxation, and foster a deeper mind-body connection.
Start Your Journey Today
Download Eve and discover a holistic approach to wellness during one of life's most transformative periods. Embrace your strength, nurture your spirit, and enjoy every moment of your motherhood journey with Eve.

All wellness insights in Eve are supported by peer-reviewed medical research, with full citations available in The Wisdom Garden section of your Profile.

bluejetty:00186978:ios.description:
Get definitions for words in more than 40 languages and boost your language learning efforts with flashcards exported to AnkiMobile. Free software based on free data, without ads, data collection, tracking or in-app purchases. The data is on your device, and stays there.
The language data comes from Wiktionary, a project which aims to describe all words of all languages in English. In one single application, multiple languages can be installed, currently there are 40+ languages, but with more than 5200 languages in the Wiktionary project there is ample opportunity to include more in future releases. Regular (monthly to bimonthly) updates ensure the dictionaries always stay current.
Etymologies help to make connections between new and already familiar words in any language installed, and example sentences show words and phrases from everyday usage.
To facilitate faster language learning, your search history is available locally and fully searchable. If you use AnkiMobile you can export flashcards directly from an entry.

bluejetty:00041388:ios.description:
Tiamat turns cellular automata into a creative, relaxing sandbox for patterns, rules, colors, and discovery.
Build living worlds from simple rules, then watch order, chaos, gliders, oscillators, and unexpected structures emerge. Start with familiar Game of Life-style behavior, import or export rulestrings, tune simulation speed, paint directly on the field, and save the fields, rules, gradients, and patterns you want to revisit.
What you can do in Tiamat:
- Explore Conway-like cellular automata with wrapped, borderless fields.
- Create, edit, save, import, and share rules with BS, SB, and HROT rulestring support.
- Paint cells by hand, place saved patterns, or generate random fields.
- Customize gradients and fading to make simulations easier to read and more beautiful to watch.
- Save favorite worlds, layers, rules, colors, and patterns for later experiments.
- Learn cellular automata concepts with built-in help and changelog articles.
Whether you are studying emergent systems, looking for generative art inspiration, or just want a calm mathematical sandbox, Tiamat gives you precise controls without getting in the way.

Not only that, but you also get key metrics/data pointers while using the JRing app to calculate calories burned, pace, speed, distance traveled, and more.
It's Bigger, Better, Bolder, Download the JRing app now!
-Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
-JRing is already access to HealthKit, you can view your health data through HealthKit

bluejetty:00127023:ios.name: Looperator
bluejetty:00127023:ios.summary:
Looperator is the ultimate slicing and processing plugin for all styles of electronic music. 
It chops up your audio and turns it into something new. Thanks to its quick & intuitive interface it makes designing subtle rhythmic enhancements
bluejetty:00127023:ios.description:
Looperator is the ultimate slicing and processing plugin for all styles of electronic music. 
It chops up your audio and turns it into something new. Thanks to its quick & intuitive interface it makes designing subtle rhythmic enhancements to spectacular effect pyrotechnics easy and fun.
In the process, you can dispose of the classics like Filters and Reverbs, but also trippy Loop and Vinyl manipulations. Build a looping effects sequence, with discrete settings for each of Looperator's stunning engines, then bring everything to life using the comprehensive modulation system on a per-step basis.
Looperator makes you sound as if you worked on your track for hours and hours and really all it took was a click of a button.
::FEATURES:: 
• Audio Unit v3 & Standalone
• Rearrange your groove! 
Chop the input signal into 16 slices and freely assign them to each sequence step on the Slice track, then rhythmically stutter selected steps on the Loop track.
• Flexible filters 
Looperator’s Filter provides per-step frequency shaping of the left and right channels independently.
• Multi-effects galore 
Two User FX modules each deliver dynamic effects sequencing via a rich and varied line-up of high-quality processors.
• User steps 
Each sequencer track offers 20 ready-made step options. Much of the time, you won’t need to go any further than that, but when you do, the four User-defined steps also available to each track give you full and precise control of five processor parameters per effect.
• Motion and modulation 
Every User step configuration features five adjustable parameters, each automated using a simple knob, a Randomizer, an Envelope Follower or one of 20 preset parameter modulation curves with adjustable start and end points. When it comes to animating your Looperator effects sequences, the possibilities are literally endless!
• Fast, focused workflow
Like all Sugar Bytes software, Looperator has been developed with operational fluidity at the top of the agenda. Looperator’s snappy workflow keeps up with even the fastest-moving producer.
• There’s more… 
The feature list just keeps on giving! Seven per-module and global Mix blending modes; intelligent randomization options throughout; super-smooth step transitions; deep MIDI integration and control; limitless undo/redo; standalone functionality and more. It all comes together to make Looperator nothing less than a state-of-the-art loop design powerhouse that no electronic musician should be without.

The plot.
England, 1893 year. Professor of Natural Sciences, Dr. Jimenez finds information about the location of a forgotten manor in which a lord Kelly conducted experiments with energy sources. Attracted by a thirst for knowledge and profit, the professor goes on a secret expedition in which he is accompanied only by a faithful assistant, desperate adventurer Bartholomew.
Bartholomew is an orphan who grew up on the streets of London with his sister Anna. From an early age he is in the service of Professor Jimenez, performing a variety of, sometimes very dangerous errands.
According to the information that Dr. Zhimenez managed to gather about the manor, it is known that the most protected secret is located in the very center of the house, which can be reached only after breaking 100 doors.
Professor Jimenez and Bartholomew set off and soon find an entrance to the forgotten manor...

- Learn the secret of the Lord Kelly's Manor;
- Enjoy stunning graphics;
- Solve puzzles on unique, non-repetitive levels;

150+ countries and territories — one eSIM, wherever you're headed

Digital nomads and remote workers needing reliable data across multiple countries 
Business travellers who can't risk connectivity issues 
Long-term and budget travellers on extended, multi-country trips 
Families traveling together

No contracts or recurring charges
Backed by 24/7 live chat support and a 100% money-back guarantee for unactivated eSIMs or technical issues.

bluejetty:00098178:ios.description:
Jibreel is the easiest way to learn the essential knowledge every Muslim needs - in just 5 minutes a day. Designed like Duolingo but built for faith, Jibreel turns learning obligatory (fard ‘ayn) knowledge into a simple, step-by-step journey.
- How do you pray when you travel?
- Can you wipe your socks in wudu?
- What are the rules around prayer, menstruation & ghusl?
- What are the names of Allah? 
- What are the rights of your neighbours? 
- What exactly are the rights of your parents?
99.9% of Muslims don't know the answers to these questions, let alone fulfil them. 
Yet, we will be questioned about every single one on the day of judgement! 
- Problem: most Muslims were never taught their fard ‘ayn systematically.
- Solution: Jibreel fixes this by guiding you through the essentials in a way that is clear, trustworthy, and easy to follow.
--------------------
Based on the famous Hadith Jibreel - the Foundations of Islam
- Islam (Actions) - prayer, purification, fasting, zakat, and hajj.
- Iman (Belief) - the pillars of faith, from angels to destiny.
- Ihsan (Spirituality) - sincerity, excellence, and purifying the heart.
--------------------
Why Jibreel?
- Bite-sized daily lessons - 5 minutes a day to stay consistent.
- Checkpoints & quizzes that build confidence as you learn.
- Built for every Muslim - from lifelong Muslims to those refreshing their basics.
- Clean, distraction-free design focused on knowledge, not noise.
--------------------
Trusted by millions:
Jibreel is brought to you by the creators of Pillars, the Muslim prayer app with 1.7M+ users worldwide. Just like Pillars, Jibreel is authentic, beautifully designed, and built to serve the needs of Muslims today.
No ads. No distractions. Just you, your deen, and daily progress.
It's time to level up and become a better, holistic Muslim!
--------------------

Privacy-first

bluejetty:00139006:ios.developer: Taizhou Mutong Network Technology Co., Ltd.
bluejetty:00139006:ios.summary:
[Product Overview]
Mumu Accounting is not just an app that tracks “how much you spent.” It’s more like a personal inventory and finance management system you can build yourself. You can use it solely for bookkeeping, or connect money, items
bluejetty:00139006:ios.description:
[Product Overview]
Mumu Accounting is not just an app that tracks “how much you spent.” It’s more like a personal inventory and finance management system you can build yourself. You can use it solely for bookkeeping, or connect money, items, assets, subscriptions, and relationships—piece by piece.
Mumu doesn’t aim to have “more features is better.” Instead, it lets you keep only what you truly need.
[Core Philosophy | Build-Your-Own Personal Management]
Don’t want subscriptions? Turn it off.
Not tracking items? Hide it.
Just want a simple cash flow record? No problem—extra features disappear.
Modules can be turned on or off, hidden, or reordered. Processes can be simplified or expanded. The app adapts to you, not the other way around.
[Core Modules]
AI Bookkeeping: Supports text, voice, and screenshot parsing for fast, multi-scenario recording.
Automatic Bookkeeping: Combines system capabilities with AI parsing to reduce manual input.
Bill System: Fast recording, templates, installments, refunds, reimbursements, members, tags, combined payments—everything you need.
Personalization: Offers category and theme markets. Modules can be freely enabled or hidden like building blocks, letting you craft a bookkeeping method that fits your habits.
Asset Management: Multi-account management, balance reconciliation, hiding/archiving.
Item Management: Track purchases, usage cycles, and actual costs.
Gold Management: Weight, average price, and profit/loss clearly visible.
Subscription Management: Auto-renewal reminders for long-term expenses.
Fixed Deposits: Record all types of fixed-term funds with clear maturity dates.
Shopping List: Plan purchases to reduce impulsive spending.
Contacts: Keep track of interactions so personal relationships stay clear.
Recurring Bookkeeping: Auto-record loans, subscriptions, and fixed expenses to prevent omissions.
Batch Operations: Supports batch editing, moving, deleting, and property adjustment of bills.
Advanced Search: Filter by date, amount, category, account, contacts, and more.
Anniversary Tracking: Centralized management of important dates to avoid forgetting.
Data Backup: Supports local and multiple backup methods for easy migration and restoration.
Privacy Protection: Password and biometric unlocking, data fully under your control.
[What Mumu Stands For]
Mumu isn’t a product designed once and done. It’s a system built and refined continuously. Useful features stay; unsuitable ones are redesigned. You can gradually build it into the most convenient version for yourself.

bluejetty:00174955:ios.name: OS Maps: Walk, Hike, Run, Bike
bluejetty:00174955:ios.summary: Explore the outdoors the way you want, all while staying safe with OS Maps. Whether you want to hike, bike or run, OS Maps will guide you through amazing trails across the USA. Want to find new places in your local neighborhood? Or plan tha
bluejetty:00174955:ios.description:
Explore the outdoors the way you want, all while staying safe with OS Maps. Whether you want to hike, bike or run, OS Maps will guide you through amazing trails across the USA. Want to find new places in your local neighborhood? Or plan that next thru-hiking adventure? From breathtaking National Parks to easy walks along the coast, experience the thrill of finding a brand new trail that you never even knew existed with OS Maps. 
Why you’ll love using OS Maps:
EXPLORE NEW PLACES, CREATE NEW ADVENTURES
Plan unlimited trails with detailed, up to date maps across the country & discover that next great trail! Whether you love to hike, bike or run, there are multiple map layers to suit any place, any activity.
TRAILS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Search for the best trails in an area as rated by fellow outdoor enthusiasts or plot your own trail to follow, share & record. Use OS Maps as your go-to trail finder, fitness tracker & outdoor guide. 
VIEW & DOWNLOAD MAPS OFFLINE
No cell reception? No problem. Download your favorite areas to save & view offline, so you can view your maps & chosen routes even without cell reception. Plus, you can export your favorite trails & routes to your GPX device.
TRAIL MAPS TO SUIT ANY ACTIVITY
Choose from multiple map layers, plan activities & find trails with detailed topographic mapping; or explore the landscape in stunning detail with aerial view. You can even see the world in 3D with 3D map layers.
RECORD, REVIEW & RELIVE ACTIVITIES
Use the activity tracking feature & activity history dashboard to track each & every adventure. Look back on past activities & review your stats.
STAY SAFE ON THE TRAIL
Stay the course with live GPS location tracking & never miss a turn with off-course alerts to keep you on track. Download trails, routes & maps & share with others, whether they’re joining you or want to make sure you stay safe.
STAY INFORMED WITH COMMUNITY ALERTS
Get real-time updates from other OS Maps users with Community Alerts. Whether it’s a trail closure or tricky terrain; you’ll stay in the know thanks to insights from the outdoor community. It’s like having thousands of trail buddies helping you plan smarter and stay safer.
USE ON EVERY DEVICE
Go from laptop to hilltop with ease! View, create & sync your routes & activities with a single account across multiple devices. Plan on desktop, follow & record your activities on mobile and Apple Watch.
PLANNING MADE EASY
Use OS Maps as your off-road GPS tracker with automatic ‘snap-to-path’ making route planning easy with the shortest distance between your waypoints plotted automatically.
UNLIMITED PRINTING
Print copies of trails & maps to take with you so you always have a backup to hand.
USEFUL INFO
$4.99 for monthly subscriptions & $28.99 for annual subscriptions.
Battery life can be dramatically decreased by using GPS constantly.
We release updates to all of our apps as we improve them, making them even more stable & adding extra features. Along the way, your feedback & comments about those apps are really important to us. If there’s an issue or something you’d like us to know, head to https://www.ordnancesurvey.co.uk/contact-us 
OS Maps offers either auto-renewing monthly or annual subscriptions to provide you with premium access to OS Maps while you maintain an active subscription. If you choose to purchase a premium subscription, your payment will be processed by Apple. Subscriptions may be managed through the App Store App after purchase. Subscriptions on the App Store are renewed automatically unless you unsubscribe at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple account will be charged for renewal no more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You may cancel a subscription at any time before the end of the applicable billing period by going to your Subscriptions list within iOS settings.
Terms & conditions: http://os.uk/termsosmaps 
Privacy policy: http://os.uk/privacy

bluejetty:00155978:ios.description:
FSSB is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FSSB:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FSSB Bank app, you must be enrolled as a First Secure State Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Join the fro
bluejetty:00070963:ios.description:
Are you ready to rewrite history? Experience the ultimate FREE-TO-PLAY World War 2 FPS Shooter! Step into the boots of a legendary soldier and dive into the most intense, realistic, and action-packed mobile combat ever created!
Join the frontlines, lead your squad to victory, and become a legend in the ultimate 5v5 PvP experience. The fate of the world is in your hands!
WHY PLAY WORLD WAR 2 SHOOTER?
- 13 EPIC BATTLE ARENAS: Historically inspired war zones.
- 5v5 FAST-PACED COMBAT: Optimized for smooth mobile gameplay.
- SKILL-BASED ACTION: Precision aiming and tactical thinking.
- DAILY REWARDS: Log in every day to claim exclusive rewards and bonuses designed to help new players kickstart their military career!
- REGULAR UPDATES: We constantly introduce new maps, historical weapons, in-game events, rewarding missions, and unique characters with specialized gear.
- OPTIMIZED PERFORMANCE: Great graphics even on older devices.
BATTLE ON THE FRONTLINES
Plunge into the atmosphere of the 1940s with stunning graphics and historical accuracy. From urban ruins to military bases, every map offers a unique tactical challenge. Feel the recoil, hear the explosions, and fight for every inch of territory in this definitive World War 2 Shooter.
CHOOSE YOUR FACTION & HEROES
Pick your side and decide the outcome of the war by joining one of the four major world powers. Whether you represent the USSR, Germany, the USA, or Japan, you have the opportunity to customize your soldier, upgrade your historical gear, and use unique combat abilities to dominate every encounter on the battlefield.
EXPLOSIVE GAME MODES
Never a dull moment! Choose from six different combat modes designed to test your tactical skills and reflexes. Dive into classic Team Deathmatch and Deathmatch for pure shooting action, or focus on strategy in Capture Point and Bomb Mode. For those looking for a unique challenge, try the high-stakes Arms Race or prove your skill in Knives Only battles.
HISTORIC ARSENAL & EQUIPMENT
Unlock and master a massive variety of authentic World War II weaponry. Equip yourself with iconic bolt-action rifles like the Kar98k and Mosin-Nagant, or unleash firepower with legendary SMGs such as the PPSH and MP40. From powerful pistols and grenades to tactical equipment and heavy armor, every piece of gear is crafted for maximum impact.
CLANS & COMPETITIVE PVP
Don't fight alone! Create your own clan or join an existing squad to achieve victory more easily. Participate in global PvP battles, climb the leaderboard, or create private rooms for you and your friends. Strategy and communication are your best weapons in the heat of combat!
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
Stay updated on the latest events and exclusive content:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ww2bcofficial/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtVNQDXXPifEsXpYilxVWcA
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ww2bc/
SUPPORT
Have questions or need help? Contact us at: info@edkongames.com
IMPORTANT: A stable internet connection is required. Join the battle now and prove your valor!
Privacy Policy: https://edkongames.com/privacy-policy.html 
Terms of Use: https://edkongames.com/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00021641:ios.description:
• U by Moen shower is a Wi-Fi/cloud-based digital shower system that offers mobile connectivity 
• To create a personalized showering experience, U features three ways to control your shower: voice, phone and controller
• With voice activation, you can activate your shower with the sound of your voice through Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit and Siri, as well as Google Assistant. 
• Download the U by Moen smartphone app to personalize and control your shower from your smartphone
• Through the app you can:
 o create up to 12 personalized shower presets, including name, greeting, outlets, temperature, shower timer and notifications 
 o turn on your shower from bed and have the shower pause once it warms up to your desired temperature, saving time and water until you are ready to step in
 o customize system wide settings such as outlet icons, which Wi-Fi network the system is connected to, language and time zone
• The U by Moen shower system includes a digital valve that offers precise temperature control and a Wi-Fi connected digital shower controller that provides feedback on the shower status through on-screen messaging and notifications in the U by Moen app. It also pairs with Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit and Siri, as well as Google Assistant for a seamless, integrated experience.
• To learn more about U by Moen shower, visit www.moen.com/smart-home/smart-shower

bluejetty:00121608:ios.description:
Magic Fluids is a relaxing, colorful fluid simulation app that will help you calm down and relieve stress, or be creative and make aesthetic digital art. It is based on algorithms of fluid flow simulation and features fluid (pun intented!), beautiful graphics. It is the best time waster!
TOUCH THE SCREEN and enjoy hypnotizing motion of fluid swirls moving around, sometimes slow, quiet and elegant, other times dynamic, satisfying and trippy.
CALM DOWN AND RELAX as you draw and watch peaceful flows evolve in space and eventually settle down into colorful patterns. Magic Fluids will help you sleep, meditate, restore balance, relieve stress and anxiety.
GET CREATIVE and, with a touch of your finger, bring to life stylish patterns of paint and particles. If you like abstract digital art or acrylic pour painting, you'll love Magic Fluids! You can create impressive eye-catching designs that look like swirls, galaxies, liquid, fire, light, smoke, lava and much more!
KEEP YOUR KIDS BUSY - they love to doodle and watch the fluid move around! We hope that Magic Fluids can also help children with anxiety, autism and sensory issues.
Please note: This is NOT a live wallpaper!
Key features of Magic Fluids:
- Highly configurable fluid behaviour and look
- 70+ predefined configuration presets to get you started
- Save your own presets
- Pause the animation anytime and save screenshots
- NEW: Record videos straight from the app!
- Smoke, water and jello animation
- 10 fluid textures that add fine detail to the fluid
- Amazing light and shadow visual effects
- Thousands of particles moving with the fluid
- You can load photos and images as backgrounds
- Highly optimized, multiple quality settings
Fluid animation in your pocket! Touch the screen and create beautiful motion of colorful smoke and water. Calm down and relax as you watch trippy, magical swirls of flowing colors. Get artistic and design creative, satisfying patterns of paint and particles.

bluejetty:00015712:ios.description:
Identify, Collect and Learn – Free. No Ads. Ever.
Smart Bird ID is the all-in-one bird identifier, bird song identifier, bird call identifier, bird sounds guide, and bird watching app for birders, families, photographers, and nature lovers.
Wondering “what bird is this?” Smart Bird ID helps you identify birds instantly from a photo or by recording bird songs and bird calls around you.
Explore a global bird identification guide, discover birds near you, and improve your skills through daily challenges, quizzes, mini-games, and expert-led courses in the Bird Academy.
Whether you are spotting backyard birds, hiking a trail, or traveling, Smart Bird ID turns every bird encounter into a fun learning adventure.
-----
IDENTIFY ANY BIRD BY PHOTO OR SOUND
Quickly identify birds using powerful AI bird recognition and bird song identification tools.
• Photo ID: Snap or upload a bird photo to instantly answer “what bird is this?” with fast, accurate identification
• Sound ID: Record bird songs and bird calls, even with background noise, and detect multiple species at once
• Bird sounds library: Explore thousands of bird songs, calls, and spectrograms
• Works offline and with Siri Shortcuts – just ask: “What bird is singing?”
• Global bird catalogue with expert photos, videos, recordings, and identification tips
Perfect for identifying backyard birds, garden birds, raptors, hummingbirds, shorebirds, and more.
-----
THE BIRD ACADEMY – LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
Improve your bird identification skills through interactive learning.
• Daily bird challenges that test your identification skills
• Bird quizzes on songs, families, feathers, eggs, and habitats
• Mini-games that train your memory and listening skills
• Educational bird videos and courses created with field experts such as Chirp Nook and The Nature Educator
• Spectrograms and guided learning for bird songs and bird calls
-----
LOG AND TRACK YOUR BIRD SIGHTINGS
Build your personal birding history.
• Automatic bird journal with photos, sounds, and locations
• Life list, year list, and yard list synced across devices
• Interactive map to discover birds near you and track sightings
Your sightings become a living birding diary.
-----
COLLECT, COMPETE AND HAVE FUN
• Unlock thousands of animated bird stickers as you discover species
• Earn medals for your best bird photos, videos, and recordings
• Join real-time quizzes and seasonal bird counts
• Track your progress as a birder
-----
CONNECT WITH BIRDERS WORLDWIDE
• Discover bird photos, videos, and sounds shared by the community
• Like, comment, and follow other bird watchers
• Get your media featured on bird species pages
-----
WHY BIRDERS LOVE SMART BIRD ID
• 100% ad-free, even in the free version
• Powerful bird photo identification and bird sound recognition tools
• Beautiful design built by birders for birders
• Works offline for trails, forests, gardens, and travel
• Includes iMessage bird stickers
• Used by birders, families, nature clubs, and educators worldwide
-----
SMART BIRD ID PRO
Unlock the complete birding experience:

bluejetty:00153525:ios.name: HomeCare for HomeKit
bluejetty:00153525:ios.summary:
Featured on 9to5Mac, MacStories & more. The complete HomeKit troubleshooting toolkit for smart home reliability.
Tired of HomeKit devices randomly failing and breaking your automations?
HomeCare is the complete HomeKit toolkit for trouble
bluejetty:00153525:ios.description:
Featured on 9to5Mac, MacStories & more. The complete HomeKit troubleshooting toolkit for smart home reliability.
Tired of HomeKit devices randomly failing and breaking your automations?
HomeCare is the complete HomeKit toolkit for troubleshooting, monitoring, and debugging your smart home. Beyond instantly identifying which devices aren't responding, it provides powerful diagnostic tools to understand exactly what's happening in your HomeKit setup. No more guessing why your morning routine failed or which device is causing problems.
INSTANT TROUBLESHOOTING:
Quickly scan your entire HomeKit setup to see which devices don't respond to commands. HomeCare tests each device and immediately shows you what's broken, unreachable, or timing out. See which devices have low batteries that need replacement soon. For failing devices, check the 'Last Time Online' to understand when problems started.
PROACTIVE MONITORING:
HomeCare runs automatic health checks in the background and sends push notifications only when new problems emerge. Catch device failures before they disrupt your daily routines instead of discovering issues after your automations have already broken. Get alerted when device batteries are running low with customizable thresholds for each device.
SCENE & AUTOMATION TESTING:
Test your scenes and automations step-by-step to identify exactly which action is causing a scene to be reported as 'Failed' in the Home app or by Siri. No more mystery failures - see precisely what's breaking your automations.
REAL-TIME LOGS MONITORING:
The Logs Viewer monitors all HomeKit device state changes happening across your entire home, specific rooms, or individual devices. See exactly when devices change states and track the timeline of events - essential for understanding device behavior during troubleshooting sessions.
PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS:
Run multiple test cycles on each device to build detailed statistics about response times and success rates. Ever wondered which of your brands performs best? Compare performance across devices, manufacturers, bridges, and rooms to identify which components of your setup are most reliable and which need attention. Export comprehensive reports to PDF or CSV for detailed analysis.
EXPORT YOUR SETUP:
Export your full HomeKit device list to CSV with customizable data fields, plus your scenes and automations as readable text or CSV — perfect for keeping a backup or reviewing your entire setup outside the app.
CLEAN UP YOUR SETUP:
Find and fix issues that silently clutter your HomeKit setup. The Automation Health tool now checks triggers, actions, and broken conditions, giving you a much more complete picture of what could break your automations. The Empty Scenes checker finds scenes with no actions that serve no purpose. Keep your setup tidy and your automations reliable.
SHORTCUTS WORKFLOW INTEGRATION:
Get reports of all faulty devices directly in Shortcuts, or check if a specific device responds before sending commands to it. This prevents your Shortcuts workflows from failing when devices are offline - your Shortcuts will only execute HomeKit actions on devices that are actually responding.
COMPREHENSIVE DEVICE SUPPORT:
Works with all HomeKit accessories including bridge-connected devices from Aqara, Eve, Philips Hue, LIFX, and more. HomeCare correctly identifies device types and uses appropriate testing methods for each.
SMART HOME RELIABILITY MADE SIMPLE:
Stop reactive troubleshooting. HomeCare shows you what's broken, what's slow, and what's working perfectly - so your smart home runs reliably every day.
Download HomeCare and take control of your HomeKit setup's health.

bluejetty:00099090:ios.description:
What did "love" actually mean when it was written 2,000 years ago? What about "faith"? Or "grace"?
Bible Word Study is the only app that puts the original Greek, Hebrew, and Aramaic meanings of Scripture right in your hands - instantly. No seminary degree needed. No confusing commentaries. Just tap a word, and see what God's Word really says.
Think of it as Google Translate for the Bible.
SWIPE THROUGH WORD STUDIES LIKE TIKTOK
A full-screen, vertical-scroll feed of beautiful word study cards. Each one reveals the original script, pronunciation (tap to hear it spoken), biblical meaning, fun facts, and key verses. Just keep swiping. New studies generate as you go.
SEARCH ANY WORD IN SCRIPTURE
Type any English word and instantly see the original Greek or Hebrew behind it. Get the etymology, how many times it appears in Scripture, theological significance, related words, cultural context, and more.
READ SCRIPTURE WITH BUILT-IN STUDY TOOLS
A clean, paragraph-style Bible reader with three translations:
KJV, NKJV, NLT, NASB, NASB95, AMP, CSB
Tap any verse (or select multiple verses) to highlight, add notes, save, favorite, share, or copy. Then go deeper with four AI-powered study tools:
Explain - A plain-language breakdown of what the verse means
Original Language - Word-by-word Greek or Hebrew with Strong's numbers
Deep Study - Historical context, theological meaning, and practical application
Related Verses - Connected passages across all of Scripture
ULTRA - GUIDED AI BIBLE STUDY
A brand-new way to study. Choose one of three paths:
Study a Verse - Get a full, structured deep dive into any passage
Create a Lesson or Sermon - Generate teaching material for small groups, classes, or Sunday morning
Struggling With Something - Receive Scripture-based guidance for real-life challenges
Answer four quick questions, and Ultra builds a complete, formatted study you can save, share, or add personal notes to.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Keep Scripture in front of you all day:
Daily Verse - A new verse every morning
Hourly Verse - Rotates every hour
Favorite Verse - Display the verse you've marked as your favorite
DAILY STREAKS
Track your consecutive days in the Word. Share your streak with friends and stay consistent.
SAVE EVERYTHING
Build a personal library of saved words, saved verses, highlights (yellow, green, blue, pink), notes, and favorites. Filter and revisit anytime.
SUPPORT MINISTRIES YOU BELIEVE IN
Subscribers get one vote each month to help choose which ministry partner Bible Word Study supports. See the organizations, learn their mission, and cast your vote.
WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
4.9 stars with hundreds of five-star reviews.
Bible Word Study was built by someone who fell in love with the original languages after learning what the Greek word "agape" really means - and wanted everyone to experience that same Christ-revealing moment.
Download Bible Word Study and discover what Scripture actually says in the languages it was written in.

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

・Adorable characters enjoyable for children of young ages.

【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.

*** Featured in Apple's TV ad “Amazing Apps”! ***
Your fitness dashboard for Apple Health app!
FitPort reads your health and fitness data from the Health app (HealthKit), and shows them in a beautiful and useful way!
--------------------
bluejetty:00023878:ios.description:
*** Featured in Apple's TV ad “Amazing Apps”! ***
Your fitness dashboard for Apple Health app!
FitPort reads your health and fitness data from the Health app (HealthKit), and shows them in a beautiful and useful way!
--------------------
HEALTH APP INTEGRATION:
FitPort shows you the following data from the Health app (HealthKit).
You can input your data manually, and the data is stored securely in the Health app.
iPhone App:
- Steps
- Walking + Running Distance
- Flights Climbed (Floors)
- Cycling Distance
- Workouts (Read only)
- Exercise Minutes (Read only)
- Active Energy
- Exercise Minutes (Read only)
- Stand Hours (Read only) 
- Wheelchair Distance
- Wheelchair Pushes
- Swimming Distance
- Swimming Strokes
- Resting Calories (BMR)
- NikeFuel (Read only)
- Dietary Calories
- Water
- Weight
- Body Mass Index (BMI)
- Body Fat Percentage
- Lean Body Mass (LBM)
- Heart Rate (Read only)
- Blood Pressure
- Sleep Analysis
- Mindful Minutes
- Waist Circumference
- VO2 max
- Time in Daylight
Apple Watch App:
- Activity Rings
- Steps
- Walking + Running Distance
- Flights Climbed (Floors)
- Time in Daylight
--------------------
FEATURES:
iPhone App:
- Displays your fitness data from Apple's Health app
- Hourly/daily/weekly graph
- Shows previous data
- Shows your stats
- Sets goals and monitor your progress
- Change layouts (Auto / Grid / List)
- Change units
- Shows Steps and Walking + Running Distance automatically (iPhone 5s and above)
- Shows Flights Climbed automatically (iPhone 6 and above)
Apple Watch App:
- Shows Activity Ring, Steps, and Distance
- You can see the last 7 days of data in a graph by turning the Digital Crown.
- Complications
--------------------
NOTE:
FitPort does not create any data. It simply reads data from the Health app. 
--------------------
PRIVACY POLICY SUMMARY:
Your data is stored in the Health app (HealthKit), and FitPort will never collect your personal health data. See full privacy policy for more details.
--------------------

Giant turns whatever you're curious about into a story. Bring your imagination to life with trusted characters, just by talking. With Giant you can learn about how anything works or imagine a world of your own all through story. Start solo or bring a friend along for the journey and see your creativity visualized in real-time.
HOW IT WORKS.
Create a profile and step into the Giant universe. Pick a topic, or start a journey from scratch with a character. The character guides you through a story that changes with every question you ask and every choice you make.
Invite a friend to join your journey. They take a turn moving the story forward, then it's back to you.
Keep a journey going as long as you like, or start a new one whenever something new catches your interest.
SAFE. PRIVATE. PARENT-APPROVED.
We built Giant with the same care we would want for our own kids. That means no ads, no pop-ups, and no tracking. Giant is COPPA Certified by Privo.
WHY FAMILIES LOVE GIANT.
We believe imagination belongs at the heart of growing up. It is how children discover who they are and who they can become. The futures we build as adults begin in the worlds we imagine as children.
Trusted by parents, beloved by families, everyone is learning, playing, creating together, and building memories through shared adventures.
Imagine. Together.
Download Giant and start a journey.

bluejetty:00126243:ios.name: Colgate Magik
bluejetty:00126243:ios.summary:
Get ready, now your child can hunt out the Magik brushing monsters on all 16 zones of the mouth. All Magik worlds and masks have been redesigned in full 3D!
The Colgate Magik app will unlock your Colgate Magik toothbrush kit. The app uses
bluejetty:00126243:ios.description:
Get ready, now your child can hunt out the Magik brushing monsters on all 16 zones of the mouth. All Magik worlds and masks have been redesigned in full 3D!
The Colgate Magik app will unlock your Colgate Magik toothbrush kit. The app uses Augmented Reality to give your children a fun brand new brushing experience, turning the Colgate Magik manual 5+ toothbrush into a connected smart toothbrush.
Take the guesswork out of brush time as the Colgate Magik toothbrushing app can detect where they brush. Using advanced visual tracking, it is the first manual toothbrush that can visibly track your kids brushing technique. As your child brushes they will be able to travel through augmented reality games, fight cavity monsters and claim 3D Magik Brushing Masks as they continue on their adventure; all while learning proper brushing techniques!
Hunt out the augmented reality Magik brushing monsters on all 16 zones of the mouth, front, sides and tops of teeth now get the monster treatment, helping your child learn the proper brushing technique for life. 
The fun doesn't stop when the brushing is up, we have added a cool new mask try-on feature to the shop. Each time your child brushes they get a chance to pick a prize, which changes every time they brush. 
Sharing your photos will be so much easier as you can download the brushing pictures straight to your camera roll. 
Just a FEW highlights of the app: 
-Updated gameplay to include 16 zones, front, sides and tops of teeth
-Augmented Reality Games: Using your toothbrush connector you can turn brushing into a game. By following the brushing guidance in each level of the app you can defeat cavity monsters and win augmented reality masks as prizes.
-Discover new game worlds: The better you brush the more prizes you can win and more game levels you can unlock! Now with 15 levels to explore as you improve your brushing
-Parental dashboard: Here you can review brushing feedback and get guidance on how to improve your children's brushing performance.
-Magik photobooth pictures can be saved to the camera roll of your phone
-Magik Check Up: Provides a personalized mouth map to show where each child has brushed and where they missed, so they can improve their technique over time
Colgate Magik - because teaching better brushing today leads to a brighter tomorrow!

bluejetty:00161134:ios.description:
When you’re busy on the frontline of emergency Medicine, EB Medicine is your guide--providing you with practical and reliable answers to aid your clinical decision making, in a concise and easy-to-use format. 
EB Medicine has produced leading evidence-based education and CME since 1999, giving our subscribers access to more than 300 topics and 20 years of experience in our journals, Emergency Medicine Practice and Pediatric Emergency Medicine Practice. 
The “EB” in our name stands for “evidence-based” and reflects our guiding philosophy--that evidence-based content is the best medicine.
Like you, we recognize the need for excellence in emergency patient care. For each of our resources, peer experts have reviewed the current body of evidence to present you with essential findings, conclusions, and best practices to inform your clinical decisions. You receive real-world, practical, actionable guidance you can rely on to improve patient outcomes. Our content is developed by experienced physicians facing the challenges and realities of practicing medicine every day, all accomplished in their medical specialties. 
And with more than 400 CME credits available across the full array of must-know emergency medicine topics, you can advance your clinical knowledge and improve your practice, while fulfilling requirements for ongoing CME. 
Whether you’re a recent graduate or a veteran emergency clinician with decades of experience, our resources allow you to dive deeply into the current evidence that will help you make the best clinical decisions on shift. 
Your EB Medicine subscription gives you practical content right at your fingertips.
• 300+ Evidence-Based Emergency Medicine Courses. Search our course library of Emergency Medicine Practice and Pediatric Emergency Medicine Practice issues by keyword, chief compliant, or topic and get practical recommendations within seconds 
• Clinically Relevant Topics. Get access when and where you need it—via our app, podcast, and online
• Quick Course Summaries. When time is short, just hit the highlights on any topic with our Points & Pearls digests 
• Decision-Support Tools. Make quick, confident decisions guided by clinical pathways, Calculated Decisions (powered by MDCalc), and pitfalls to avoid 
• Subject-Matter Expertise. Our content is crafted by practicing emergency medicine clinicians on the front lines 
• 400+ AMA PRA Category 1 Credits. Core EM content + stroke, trauma, pharmacology, critical care, and more

bluejetty:00172098:ios.description:
To meet the needs of language translation, Bread Translator integrates text translation, photo translation, and audio translation to help users learn and communicate better in daily life.
Functional characteristics：
-Text translation
Users can manually input languages for translation. We have configured language packages for users from various countries and regions to meet different language requirements.
-Photo translation
When users want to translate text on an item, they can try photo translation, take a photo directly or select an image from the phone's album. Our system will recognize the text in the picture and translate it.
-Speech translation
If users feel that manual input is too troublesome, they can try voice input, free hands at the same time, our intelligent recognition system can quickly recognize speech for translation and conversion.
-New AI Chat Feature
Meet the upgraded AI Chat — your intelligent companion for every language task. Effortlessly rewrite text, correct grammar, craft essays, learn new languages, and translate anything with ease.
-Useful Daily Phrases
Discover newly added sets of practical everyday phrases designed to help you communicate more naturally and efficiently in any situation.
Experience a smarter, more intuitive, and more powerful way to handle all your writing and translation needs — within the app.
-Desktop Widget
In order to meet the needs of users' daily learning and recording, we provide desktop components, which users can write language words and sentences on and put them on the mobile desktop for convenient review at any time. Or you can record important events as reminders. It contains a variety of editing methods, users can match and combine their own satisfactory style.
-Subscription
Bread Translator includes a subscription section, which is divided into weekly, monthly and annual subscriptions. The specific prices are as follows:
Weekly plan: $3.99 per week
Monthly plan: $10.99 per month
Annual plan: $34.99 per year
You can cancel your subscription at any time. Once cancelled, your subscription will expire one day before the start of the next subscription cycle. If you need to reactivate your subscription, simply click "Restore" to reactivate it.
Language translation is very simple, download experience to use!
http://breadtranslatorzhc.com/privacyPolicy.html
http://breadtranslatorzhc.com/termOfService.html

Bukan sekadar aplikasi, SuperApp POLRI adalah pusat layanan digital terpadu untuk kebutuhan Anda sehari-hari!
11 Layanan Cepat & Praktis di SuperApp POLRI
1. Panggilan Darurat 110
 Akses cepat ke Layanan Panggilan Darurat 110 POLRI saat Anda membutuhkan bantuan segera.
2. Perpanjangan STNK Online
 Cek data kendaraan dan perpanjang STNK sepenuhnya secara digital, tanpa harus datang ke loket.
3. Urus SIM Nasional
 Perpanjangan SIM A dan C jadi sangat mudah.—dokumen siap dikirim atau diambil.
4. SKCK Online (Tanpa Batas Domisili!)
 Pembuatan dan perpanjangan SKCK kini bisa diurus secara online dari mana pun Anda berada di seluruh Indonesia.
 Praktis, tanpa harus repot bolak-balik.
5. Laporan Polisi & Pengaduan Masyarakat
 Buat laporan insiden/pengaduan (didukung DUMAS & PROPAM) dan pantau statusnya secara real-time.
6. Cek E-Tilang & Konfirmasi ETLE

7. Pantau Perkembangan Kasus (SP3D)

 Temukan lokasi kantor polisi dan rumah sakit POLRI terdekat dengan sekali tap.

Ayo download SuperApp POLRI sekarang juga!

The Data Roaming App developed for our athletes is now available for you!
A single App with
- data packages for more than 100 countries,
- at high-speed connection,
- without a subscription,
- that requires no extra SIM card
- at low costs
- and the first 100MB of data are for free.
The easy way to buy international data at a super fair price! Without obligations, no additional subscription, no strings attached. Get a data bundle to use abroad - no surprise of an outrageous bill once you are back home. All you have to do is to download the App. The Red Bull MOBILE Data App provides your data plan that does NOT require a physical SIM card!
How it works: Download the App, choose the country you want to visit, the amount of data you need and surf like a local via your embedded SIM card. As easy as that! Your existing phone number with your Sim card stays the same.
There are no hidden costs - 
we wanted to make your travel experience smoother and keep your focus on the adventures you experience! And the purchased data package stays active for a whole month.
You can get data for more than 60 countries, including almost every country in Europe, EU bundles and the most popular destinations in North and South America, Australia, and Asia.
With these low costs per GB, you can navigate, communicate, socialize, share and care without worries. 
Why wait? Download the Red Bull MOBILE Data App and get your first 100MB for free!
Countries and Bundles covered within the App are:
Albania; Australia; Austria; Azerbaijan; Belarus; Belgium; Bosnia and Herzegovina; Brasil; Bulgaria; Canada; Costa Rica; China; Croatia; Cyprus; Czech Republic; Denmark; Egypt; Estonia; European Union; Finland; France; Germany; Greece; Hungary; Iceland; India; Ireland; Italy; Japan; Kosovo; Latvia; Liechtenstein; Lithuania; Luxembourg; Malta; Mexico; Netherlands; New Zealand; Nicaragua; North Macedonia; Norway; Pakistan; Poland; Portugal; Puerto Rico; Romania; Russia; Saudi Arabia; Serbia; Slovakia; Slovenia; South Africa; South Korea; Spain; Sweden; Switzerland; Thailand; Tunisia; Turkey; United Kingdom; United States
If you want to learn more, visit esim.redbullmobile.com
You can activate your data directly on your phone and get all your data via your eSim, instead of your local operators physical SIM card.
So no hassle with buying and activating SIM cards in countries you don’t understand the language, the instructions and the operators terms.

Sketches is the most realistic, versatile and user-friendly sketching app designed for a mobile device. This exhaustive artist's toolbox helps users create dazzling sketches, cheerful paintings and smashing illustrations on the go.

Sketches includes a Pro Bundle IAP that make it exactly the same as the Paid Sketches Pro App.

• Features
- Import photos
- Over 20 ultra realistic tools
- Incredibly realistic watercolor wet brushes
- Brush Editor
- Color Eyedropper

• Layers
- Use layers to simplify your task
- Export them as separate PNG with transparency
- import and export PSD layered files

• Cloud Sync
- Backup your drawings to the Cloud
- Synchronize your drawings between all your devices
- Manage sync options folder by folder

• Patterns
- Import, draw and customise your own patterns.

• Folders
Easily organize your drawings to personalize folders.

• Pressure Stylus support
Discover even more realistic brushes while Styluses.
Full support for Apple Pencil.

• A Unique feeling: Each stroke behaves vividly and truly like a brush on paper, adapting the pressure, angle, and width to your movements. It's an effect you have to see to believe.

• A unique UI with a touch of Zen : Tools are hidden away as you create and the bare minimum buttons are shown to make for a very clean canvas.

• List of tools
- Pen
- Rotring 
- Felt Pen
- Pen Brush
- Oil Pastel
- Watercolor Dry and Wet brushes
- Acrylic brush
- Airbrush
- Area and Filling tool
- Patterns
- Text
- Shapes (iPad only)
- Eraser
- Cutter
- Smudge tool
- Ruler

bluejetty:00131884:ios.summary:
Fitbit + Apple Health + Free Sync = Happiness
- Sync all your Fitbit data to Apple Health, for Free
- Sync Heart Rate data
- Auto Sync data for you
- Support all Fitbit device types (including users who doesn't have a hardware and relies s
bluejetty:00131884:ios.description:
Fitbit + Apple Health + Free Sync = Happiness
- Sync all your Fitbit data to Apple Health, for Free
- Sync Heart Rate data
- Auto Sync data for you
- Support all Fitbit device types (including users who doesn't have a hardware and relies solely on Fitbit app)
- Switch between multiple Fitbit accounts
- Support Dark Mode in iOS 13
- **Note** Fitbit provides access to daily data only; we're working with Fitbit to support intraday syncing
- **In App Purchase** is required for Auto Sync
We believe that your Fitbit data belongs to you, and syncing your own data to Apple Health should be Free. So we created Power Sync.
Data types supported:
- Heart Rate
- Steps
- Walking + Running Distance
- Flights Climbed
- Weight
- Body Fat Percentage
- Body Mass Index
- Sleep Analysis (in bed and asleep time)
- Water
- Dietary Calories
Notes:
- Fitbit provides access to daily data only; we're working with Fitbit to support intraday syncing
- Since we don't have intraday data as of now, we're syncing all the data to 12:00 in a day
• You can subscribe for Premium Auto Sync inside the app; subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
• Alternatively a one-time payment plan is available (this is not a subscription).
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of current period. 
• Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
• You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase:
- Go to Settings > iTunes & App Store
- Tap your Apple ID at the top of the screen
- Tap View Apple ID. You might need to sign in or use Touch ID.
- Tap Subscriptions.
- Tap the subscription you want to manage.
- Use the options to manage your subscription.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
We take the security of our customers very seriously.

https://terms.touchberry.net/

Fitbit + Apple Health + Free Sync = Happiness

- Sync all your Fitbit data to Apple Health, for Free
- Sync Heart Rate data
- Auto Sync data for you
- Support all Fitbit device types (including users who doesn't have a hardware and relies solely on Fitbit app)
- Switch between multiple Fitbit accounts
- Support Dark Mode in iOS 13
- **Note** Fitbit provides access to daily data only; we're working with Fitbit to support intraday syncing
- **In App Purchase** is required for Auto Sync

We believe that your Fitbit data belongs to you, and syncing your own data to Apple Health should be Free. So we created Power Sync.

Data types supported:
- Heart Rate
- Steps
- Walking + Running Distance
- Flights Climbed
- Weight
- Body Fat Percentage
- Body Mass Index
- Sleep Analysis (in bed and asleep time)
- Water
- Dietary Calories

Notes:
- Fitbit provides access to daily data only; we're working with Fitbit to support intraday syncing
- Since we don't have intraday data as of now, we're syncing all the data to 12:00 in a day

• You can subscribe for Premium Auto Sync inside the app; subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
• Alternatively a one-time payment plan is available (this is not a subscription).

- Tap your Apple ID at the top of the screen
- Tap View Apple ID. You might need to sign in or use Touch ID.
- Tap Subscriptions.
- Tap the subscription you want to manage.
- Use the options to manage your subscription.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.

bluejetty:00175240:ios.name: Fitness for Kids: Kids Workout
bluejetty:00175240:ios.summary: For a child you love, a perfect gift to promote their happiness and well-being. If you are searching for the best workout apps for kids, you found it! Our training program is optimal for healthy children's growth, and it's safe for everyone
bluejetty:00175240:ios.description:
For a child you love, a perfect gift to promote their happiness and well-being. If you are searching for the best workout apps for kids, you found it! Our training program is optimal for healthy children's growth, and it's safe for everyone to use it.
-Fitness for Kids - Kids Exercises-
Workout for kids is based on years of research and experience in the Health and Fitness industry. As unique exercise apps for kids, our primary focus is kids' health. We focus on correct posture and spine health in a fun and safe way for everyone.
----------------------------------------------------
Exercise together with your kid!
----------------------------------------------------
Take a break! Spend some quality time with your child. Exercises are suitable for everyone. Both you and your child will experience the benefits! Start moving and share the joy with your kid. Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle building, back pain relief, or posture correction, reach your goals with your child! Consistency is the key. What are you waiting for?
Discover three new training programs!
+ Unlimited FUN Workout for Kids
+ Posture Correction
+ Lose weight for Kids
No matter what age, shape, size, or abilities you have, we offer everyone a safe experience. Enjoy the movement!
Experience - Fitness for Kids
We have more than 20 years of experience in creating safe and effective workouts for kids. Fitness for kids is a neglected field in which kids can benefit a lot. Child workout is our expertise, and we are happy to share our knowledge with you so that everyone can benefit from it.
-Safe & Effective Kids' Exercises-
Our training plan combines yoga for beginners and bodyweight exercises focusing on overall well-being. Lose weight for kids exercises with a fun and effective training program!
-Fun At Home Workout for Kids & Family-
With our experience, we developed this app to promote physical and mental health. Get fit for kids is our project where children worldwide will be able to participate. We will show you how to practice yoga and bodyweight movements suitably for 3 years and older kids.
Kids' Fitness suitable for everyone
The fitness for kids app's training program does not require equipment, but 5 minutes of safe joy and happiness. Enjoy working out with your child: bodyweight exercises and yoga for losing weight, building muscles, pain relief, and posture correction.
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. It will not be possible to immediately cancel a subscription. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Refunds are not available for unused portions of a subscription. The lifetime plan is a one-time payment and will not be charged again.
Privacy Policy - https://pages.flycricket.io/fitness-for-kids/privacy.html
Terms & Conditions - https://pages.flycricket.io/fitness-for-kids/terms.html
Our Mission - Healthy Kids
It is health that is real wealth and not pieces of gold and silver. -Gandhi

bluejetty:00120487:ios.description:
*Are you a student who often troubled with when and where the next class will be?
*Are you a teacher who often troubled with different courses of different grades & classes?
*Are you a parent who often troubled with that you would like to take care of kids while they are having exam but you do not even know when the exam is?
Then Pocket Schedule is for you!
Designed and developed by polycents!
Our Pocket Schedule is one of the best tools to track down all your courses, classes, and assignments. Once you use the app you will want nothing else to make your school life easier.
ORGANIZE COURSES, CLASSES & EXAMS
You can easily input and manage your courses, classes, and exams. All your classes will be displayed in a week-view within the schedule module.
You are supplied with a set of icons for your courses, and the icons will be continually updated in every upgrade version. By the way, you can cancel the separate class in case of emergency events.
MANAGE ASSIGNMENT
Kinds of sections are designed to track down all your assignments easily and intuitively. You can either organize your assignments by date, by course or by priority or sort them by completed or uncompleted. 
KEEP YOU ALERT
A powerful notification feature makes sure that you will never miss even one class or assignment. The app allows you to set general notification of all classes and separate alarms of each assignment.
FILLED WITH FEATURES
-Easily manage different semesters and holidays.
-Manage detailed information of all your instructors.
-Add a course, exam or assignment easily.
-Each course has a well-designed icon.
-Sort all assignments into different sections as you want.
-Done an assignment easily, just by one tap.
-Today’s classes are shown in a specific module so that you can get them intuitively.
-Each assignment and class has its own notification.
-All classes are shown in a week view, you can scroll to get the information you want so that you will not forget even one class.
# Subscription Details #
- Monthly, 6 months and annual subscriptions are available.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
- Subscriptions can be managed by going to Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/55082894
Terms of use: https://polycents.com/terms-%26-conditions-3 
Download and start to use the Pocket Schedule to make your school life easier. Think of Pocket Schedule as your classes, exams & assignments alarm clock.
If you have any problems or suggestions please send a mail to schedule@support.polycents.com, and you will get the response in a short time.

bluejetty:00178040:ios.summary:
Are you ready to redefine convenience?
Step into the shoes of a convenience store manager in this charming business sim. Arrange and customize the store using a wide variety of products - candy, drinks, even hot meals. The choice is yours!
bluejetty:00178040:ios.description:
Are you ready to redefine convenience?
Step into the shoes of a convenience store manager in this charming business sim. Arrange and customize the store using a wide variety of products - candy, drinks, even hot meals. The choice is yours!
Add a news stand to sell the latest magazines, comic books, and more. Just remember - this is not a library!
Sometimes the fastest way to your customers' hearts is through their stomachs! Stock hot snacks to entice passers-by to fill their bellies and lighten their wallets.
Running a good store is a team effort. You'll have to recruit new employees to make the most of your working hours. Before you know it, you'll be offering 24-hour service all year long!
It takes care and attention to take your business to the next level. Listen to your customers, help them find what they're looking for, and they might just become regular shoppers!
When the time comes to expand, cooperation is the name of the game. Negotiate with suppliers and other companies to discover new products and unlock your store's true potential!
You may not be the only store on the scene, but a little healthy competition never hurt anyone! Crush your rivals to take over their territory and become the most successful franchise the country has ever seen!
The beginning of your journey to service industry domination is just a short step away. Stock your shelves, ring up your register, and start building the store of your dreams!
Why not try running an amusement park, a hamburger restaurant, or even a campsite?
Search for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games, or visit us at https://kairopark.jp
Be sure to check out both our free-to-play and our paid games!
Kairosoft's pixel art game series continues!

bluejetty:00141361:ios.description:
iGBA runs your own .gba, .gbc and .gb files on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. No account, no cloud, nothing to sign up for: copy a file in and play.
I build iGBA on my own, and most of what is in it came from people writing reviews and telling me what was broken.
SUPPORTED SYSTEMS
- Game Boy
- Game Boy Color
- Game Boy Advance
WHAT YOU GET
- Built for iPhone Duo: it uses the whole unfolded display and keeps playing when you fold it.
- Save states anywhere, alongside the game's own save.
- Rewind when you fall in the pit, and turbo up to 3x for the grinding.
- Cheats: thousands of codes built in, or paste your own. GameShark, Game Genie, Code Breaker and Action Replay formats.
- Link cable between two devices over the network, or between two different games on the same one.
- On-screen buttons you can move, resize, recolor and hide. 8 skins, a color per button, light and dark theme.
- Pick a d-pad, a d-pad with diagonals, or a joystick, and try it before you play.
- MFi and Bluetooth controllers, and a keyboard on iPad.
- Game volume apart from your phone's, so you can put your own music over it.
- Screen filters, frame skip, full screen, and color palettes for monochrome games.
- Apple Watch: your library on your wrist and the Digital Crown as buttons.
- Back up saves, save states, settings and layouts to a single file.
- Play time, favourites, filters and file info in the library.
- Works offline. Your game files stay on your device and are never uploaded.
- 33 languages.
ADS AND PRO
iGBA is free, and the ads are what pay for it, so it can stay free for the people who cannot pay. Pro turns them off for good. If you would rather not pay, watching an ad now and then helps just as much.

CAMPAIGN

#1 racing on a traffic-packed highway!
A mix of lifelike physics which has been the center point of CarX Drift Racing 2, eye-catching graphics and extreme driving on traffic-packed roads is what CarX Highway Racing has to offer.
CAMPAIGN MODE. Immerse yourself in the world of street racing.
- Check out Texas deserts, visit Australia, France or Russia. A number of countries are there on your way to success.
- Divulge activities of secret organizations and destroy Winston’s empire
- Find out what the Syndicate is after and knock down their plans before it’s too late
- Make new friends who can help you in your endeavors
LOTS OF CARS TO CHOOSE FROM. Select from pickup trucks to hypercars.
- 40 sports cars are awaiting your command: sports classic, regular vehicles, muscle cars and powerful supercars.
REALISTIC PHYSICS. Feel the power drive at your fingertips.
- Well tuned physics will allow you to feel every horsepower of the car of your choice.
- Adjust your vehicle to make sure it drives the way you want it
- No other game can give you the kind of emotions you’ll experience with CarX Highway Racing
ONLINE RACING. Show others what you’ve got.
- Compete with other players for the first place
- Move up to the next league by winning
- New competitors and challenges are awaiting you every season
DIFFERENT GAME MODES. You won’t get bored.
- Select Time Attack, race to stay in the pack or complete your run without a scratch
POLICE MODE. Bring the law back on the road.
- Become Police and restrain lawlessness on the road. Catch offenders before they get lost.
- Scare all criminals with the roar of your engine and sound of your sirene
UNIQUE EVENTS. It’s your chance to get a unique car.
- Take part in different events and receive unique cars
FREE RIDE MODE. Feel the freedom of unrestrained driving.
- Unlimited mode which will allow you to enjoy driving without having to flee or follow
CONTROLLER SUPPORT
- Connect your controller and race on vibrant tracks
MORE STUFF TO ENJOY!
- Day/Night mode: drive around Paris in the evening or blow dust of night Texas roads
- Flee from police: patrol cars will keep the thrill until you cross the finish line

- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00073608:ios.summary:
