A Best of App Store 2016 winner, Medly’s simple interface is packed with advanced t
bluejetty:00073608:ios.description:
Music-making for everyone. From new musicians looking to get started to experienced producers, Medly has everything you need to unleash your musical spark.
A Best of App Store 2016 winner, Medly’s simple interface is packed with advanced tools to create studio-quality productions. Get started for free with the Starter Pack of 17 instruments and over 100 loops and samples. You can also try Medly Member free for 7 days to unlock over 3500 instruments, loops, and exclusive features.
CREATIVE CONTROL
Music-making can be intimidating. Medly makes it easy by breaking songs down into Sections. You can add notes, audio samples, and loops to your Sections, then copy, paste and rearrange them to build your song. At any time, use the History tool to quickly rewind and undo your changes.
A MAGIC TOUCH TO NOTES
From simply adding a note to complex multi-note editing, each interaction was carefully designed with touch in mind. And with over 300 instruments available to Members, you can quickly try out different sounds and find your style.
AMPLIFIED AUDIO
Edit, snap, and trim your audio clips to your liking. Record or import audio, or use a sample from Medly’s vast audio library. You can record audio up to 4 bars or become a Member and record and import audio up to 30 seconds. As a Member, bring your songs to the next level with professionally recorded vocals by Medly’s talented artists.
POINT PERFECT AUTOMATION
Automatically change volume, echo, and other effects to add fades and pitch bends to your sounds. Snap between points and beats to achieve point perfect precision and use the selection tool to edit multiple automation points together. Then open the effect picker to quickly see the automation graphs of all effects within a Section.
SHARE AND PLAY
Quickly upload your songs to SoundCloud, or share them as a video, audio, MIDI, or Medly file. You can also connect Medly to other apps using Inter-App Audio or play in time using Ableton Link.
MADE IN CANADA
We’re a small team working relentlessly to make Medly possible. We’d love to know what you think about Medly, let us know on Facebook, Twitter, or email us at hi@medlylabs.com
*iPad App of the Year: Japan and South Korea
*iPhone App of the Year Runner-Up: China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan
https://medlylabs.com/legal

bluejetty:00014899:ios.description:
Novo App da XP: Simplicidade, Segurança e Personalização em cada toque
Apresentamos o novo app da XP, uma revolução digital que transforma a forma como você interage com suas finanças. Em um mundo onde a agilidade e a segurança são essenciais, criamos uma experiência mais simples e intuitiva, alinhada com o nosso compromisso de colocar nossos clientes em primeiro lugar.
Simplicidade
Navegar pelo novo app da XP se tornou uma experiência descomplicada. Encontre o que precisa em poucos cliques e aproveite uma navegação fluida que elimina a frustração. A simplicidade é o nosso lema, e queremos que você tenha uma experiência agradável e sem barreiras.
Personalização
Entendemos que cada cliente da XP possui necessidades únicas. Por isso, o novo app oferece um nível de personalização sem precedentes. Escolha entre temas claro ou escuro, ative ou desative a aba de bolsa e o app ajustará outras configurações conforme seus maiores usos. O app se adapta a você, tornando cada interação mais relevante e alinhada a suas necessidades.
Contexto de Uso
A praticidade é uma prioridade em nosso design. Com atalhos inteligentes, você pode acessar rapidamente as principais funcionalidades do dia a dia desde o login agilizando suas tarefas. Navegue facilmente entre serviços bancários e de investimentos, com uma interface que se adapta ao seu contexto nacional ou global, facilitando a compreensão de quais informações estão sendo visualizadas naquele momento.
Segurança com Performance
A segurança das suas informações é nossa prioridade. Implementamos melhorias tecnológicas robustas que garantem que suas transações sejam protegidas em todos os momentos e com maior performance. Graças a evolução arquitetural da plataforma, o aplicativo foi otimizado para oferecer respostas rápidas e eficientes. Desfrute de uma experiência sem interrupções, onde cada ação é realizada de forma ágil, permitindo que você se concentre no que realmente importa: suas decisões financeiras.
Baixe o novo app da XP e descubra como a sofisticação e a inovação se encontram para criar uma experiência financeira verdadeiramente personalizada. 
Ainda não é cliente XP? Baixe o app, abra sua conta e tenha os melhores investimentos e serviços financeiros em um só lugar.

bluejetty:00040904:ios.summary:
SUNLIGHT: FRIEND OR FOE?
Sunlight can boost your mood, lower stress, improve sleep, and kick-start vitamin D production. It can also turn you into a walking tomato and increase your risk of skin cancer. Like most powerful forces in the univ
bluejetty:00040904:ios.description:
SUNLIGHT: FRIEND OR FOE?
Sunlight can boost your mood, lower stress, improve sleep, and kick-start vitamin D production. It can also turn you into a walking tomato and increase your risk of skin cancer. Like most powerful forces in the universe, moderation is key.
MEET SOLA: YOUR PERSONAL POCKET SUN-NERD
Whether you're chasing a golden glow, hunting for vitamin D, or hiding from UV rays like a vampire, Sola helps you enjoy the sun without burning.
Unlike basic UV apps, Sola tracks your real UV dose over time — not just the current UV index. Smarter tanning, safer exposure, fewer regrets.
SCIENCE-BASED UV & VITAMIN D TRACKING
Sola calculates your sun exposure using real science, including:
• Current UV index forecasts
• Your skin type and existing tan
• Past sun exposure (yes, it remembers)
• Sunscreen SPF
• Whether you actually flip like a pancake instead of roasting one side
All of this feeds into your accumulated UV dose and estimated vitamin D production, so you know when enough is enough.
AUTO-TRACKING WITH APPLE WATCH
Wear an Apple Watch with an ambient light sensor? Sola can automatically detect when you step outside using Time in Daylight data. You don't even have to open the app. It just knows. Not in a creepy way. Promise.
REMINDERS THAT SAVE YOUR SKIN
Sola's built-in alerts remind you when to:
• Reapply sunscreen
• Flip for an even tan
• Seek shade before you cook
• Get notified when the UV index reaches, exceeds, or drops below your chosen threshold
No guessing. No "just five more minutes." No sudden realization that the sun quietly turned up the heat.
APPLE WATCH, WIDGETS & LIVE ACTIVITIES
Track UV exposure from your wrist (because pulling out your phone mid-sunbath is how sand gets everywhere). Sola widgets show:
• Current UV index
• Accumulated UV dose & sun-triggered vitamin D
• Estimated safe sun time
• Time in Daylight stats
Live Activities keep your session timer on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, so you can see exactly how close you are to crispy.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Sola logs UV exposure, vitamin D production, and Time in Daylight directly to Apple Health — accurate data based on real sunlight and real science, not guesswork.
DESIGNED FOR ACTUAL SUNLIGHT
High-contrast monochrome themes make Sola readable even in blinding sunlight — yes, even with sunglasses on. No squinting required. Save the crow's feet for later.
TRY SOLA
Some basic features are free. Unlock everything with a free 3-day trial, then continue with an annual subscription — or grab a one-time lifetime purchase, because unlike a summer fling, commitment can be beautiful.
"A sunburn-free world, one Sola user at a time." ~ Dr. Helios (probably)
DISCLAIMER
Sola provides informational estimates about sun exposure and UV radiation based on scientific research and available data, including skin type, location, UV intensity, sunscreen use, and related factors. This is not medical advice and should not replace professional healthcare guidance or common sense. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the developer is not responsible for any consequences resulting from the use or inability to use this app.
Terms of use: https://getsola.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00145493:ios.description:
A Loja do Mecânico é o aplicativo oficial da maior loja de ferramentas, máquinas e equipamentos profissionais do Brasil. Encontre ferramentas manuais, ferramentas elétricas, máquinas profissionais, equipamentos para oficina, construção civil, manutenção industrial e muito mais, com compra segura, entrega rápida e garantia de procedência.
O app Loja do Mecânico foi desenvolvido para profissionais que vivem do fazer: mecânicos, oficinas, técnicos, serralheiros, eletricistas, instaladores, empresas, indústrias e também consumidores que buscam ferramentas de qualidade profissional para trabalho, manutenção e produtividade.
Aqui você encontra milhares de produtos das principais marcas do mercado, com ofertas exclusivas no aplicativo, condições especiais e praticidade para comprar ferramentas e máquinas direto do celular.
Principais categorias disponíveis no app:
• Ferramentas manuais e elétricas
Parafusadeiras, furadeiras, esmerilhadeiras, chaves, lixadeiras, serras e muito mais
• Máquinas e equipamentos profissionais
Compressores de ar, máquinas de solda, lavadoras de alta pressão, geradores, motores e equipamentos para uso profissional
• Oficina mecânica e automotiva
Elevadores automotivos, guinchos, aspiradores, ferramentas automotivas, bombas e equipamentos para oficina
• Construção civil e indústria
Equipamentos para obra, manutenção, instalação, produção e uso industrial
• Segurança e EPIs
Equipamentos de proteção individual para segurança e conformidade no ambiente de trabalho
Benefícios do aplicativo Loja do Mecânico:
• Ofertas exclusivas no app
• Cupons especiais para usuários do aplicativo
• Lives com promoções em ferramentas e máquinas
• Compra segura e rápida
• Pagamento via Pix, cartão e parcelamento
• Acompanhamento de pedidos em tempo real
• Lista de favoritos para salvar produtos
• Histórico de pedidos e recompra facilitada
• Atendimento rápido e suporte especializado
Compre online e retire na loja
No app Loja do Mecânico você também pode comprar online e retirar na loja física mais próxima, com mais rapidez, praticidade e agilidade para o seu trabalho.
Por que escolher a Loja do Mecânico?
A Loja do Mecânico é referência nacional em ferramentas, máquinas e equipamentos profissionais. São milhares de produtos para oficina, mecânica, construção civil, manutenção, indústria e uso profissional, sempre com marcas reconhecidas, garantia, suporte especializado e confiança de quem entende do assunto.
Seja para uso profissional ou pessoal, o app Loja do Mecânico ajuda você a encontrar as ferramentas certas para trabalhar com mais eficiência, produtividade e segurança.
Baixe agora o aplicativo Loja do Mecânico e tenha acesso à maior loja de ferramentas e máquinas profissionais do Brasil diretamente no seu celular.
Site: www.lojadomecanico.com.br
Instagram: @lojadomecanico
Facebook: /lojadomecanico
TikTok: @lojadomecanico
YouTube: @Lojadomecanico
Suporte direto pelo app: rápido, prático e confiável!

bluejetty:00186160:ios.name: Vaia: Flashcards & Study Guide
bluejetty:00186160:ios.summary:
Your notes can do more than sit in a folder.
Turn lecture slides, PDFs, and class notes into a personal study path with Vaia. Use AI to create flashcards and summaries, get help understanding tricky topics, and practice what you need for h
bluejetty:00186160:ios.description:
Your notes can do more than sit in a folder.
Turn lecture slides, PDFs, and class notes into a personal study path with Vaia. Use AI to create flashcards and summaries, get help understanding tricky topics, and practice what you need for homework, midterms, and finals.
YOUR MATERIALS, MADE FOR LEARNING
A stack of slides and no idea where to start? Upload your materials and build a study guide around your own course.
• Break down your material with explanations and summaries
• Generate AI flashcards to practice key ideas
• Follow a learning path with chapters, lessons, and questions
Go from collecting notes to actually working through them.
HOMEWORK HELP THAT BUILDS UNDERSTANDING
Stuck on a topic while doing homework? Ask Vaia's AI assistant questions about your study materials and get explanations to help you move forward. Use the homework scanner to capture a problem as input.
Then put your understanding to work with flashcards and practice questions. Get help with today's material and build knowledge you can use on your next test.
FLASHCARDS THAT FIT YOUR COURSE
Generate flashcards from your notes, create your own cards, or explore sets shared by other students. Practice definitions, formulas, and vocabulary by recalling the answer before you flip the card.
Use spaced repetition to revisit material over time. Fit in a few cards between classes or settle into a longer study session.
A STUDY PLANNER WITH A CLEAR NEXT STEP
Your course becomes a structured learning path. Work through chapters, read explanations, and practice with interactive questions. See your progress and pick up where you left off.
From biology to economics, keep your study materials and your next lesson together in one place.
FIND THE GAPS BEFORE EXAM DAY
That topic looked familiar. Could you explain it without your notes? Find out with quizzes, exercises, and practice tests.
• Check your understanding with multiple-choice and fill-in-the-blank questions
• Try practice exam mode and review your results afterward
• Revisit the topics that need more work before your midterm or final
GIVE YOUR NOTES A VOICE
Create study podcasts from your materials and listen on the go. Review a topic on your commute or switch things up when you need a break from reading.
SHARE THE WORK. KEEP LEARNING.
Explore shared flashcards, study notes, and summaries to complement your own materials. Share your sets with classmates and bring useful resources together for your course.
From high school homework to college finals, Vaia helps you turn your materials into something you can learn from.
Download Vaia, upload your first notes, and start your first chapter.
Terms of Use: https://www.vaia.com/en-us/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.vaia.com/en-us/privacy/

bluejetty:00075149:ios.summary: Harvest games for toddlers is an educational game for kids from 2 to 5 years old in which kids will learn a lot about village life. Toddlers will start a new rural adventure and our kindergarten game will help create a countryside atmospher
bluejetty:00075149:ios.description:
Harvest games for toddlers is an educational game for kids from 2 to 5 years old in which kids will learn a lot about village life. Toddlers will start a new rural adventure and our kindergarten game will help create a countryside atmosphere. Children will not only figure out how to grow wheat and how this wheat can then be used, but they will also learn and build different machines, agricultural techniques and much more!
How will the children play the farm game:
Farm and Agro Machines is a fun and educational children's game that takes players on a journey through the process of growing wheat. In the game, children grow wheat in stages and build separate machines for each stage, which they assemble from different parts.
In the first stage, players plant and cultivate wheat seeds, making sure they have enough water and sunlight. Once the wheat has grown, players move on to the next stage where they harvest the crop using a combine harvester machine they have assembled.
In the following stage, players use a thresher machine to separate the wheat kernels from the chaff. Finally, they use a milling machine to grind the wheat into flour, which can then be used to make various food products such as bread and pasta.
Throughout the game, children learn about the different machines and processes involved in growing and processing wheat, and the various products that can be made from the crop. With engaging graphics and fun challenges, "Farm and Agro Machines" is an entertaining way for children to learn about agriculture and food production
"Farm and Agro Cars" is a fantastic educational game designed for young children aged 2 to 5 years old. The game offers numerous benefits that help to stimulate children's learning and development in a fun and interactive way.
Advantages of Farm and Harvest Kids Games:
One of the main benefits of this game is that it teaches children about farm equipment and how it works. Children will learn the names of different machines, their functions, and the tasks they help people with. This knowledge not only increases children's understanding of the world around them, but also helps to develop their critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Another benefit of the game is that it helps to train children's memory, attention, and observation skills. Children will learn to remember the names of different machines and their functions, and will also have to pay close attention to detail as they complete various tasks.
In addition to this, the game also helps to develop fine motor skills and coordination. The simple car mini-games between the main tasks offer a fun way for children to practice and improve their hand-eye coordination.

Ever lent someone your phone only to catch them swiping through your gallery, notes, or reminders? With App Secret, that stops now. Easily lock your private content with a passcode, combination, or dot-pattern, and keep prying eyes out of your business.

-- KEY FEATURES --

Multiple Lock Styles
• Numeric passcode lock
• Combination lock
• Dot-pattern lock for enhanced security

Private Photos & Videos
• Create and lock individual albums
• Import from your photo library or take photos in-app
• Export back to your device easily
• Move, copy, and paste between albums

Secure Notes
• Organize notes into lockable folders
• Move, copy, paste, and search your notes
• Simple folder management for better organization

Protected Reminders
• Create reminders in secure folders
• Copy, move, and paste with ease
• Keep tasks and plans private

Voice Memos
• Record, rename, delete, and playback
• Share voice memos securely
• Optional speaker output

Private Contacts
• Fully-featured contact management
• Add, edit, delete, and search contacts
• Batch import/export with vCard support
• Add custom fields beyond standard info

Extra Security Tools
• Break-in reports
• Decoy mode with a fake password
• Universal app — works on both iPhone & iPad with a single purchase
• Intuitive, easy-to-use interface

Your privacy matters. Take control of your data with App Secret — the smart, simple, and secure solution for keeping your private life truly private.

apple-macos:6780704048.description:
Give your retired Mac, iPad, or iPhone a premium second life. Instead of letting older, classic Apple hardware collect dust, "Wall Clock Weather" instantly transforms your device into a highly legible, elegant smart-home dashboard and real-time weather station.
For a one-time purchase of just $0.99 - with NO subscription fees, NO ads, and NO data tracking - you can upcycle your hardware into a gorgeous, high-visibility dedicated wall display that rivals expensive smart-home screens.
--------------------------------------------------
KEY FEATURES
--------------------------------------------------
* GLOBAL CLOCK & CALENDAR
- Universal Timekeeper: Type in any city worldwide, and the clock immediately shifts to display that location’s exact local date and time.
- Highly Customizable: Choose between standard 12-hour (with AM/PM) or 24-hour clock displays, and easily toggle the seconds indicator on or off.
- Aesthetic Typography: Select from a curated list of wall-clock optimized fonts, including clean system styles, geometric industrial designs, or our signature retro "Flip Clock" bold typeface.
* REAL-TIME WEATHER STATION
- At-a-Glance Metrics: Displays current temperature, precise weather conditions, and high-detail dynamic weather symbols that automatically shift to reflect day or night states in the target timezone.
- Comprehensive Environmental Data: Track real-time metrics including wind speed/direction, current humidity, daily forecast average humidity, UV index, and official US EPA Air Quality Index (AQI) ratings.
- Extreme Temperature Indicators: The temperature readout dynamically highlights in bright red when conditions exceed 90 degrees F, or bright green between 70 and 80 degrees F, giving you instant environmental awareness from a distance.
* SEVERE WEATHER ALERTS
- NWS Integration: For US locations, the app directly hooks into the official United States National Weather Service API to display real-time emergency warning banners (Tornado, Flood, Blizzard warnings).
- Detailed Descriptions: Tap the warning banner to open a clean, monospaced details page to read the complete government-issued severity text and instructions.
- Global Fallback: For international regions, the app automatically evaluates local parameters and raises native warnings for extreme heat or high-wind events.
* ASTRONOMICAL TRACKING
- Displays the current phase of the moon with high-resolution, beautifully rendered astronomical glyphs and matching descriptive text (e.g., Waning Crescent, Waxing Gibbous).
* MODERN, TAILORED AESTHETICS
- Customize your display to fit any room. Select a pure, high-contrast solid black background, one of our vibrant built-in macOS-style gradient themes (Big Sur, Sonoma, Aurora, Sunset), or upload a personal family photo that automatically crops and scales to fit your screen perfectly.
- Tap your custom logo on the top-left to slide open a built-in web browser overlay navigating directly to your website.
--------------------------------------------------
WHY CHOOSE WALL CLOCK WEATHER?
--------------------------------------------------
* Zero Subscriptions: Buy once, own forever.
* Zero Advertisements: No visual clutter, no interruptions.
* Responsive Vector UI: Every font, capsule, and layout coordinate scales mathematically, keeping the screen pixel-perfect whether run on a Macbook, iPad, or Android tablet.
* Upcycling Value: Turn older, unsupported, or lying-around devices into an invaluable permanent fixture in your home, kitchen, or office.
Transform your space today with Wall Clock Weather.

apple-macos:6760369059.name: FoodPilot
apple-macos:6760369059.description:
FoodPilot te ayuda a organizar el día a día de tu restaurante, cafetería o pequeño negocio de comida. Reúne pedidos, cocina, menú, cobros y caja en una experiencia pensada para iPhone, iPad y Mac, sin depender de una instalación complicada.
PEDIDOS CLAROS DESDE EL PRIMER MOMENTO
Toma pedidos con un catálogo visual, identifica la mesa o el cliente y elige si son para consumir en el lugar o para llevar. Añade indicaciones para cocina y consulta cuánto tiempo lleva esperando cada cuenta.
UNA COCINA MEJOR ORGANIZADA
Consulta los pedidos pendientes, en preparación y listos para servir. Marca las entregas y revisa los pedidos entregados en su propio apartado, para mantener clara la carga de trabajo.
TU MENÚ, CON MÁS CONTROL
Organiza productos por categorías, añade precios, descripciones y fotografías. Configura extras con precio, opciones obligatorias y límites de selección. Lleva el control de unidades disponibles o marca productos como agotados.
COBROS Y RECIBOS SIN COMPLICACIONES
Registra pagos completos o por productos, en efectivo o con tarjeta, y calcula el cambio. Consulta los recibos de cada pago, compártelos en PDF o imprímelos mediante las opciones del sistema con una impresora compatible.
CAJA Y CORTES
Abre la caja con un fondo inicial, registra entradas y retiros con su motivo y compara el efectivo esperado con el contado al cerrar. Conserva los cortes anteriores y sus diferencias para revisarlos después.
VENTAS Y GASTOS A LA VISTA
Consulta el historial de ventas y reembolsos, registra gastos y revisa un resumen de ventas menos gastos registrados. Busca movimientos, filtra por periodos y descarga reportes para dar seguimiento a tu negocio.
TU EQUIPO, CON LOS PERMISOS ADECUADOS
Invita empleados mediante códigos, autoriza sus dispositivos y asigna roles de mesero, cocina o caja. La administración queda reservada al propietario, que también puede consultar el historial de acciones confirmadas.
INFORMACIÓN COMPARTIDA, ESTÉS DONDE ESTÉS
Los pedidos, fotos del menú y demás registros del restaurante se guardan en línea y se actualizan entre los equipos autorizados. No necesitan compartir la misma red Wi-Fi ni mantener conectado el dispositivo del propietario.
UNA EXPERIENCIA PARA CADA PANTALLA
Trabaja desde el iPhone durante el servicio y aprovecha las vistas adaptadas a pantallas grandes en iPad y Mac.
Se requiere conexión a internet. El propietario utiliza Iniciar sesión con Apple; los empleados se unen mediante una invitación. La impresión es opcional y requiere una impresora compatible.
FoodPilot registra pagos y reembolsos, pero no procesa cargos ni devoluciones bancarias. Los recibos no son facturas fiscales.
